fdroid:app.nightdrop.name: Night Drop
fdroid:app.nightdrop.summary: Anonymous, end-to-end encrypted 1:1 chat over Tor
fdroid:app.nightdrop.description:
Night Drop is a privacy-first 1:1 messenger. Like a night deposit box: every message is a sealed envelope, dropped for one person only, opened by no one in between.
* Anonymous identities only — no phone number, no email, no account. Your identity is a keypair held on your device.
* End-to-end encryption with the Signal Double Ratchet: only the sender and receiver can read a message.
* Peer-to-peer over Tor by default. There is no clearnet path — the only network egress is the Tor network.
* Local-first storage: messages live on your device. Optional server storage is opt-in, capped at 24 hours, and shows a persistent warning in the chat while active.
* An untrusted store-and-forward relay carries offline delivery only. Any relay ever holds nothing but opaque, already-encrypted blobs under unlinkable handles — no keys, no plaintext, no identities, no logs.
* Authorization before the first message: a stranger cannot message you until you approve them (scan a pre-authorized QR, or exchange a short code whose secret words block a man-in-the-middle).
* Safety-number verification (scan or compare) to confirm no one is in the middle.
* User-owned encrypted backups: the recovery password is generated on your device, shown once, and never sent to any server. Lose it and the backup is unrecoverable — by design.
* No analytics, no crash reporters, no ad SDKs, no Google Play Services, and no third-party push service.
* No automatic update check on F-Droid installs. Other builds (sideloaded, or the desktop AppImage, which have no update channel of their own) ask the Night Drop onion site over Tor, at most once a day, whether a newer version exists — and only tell you. The app never installs anything, and does not hold the permission that would let it.
Night Drop is free software (AGPL-3.0-or-later) and built to be reproducible: anyone can rebuild the release from source and confirm it matches, byte for byte.

fdroid:com.ciphernotes.twa.description:
Ciphernotes is an end-to-end encrypted notebook that keeps your text safe even when it syncs through the cloud. Every note is encrypted before it leaves your device, so the server only sees ciphertext.
Key features:
- Open source backend and frontend so you can self-host or review how your data is handled.
- Works completely offline.
- Text and files are encrypted before they're synced.
- No ads, no trackers, no unnecessary cookies.
- No account required for local use.
- Syncs immediately across all platforms.
- Dark- and Light-Mode.
- Todo lists with sub-tasks.
- Import and view images and videos.
- Import files of any type.
- Organize with labels.
- Google Keep import.
- Export notes as JSON.
- Fully keyboard navigatable.
- Keyboard shortcuts, open notes with cmd+k or ctrl+k.
- Text-editor with multi-cursor support and other shortcuts.
- Archive unused notes.
- Share encryption key via QR-Code directly from app to app
Ciphernotes is a PWA hosted on https://ciphernotes.com the Android app bundles the assets and serves them locally using a WebView.
Encryption:
- Encrypted in transit/storage from the server’s perspective. Notes are decrypted locally, edited locally, then encrypted before sync/upload.
- Not encrypted at rest inside the app/device. Local IndexedDB data stores plaintext notes and decrypted file blobs.
- Device compromise exposes notes. Malware, physical device access, malicious extensions (web version), or WebView data extraction can read plaintext local data and the key.
- Server/operator compromise alone should not expose note contents.

fdroid:com.saiga.find.messagefinder.description:
Priority Alerts is an app to trigger notifications when receiving priority messages (determined by user keywords).
 UseCase 
Acts as SOS alerter, user can configure some keywords like "help" or "emergency" keywords in this app, and the contact number likely they are going to receive the same.
So even when the user puts the phone in silent mode or in vibrate mode, the app alerts the user through customized ringtone, when the incoming SMS contents matches the configured keywords.
 Features: 
1. It supports multiple keywords as input to identify the text (either in comma or space separated format).
2. Informs user, when any one of the keywords are matched with received message.
3. Informs user even in silent mode.
4. On Boarding Screen for first time users is shown upon app installation.
 How to use: 
1. User inputs contact number(optional) and the keyword(required), the user will be informed when the keyword is found in any of the incoming SMS.
2. Press trigger button to save the config. So that the app uses it every time, when a SMS is received and validates it, even after reboot it works.
3. User needs to accept the READ SMS permission or else the app wouldn't able to validate the SMS packets against the user configured keyword. This is the core functionality of the app, without this the app wouldn't work.
4. To stop the app functionality, press the clear config button.
5. Users can see their saved config on pressing settings icon inside the app
We don't use Ads and we never share user data via any means.

fdroid:io.github.mgdx.rouelibre.name: Roue Libre
fdroid:io.github.mgdx.rouelibre.summary: Bike sharing: offline map and journeys, with no tracker.
fdroid:io.github.mgdx.rouelibre.description:
Roue Libre shows bike-share stations on a map and computes a door-to-door journey combining walking and cycling.
Everything runs on the device: the map, the address search and the route computation need no connection at all. Only real-time bike availability goes out on the network.
 What sets it apart 
• No Google service: no Play Services, no Firebase, no Maps SDK. It runs on any Android OS without Google services.
• No telemetry, no tracker, no unique identifier, no account.
• No journey data kept: no history, no positions, no destinations. What you search for does not leave the phone.
• No city is imposed: several conurbations coexist on the device, and one city's data can be deleted without touching the others.
• The journey optimises the pair of stations — departure and arrival — rather than settling for the nearest, and weighs the risk of a poorly stocked station emptying while you walk to it.
 Worth knowing before installing 
The map, the routing graph and the address index are not in the application: they are downloaded once, from the storage screen, or installed by hand from files you produce yourself. Their weight follows the city — a few tens of megabytes for a medium-sized conurbation, more for a capital — and it is announced before downloading.
 The cities served 
Close to three hundred networks, in some thirty countries: every one that publishes its stations as open data and whose docks the journey can rely on — from Vélib' in Paris to Citi Bike in New York, by way of Prague, Barcelona, Copenhagen, Tokyo and Buenos Aires. The application proposes yours from your position, if you ask it to, and you can keep several installed and switch between them.
The offline datasets have been produced for a handful of them so far. For the others, the application says so rather than pretending: the list shows what exists, and the files can be produced with the repository's scripts.
It is tied to no network in particular: the list of cities updates itself, and every city carries the address of its own GBFS feed, which makes the application usable with any GBFS network in the world.
Roue Libre is an independent application, with no link to the networks it serves or their operators.
Free software under the GNU GPL v3 licence.

apple-macos:6747192143.name: eXODA Port Scanner
apple-macos:6747192143.description:
eXODA Port Scanner makes network analysis on macOS and iOS effortless with an intuitive interface and powerful features. With just a few taps, you can scan any IP range and ports—whether standard services like HTTP (port 80) and SSH (port 22), printer interfaces (ports 515, 631, 9100), or custom ports you define. Thanks to asynchronous parallel scanning and intelligent port caching, the process is lightning-fast even across large subnets, and previously discovered hosts are reused automatically.
Each discovered host appears in a clean, informative card showing the open port number, IP address, PTR-looked-up hostname, and MAC and vendor details from the local ARP table. eXODA Port Scanner also performs an ICMP ping to report round-trip time (RTT) in milliseconds and TTL (time-to-live), so you can gauge latency and reachability at a glance.
For deeper device insights, the app can connect via SNMP to switches, routers, or printers—when available—to pull system info (sysName, sysDescr, sysUpTime). It even auto-detects printers using the Printer MIB. Public GeoIP and ASN data (via ipwhois.app) provide country, region, and ISP details for each host.
Your own Wi-Fi environment is detailed, too: local IP address, SSID, and BSSID are displayed. You remain in full control—scans run entirely within your LAN, and no data ever leaves your network.
The sleek, modern UI is built on Flutter 3 with Material 3 and Cupertino styling, automatically adapting to light or dark mode. On macOS, a global hotkey (Ctrl + Q) lets you start or stop scans system-wide and view results in any active app. Advanced users can save, edit, and reset their custom port lists as needed.
eXODA Port Scanner is ideal for home network administrators, small-office IT pros, or anyone who wants to discover open ports, measure latency, and identify devices without wrestling with terminal commands. Whether you’re hunting down rogue devices, cataloging printers and routers, or simply checking connection speeds, it’s all at your fingertips.
Download eXODA Port Scanner today and transform your network analysis workflow—scan open ports, test latency, recognize devices, and optimize your infrastructure without ever opening a terminal. Regular updates ensure you’ll always have the latest protocols, new platform support, and cutting-edge diagnostic tools.

apple-macos:1473674681.name: CloudDox
apple-macos:1473674681.description:
◎CloudDox
CloudDox is an application designed to handle online documents as if they were local files.
Have you ever wanted to use Google Docs just like an Excel file? This app was born from such a wish of a developer.
The Internet has evolved so that devices are always connected to the Internet and local and cloud barriers are almost invisible. On the other hand, work styles in which local files are organized into folders for each project are still often used. 
For example, when developing an app. An Excel file that creates an Xcode project, Excel file that summarizes specifications, Google document bug list shared among members, image files used in the app, and text files notes from meetings. They can be online documents or local text files. They are put together into a single folder and development is progressing. You can access online documents such as Google Docs from a folder just like any other file. CloudDox makes it possible.
Technology should not force human behavior. Technology should make people free.
◎Usage
Create a new CloudDox document with "New" from the "File" menu. If you click the setting icon in the upper left, you can enter the URL of the online document you want to make into a file.
After that, please save it like a normal file. You can open it by double-clicking, or copy it to a folder.
Like Word and Excel, you can create cloud-based documents such as Google spreadsheets from templates.
If you want to create a cloud-based document that does not exist in the template, create a blank CloudDox document from "Create New". You can create any document by copying the URL from the settings icon in the upper left.
The following cloud-based documents are supported in newly created templates:
Other documents can be used in the same way (some are not supported, please check).
◎Features
The following cloud-based documents are supported in newly created templates:
Other documents can be used in the same way (some are not supported, please check).
《Productivity》
・ Google Docs
・ Google spreadsheet
・ Google Slide
・ Google drawing
・ Google Calendar
・Microsoft Word
・Microsoft Excel
・Microsoft PowerPoint
《Entertainment》
・YouTube
・Netflix
《Communication》
・Chatwork
・Discord
◎In-App Purchase
CloudDox can be used free of charge for 5 days from the first startup. After the trial period expires, you cannot use it unless you purchase it.
◎ Notes
Some online documents do not support CloudDox. Please check carefully during the trial period.

flathub:org.damask_multiphysics.DAMASK_m.name: DAMASK mesh
flathub:org.damask_multiphysics.DAMASK_m.description:
DAMASK® is a unified multi-physics crystal plasticity simulation package. The solution of continuum mechanical boundary value problems requires a constitutive response that connects deformation and stress at each material point. This problem is solved in DAMASK on the basis of crystal plasticity using a variety of constitutive models and homogenization approaches. However, treating mechanics in isolation is no longer sufficient to study emergent advanced high-strength materials. In these materials, deformation happens interrelated with displacive phase transformation, significant heating, and potential damage evolution. Therefore, DAMASK is capable of handling multi-physics problems. Following a modular approach, additional field equations are solved in a fully coupled way using a staggered approach.
 The mesh solver (damask_mesh) operates on unstructured meshes.

 W,A,S,D = Move around based on relative orientation to X and Y.
 SPACE + L-SHIFT = Move up and down relative Z.
 F = Toggle player fast speed on and off.

 F1 = Resets environment state back to default.
 F2 = Toggle HUD visibility.
 F3 = Save. (auto saves on exit, backup made if idle for 3 mins)
 F8 = Load. (will erase what you have done since the last save)
 Your state is automatically saved on exit.
 Check the console output for more information, arguments can be passed to the program to export your project, create a new project, load a project from file, change mouse sensitivity and apply custom color palettes to projects.

This package can be divided in three parts: • The ‘e00conv’ command-line program. This program takes a E00 file as input (compressed or not) and copies it to a new file with the requested compression level (NONE, PARTIAL or FULL). • A set of library functions to read compressed E00 files. These functions read a E00 file (compressed or not) and return a stream of uncompressed lines, making the E00 file appear as if it was not compressed. • A set of library functions to write compressed E00 files. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. fedora-packages:golang-etcd-bbolt/golang.description: Package Bbolt implements a low-level key/value store in pure Go. It supports fully serializable transactions, ACID semantics, and lock-free MVCC with multiple readers and a single writer. Bolt can be used for projects that want a simple data store without the need to add large dependencies such as Postgres or MySQL. Bolt is a single-level, zero-copy, B+tree data store. This means that Bolt is optimized for fast read access and does not require recovery in the event of a system crash. Transactions which have not finished committing will simply be rolled back in the event of a crash. The design of Bolt is based on Howard Chu's LMDB database project.

bluejetty:00147559:ios.description:
Fique ligado com o aplicativo do Voz das Comunidades. 
Receba notícias, informações e análises atualizadas sobre o que está acontecendo nas favelas do Rio de Janeiro e como você e a sua comunidade estão sendo impactados. 
Este aplicativo poderoso oferece acesso constante à reportagens completos, análises especiais e atualizações em tempo real do Voz das Comunidades sobre o que está acontecendo agora perto de você e em outras comunidades da cidade. 
Navegue no Jornal o conteúdo do Voz que você ama e confia, incluindo notícias de última hora, perfis detalhados e artigos de opinião. Vá até Fatos para ver as últimas notícias em circulação comprovadamente falsas ou verdadeiras. 
Fique atento para Ao Vivo para receber relatórios atualizados sobre a situação em constante mudança nas favelas do Rio e volte rapidamente para o conteúdo salvo ou visualizado recentemente em Meu Voz. 
Com esse aplicativo, agora você tem uma linha direta de comunicação com a equipe editorial do Voz, que está à disposição para receber suas dicas e alertas, seja sobre notícias falsas, chuva forte, violência armada ou qualquer outro assunto urgente. 
Tudo isso, além de notificações de notícias de última hora, e a capacidade de compartilhar qualquer coisa com um toque, mantém você conectado e informado como nunca antes nesses tempos de mudança rápida.
Recursos do aplicativo:
* Jornal: todo o conteúdo do jornal do Voz das Comunidades é fácil de acessar, ler, salvar e compartilhar
* Concursos: participe de concursos promovidos pelo Voz das Comunidades
* Pesquisas: ajude o Voz a compreender os dados das comunidades respondendo pesquisas
* Criação de Conta: crie sua conta e interaja com funções especiais
* Fatos: dedicado à verificação de notícias em circulação - dizemos o que é verdade e o que são apenas fake news
* Ao Vivo: explore um feed com curadoria das notícias mais importantes à medida que elas acontecem
* Meu Voz: veja histórias salvas e a sua atividade recente
* Notificações por push: receba as últimas notícias de nossos editores assim que as histórias surgirem
* Compartilhe conteúdo facilmente com Whatsapp, Twitter, Facebook, ou e-mail

bluejetty:00186970:ios.name: Learn Recorder - tonestro
bluejetty:00186970:ios.summary:
Learn to play the recorder and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the recorder and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune your recorder easily.
tonestro for Recorder of
bluejetty:00186970:ios.description:
Learn to play the recorder and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the recorder and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune your recorder easily.
tonestro for Recorder offers a large collection of songs, exercises and guided lessons for every skill level. Learn how to read music notes and improve your recorder skills by playing many songs and exercises.
With the tuner you tune your recorder fast and easily for perfect pitch. A metronome and specially composed background music with play alongs for many songs guide you the way to perfect rhythm.
Weekly challenges with hand-picked songs give you the extra motivation to improve your skills when you compare yourself with recorder players from around the world.
OVERVIEW
- Get instant feedback on rhythm & pitch
- Learn to play the recorder or learn something new
- Enjoy a large collection of songs
- Discover recorder lessons & exercises
- Start with your first lessons on music notes or choose from many songs
- Learn the correct fingerings with fingering charts
- Tune your recorder with our integrated tuner
- Enjoy songs with play alongs
- Stay motivated with weekly challenges
LEARN
Learn how to play the recorder or improve your skills with lessons, fingering charts and exercises. Step-by-step lessons will guide you through your first notes on the recorder. Detailed explanations and fingering charts tell you how to play a certain note. A tuner helps you find the correct pitch. Test your knowledge in exams and see how fast you progress. Use your newly learned skills and play your first songs on your recorder.
For experienced recorder players there’s always something new to learn with advanced lessons, songs and exercises.
PRACTICE
Use tonestro’s live-feedback feature on rhythm and pitch to improve your skills. See where you struggle with intonation and work on your pitch to become a better recorder player. Switch to practice mode and choose a slower tempo to work on getting that rhythm right. Let the metronome guide you through the songs and use the tuner to not only tune your recorder but also to see which notes are the ones you have to be very careful with pitch.
PLAY
Discover songs from all music genres and play recorder songs for every skill level. Whether you’re a fan of classical music or you prefer jazz songs instead: With tonestro’s large sheet music library you’ll find just the songs you need for playing your recorder.
And you don’t have to play alone: With play alongs you’re playing with a whole band in the background. Always on your side is the tonestro tuner, which is an easy-to-use tuner that will make sure that you’re in tune. And there’s always the metronome that will guide you through the songs. 
COMPETE
Do you want to prove your skills? Enter our weekly challenges! Compete with recorder players from around the world and fight for the podium. Practice the songs to score as many points as possible and become the best recorder player in the tonestro world. Don’t forget to use the tuner first, so that you can start the challenge with perfect preparation.
tonestro requires a subscription to access the entire learning content and song library. Each subscription plan may include a 3-day free trial period.
Terms: https://www.tonestro.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.tonestro.com/privacy

In ad­di­tion to track­ing makes and miss­e
bluejetty:00082531:ios.description:
Spalding TF DNA app* is used by the best shooters in the world to improve their shooting. The app tracks makes, misses, and critical training data. Shoot in your drive­way, gym or team prac­tice.
In ad­di­tion to track­ing makes and miss­es, the app also tracks:
* re­lease time
* re­lease an­gle (i.e. shot arc)
* spin rate
* shot con­sis­ten­cy
* shot sit­u­a­tion (off-the-drib­ble, off-the-pass, re­laxed like a free throw)
* shot accuracy (accuracy indicates the number of perfect shots, by tracking your improvement and focus to shoot swishes, your shooting percentage will improve)
The ball is ready, are you?
*) The app requires a valid Spalding TF DNA app subscription and an official Spalding TF DNA or TF1000 smart basketball to collect shooting data. The ball can be ordered at Spalding Website and is available in sizes 6 & 7.
HealthKit is used for getting user height.
Terms of Use: https://spalding.tf-dna.app/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00087893:ios.description:
Food is really awesome, right? 
Kitchen Crush is a fast-paced, addictive, time management free online cooking games. The best way to show your cooking skills with food cooking game. Be ready to have the best cooking simulator experience. 
Kitchen Crush is a free cooking games and have lots of exciting food and features to experience. Let's explore the world of the best menu from around the world. 
This food cooking game contains food trucks and cuisine from different corners of the world. You can find Indian restaurants, Chinese food restaurants, fast food restaurants, Mexican food trucks, American food recipes, Christmas foods and much more. The best cooking games online for girls to prepare, cook, and serve yummy food to your customers. 
Crazy food game features of the Kitchen Crush game 
- Easy game play experience
- Simple controls to play in this cooking games online
- Cool sound effects and music
- Cute customers to visit the food trucks
- Amazing food animations and customer expressions
- Upgrade food machine and recipes to improve their abilities
- Spin wheel to get unique rewards
- Combos to get extra money
- Tips from customer when you make them happy
- Daily task for you to claim daily reward
- Boosters to get you victory in this kitchen game - Double Coin, Burn Proof, Insta cook, Candy, Magic Dish, Insta serve, Second Chance, More Customer, More Time
 Unique recipe and fun fact of kitchen crush cooking games 
- Prepare breakfast, lunch and dinner in different food trucks. 
- Choose ingredients to prepare the delicious food for your customers
- Cook the food perfectly, don’t overcook the food. overcooked food will get burned.
- Prepare, cook, and serve the delicious recipe and become a top chef. 
- Travel to different cities around the world and learn new recipes. 
- Be quick and show your cooking craze to get the combos and coins. 
- Start your day with a yummy breakfast of donuts and sweet and sour pineapple juices.
- Visit a Chinese restaurant to have ban mian soup, risotto, Lanzhou lamian soup, noodles, Kung Pao Chicken, Sweet & Sour Pork, Hot Pot and spicy manchurian
- Thinking of fast food near me? Then dive into Mexican flavour with tacos, sandwiches, cheese steak hotdogs, and French fries with great fast food recipes.
Avocado sushi, buffalo chicken wings, Sloppy Joe, avocado smoothie, deep dish cheesy pizza, and pizza muffin are super tasty foods available in American restaurants.
America
California - Try healthy avocado recipes like avocado sushi, avocado guacamole burgers, and avocado smoothies.
Chicago - Chicago cuisine - deep-dish pizza, flavour of Chicago's Chicken Vesuvio and pizza muffins.
New York - New York cheesecake, New York's famous Manhattan meatballs and Buffalo chicken wings at this restaurant.
Halloween World
Canada - Canadian flavours with spider cake and pumpkin pancakes. Drink a Halloween smoothie if you feel thirsty.
USA - The Hallows Juice, mummy brie, and Halloween Cookie will set Halloween on fire.
Australia - Frankenstein Rice Krispies is an awesome rice recipe. Serve a Spider Taco Crescent Ring with a Halloween donut and enjoy Halloween.
Ireland - On a spooky night, enjoy Skull Burgers, Ghost Pizza Bagels, and The Pink Witch Punch at this Halloween fast food restaurant.
Christmas World
United Kingdom - British style Christmas panettone and a gingerbread smoothie bowl.
New Zealand - When you are at kiwi's place to celebrate Christmas, you must have smoked salmon and glazed ham.
Canada - Traditional Canadian recipes for Christmas. Christmas Turkey and Beef Wellington would be the main courses, along with Christmas cake as a dessert

bluejetty:00078768:android.description:
Embark on a magical quest to defeat the Evil Lord and save the realm!
In a world shrouded in darkness and ruled by dark magic, a lone hero emerges to challenge the evil that has gripped the land.
You are the chosen one, a warrior with untapped magical powers, destined to defeat the Evil Lord and restore peace to the kingdom.
Your journey will be fraught with peril, as you battle against hordes of monstrous creatures, overcome treacherous obstacles, and unravel the dark secrets of your past.
Along the way, you will encounter allies who share your cause, and together, you will forge a path towards victory.
As you grow in power, you will master a variety of magical abilities and acquire powerful weapons, becoming an unstoppable force against the darkness.
The fate of the realm rests in your hands. Will you rise to the challenge and become a legend, or will you succumb to the forces of evil?
Embrace your destiny and become the hero the world needs!
Action-packed gameplay: Battle against hordes of enemies, using your magical powers and weapons to defeat them all.
Explore a vast and mysterious world: Uncover hidden secrets, solve puzzles, and discover new areas as you progress through the game.
Upgrade your character: Level up your skills, acquire powerful weapons and armor, and become the ultimate hero.
A captivating story: Unravel the mystery of your past and discover the truth about the Evil Lord.
Easy to learn, difficult to master: The intuitive controls make it easy to pick up and play, but the challenging gameplay will keep you coming back for more.
Are you ready to become a legend? Download the game today and start your adventure!

bluejetty:00119407:ios.description:
Scopri, nella nuova Nexi Pay, come le tue carte di pagamento si arricchiscono con funzionalità digitali esclusive.
Con Nexi Pay gestire le carte è semplice e acquistare diventa veloce e sicuro anche per piccoli importi, grazie a soluzioni come Apple Pay.
MONITORA LE SPESE
• Utilizza la nuova sezione “Spese” per consultare i movimenti, l'estratto conto e rateizzazioni
• Ricerca i movimenti e filtra le tue spese per categoria e importo
• Ricevi tutte le notifiche di sicurezza (giornaliere, settimanali e mensili)
GESTISCI LE TUE CARTE
• Scopri in Homepage la nuova sezione “Avvisi di sicurezza” per tenere tutte le spese sotto controllo
• Imposta i limiti di utilizzo a seconda delle tue esigenze
• Blocca la tua carta o mettila in pausa per 48h
PAGA TUTTI I TUOI ACQUISTI
• Acquista con Apple Pay e il tuo cellulare in tutti i punti vendita abilitati
• Ricarica le carte prepagate Nexi e i cellulari tuoi e dei tuoi cari 
• Paga il bollo dei tuoi veicoli e gli avvisi PagoPA 
• Abilita la tua carta al servizio Click to Pay per pagare presso gli esercenti abilitati
RATEIZZA I PAGAMENTI
• Scopri come è facile rateizzare le tue spese con Easy Shopping
• Decidi tu in quante rate pagare le tue spese
PREMIA I TUOI ACQUISTI
• 100 € al mese di sconti con ioSPECIALE
• Maggior protezione con ioPROTETTO
• Prodotti esclusivi con iosi PLUS COLLECTION
• Esperienze uniche con iosi PLUS EMOTION
• Viaggi a condizioni esclusive con iosi PLUS TRAVEL
GODITI I SERVIZI ESCLUSIVI DEDICATI A TE
• Monitora quanta CO₂ generi con le tue spese 
• Riduci il tuo impatto ambientale e fai una donazione 
• Scopri tutti i servizi Premium 
Nexi Pay è riservata ai clienti in possesso di una carta emessa da Nexi o da una Banca Partner. I servizi disponibili possono variare a seconda della tipologia di carta. L’applicazione richiede iOS 13 o versioni successive; per sfruttare tutte le funzionalità di Nexi Pay, come l’accesso con Touch ID o Face ID, aggiorna il sistema operativo del tuo cellulare all’ultima versione disponibile.
Per proteggere i tuoi dati personali ed evitare rischi di compromissione del tuo profilo, Nexi non consente a telefoni con impostazioni di fabbrica modificate o sui quali sono state installate App che permettono di elevare i privilegi utente ad amministratore di accedere a Nexi Pay.
ACCESSIBILITÀ
Noi del gruppo Nexi lavoriamo costantemente per rendere le comunicazioni e i contenuti online accessibili a ogni utente.
Il nostro impegno a migliorare questo sito e tutti i nostri canali digitali, secondo le linee guida e le pratiche principali di accessibilità, è continuativo e rende disponibili i nostri servizi al maggior numero possibile di utenti.
Grazie ad un rigoroso processo di analisi e assessment, in conformità con le linee guida WCAG 2.1 del World Wide Web Consortium (W3C), abbiamo reso i nostri prodotti digitali accessibili a tutta la nostra clientela.
Si tratta di un lungo percorso, che ci impegna quotidianamente, volto a individuare eventuali problematiche tecniche e di usabilità.
Per questo motivo non siamo esenti da errori e alcune sezioni di questo sito e di altri nostri canali potrebbero essere in fase di aggiornamento. Se dovessi riscontrare qualsiasi tipo di problematica, durante l’utilizzo dei nostri siti web e applicazioni mobile, ti invitiamo a inviarci le tue segnalazioni, scrivendo a accessibility@nexigroup.com.
LA NOSTRA MISSIONE
Vogliamo far sì che tutta la nostra offerta digitale sia conforme ai requisiti di accessibilità richiesti dall’appendice A della norma UNI CEI EN 301549 così da ridurre qualsiasi tipo di diseguaglianza nella fruizione dei nostri servizi e prodotti digitali da parte della nostra clientela.
SEGNALAZIONI
Per eventuali segnalazioni scrivi a accessibility@nexigroup.com.
Dichiarazione di Accessibilità: per visualizzare la dichiarazione, copia e incolla questo link www.nexi.it/content/dam/nexinew/download/accessibilita/dichiarazione_accessibilita.pdf in una pagina web.

bluejetty:00134700:ios.description:
Whether you’re out adventuring in your Ram vehicle, relaxing in the comfort of your home or just about anywhere else, the new Ram app lets you stay in touch and helps you stay in control of your vehicle like never before. Need to contact your dealer? No problem, simply use the My Dealer feature to find your preferred dealership’s address, schedule service appointments, or call them directly with the touch of a button. Easily access your vehicle’s info—including the owner’s manual, service history, and more—with the My Garage and Digital Glovebox features. And stay up to date on open recalls using the Recall Alert so you’re always one step ahead. If your vehicle is equipped, you can remotely start or stop your vehicle+, lock or unlock the doors and activate the horn or exterior lights. You now have access to more services than ever, ranging from entertainment to available Navigation, safety and security and more, all combining to provide new levels of convenience and the peace of mind you deserve.
+You are responsible for using remote features in accordance with any laws, rules or ordinances in effect in your vehicle's location. You must have an active subscription to Ram Connect, SiriusXM Guardian™ or Uconnect Access in order to use remote services. See Terms of Service for service limitations.

bluejetty:00014009:ios.description:
Deltek Touch Time & Expense for Vision
Deltek, Inc.
Entering timesheets and expenses is never fun, but it’s now easier than ever with Deltek Touch Time & Expense for Vision. Touch T&E provides you anytime, anywhere access to timesheets and expense reports – saving you time and increasing accuracy and efficiency. Same great timekeeping and expense tracking features as in Deltek Vision, and ideal for users who travel or are away from the office.
Features:
- Enter time and expenses for your projects, labor codes, and labor and expense categories 
- Approve timesheets and expense reports
- Email employees that have not submitted timesheets or need to change timesheets
- Take pictures of receipts and upload them directly to expense reports
- Quickly access favorite or recent projects allowing efficient entry
- Validate timesheet entries against project budgets and expected hours
- Track units
- Easily and securely access the app using a 4-digit pin
To use the app:
- A Deltek Vision user license is required.
- Some features will be unavailable if you are not on the most recent version of Vision.
- A server-side component must be installed by your administrator and your administrator must provide you with your organization’s unique Touch URL. Contact your IT department to ensure this component is in place and up-to-date prior to using this mobile app.
- For more details on system requirements and known issues, please see KB article #71390 on Deltek’s customer care web site.

bluejetty:00145909:ios.description:
Cheongyeon, for every moment you need support in daily life
From cleaning to care, your all-in-one life-care platform
 ▶Cleaning Standards You Can Trust – CleaningLab
Premium cleaning services tailored to your lifestyle
* All managers complete a 5-step training program to deliver systematic and reliable service.
* Cleaning is performed based on 8.8 million accumulated home-cleaning cases and a fully standardized cleaning manual.
* Choose the service that fits your life: one-time cleaning, regular cleaning, studio/one-room cleaning, bathroom-focused cleaning, and more.
* You can also gift a cleaning service to someone special.
* From home cleaning to moving-in/out cleaning, air-conditioner cleaning, washing machine cleaning, and office cleaning—CleaningLab has you covered.
▶ Cheongyeon Care – Trusted Support for Your Parents
Warm, reliable care services for elderly parents living alone
* Care managers visit your parents to check meals, well-being, and overall daily condition.
* Start with ease—our care service is available from as little as 2 hours.
* After each visit, you can review detailed updates through the Care Note, giving you full peace of mind.
▶ Professional Cleaning by Certified Experts
Perfect for moving, relocating, or deep-clean moments
* For moving-in/out cleaning, choose from secure reservations, price comparison options, and room-specific estimates tailored to your home layout.
* Air-conditioner and washing machine cleaning are both performed by certified specialists who disassemble the unit and deep-clean the interior for safe, hygienic, and reliable results.
▶ Thorough and Transparent Office Cleaning
Smart cleaning solutions for business environments
* No vague on-site estimates—check exact pricing directly in the app.
* Choose the plan that fits your needs: 1-hour cleaning, one-time cleaning, or scheduled regular cleaning.
▶ PlusShop – Your Home Lifestyle Store
Everything your home needs, curated with care
* Discover essential household products at reasonable prices.
* Earn Shop Mileage automatically when you use our home-cleaning services.
■ App Permissions & Purpose (Optional)
* Camera / Photos (Optional): Attach photos when writing reviews or contacting support
* Microphone (Optional): Attach videos when contacting support
* App Tracking (Optional): Use of marketing identifiers
* Notifications (Optional): Receive updates on matching progress and service alerts
※ You can use the app without granting optional permissions.
▶ Official Channels
* Website: https://chyeon.com
* Customer Support: Cheongyeon App > More > Contact Us
* (Mon–Sat 08:00–18:00, closed on Sundays and public holidays)
* Address:
* LIFECARE Co., Ltd.
* C-1002, Pangyo Digital Center,
* 242 Pangyo-ro, Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi-do, Korea

bluejetty:00062481:ios.description:
Enjoy discovering the world with games and beautiful animations. Explore animals, cultures, geography, countries and much more.
“My First World Atlas” is the perfect app for curious little kids. With simple and narrated text, big pictures and amazing illustrations children will learn basic information about our world: the oceans, the continents, animals, monuments, people...
This atlas is also packed with lot of educational games to play with no rules or stress. 
FEATURES 
• Learn basic information about our world.
• Play with hundreds of mini games.
• Fully narrated. Perfect for non-readers and kids who are starting to read.
• Content for kids aged 3 and up. Games for all the family. Hours of fun. 
• No ads.
WHY “MY FIRST WORLD ATLAS”?
“My First World Atlas” is an easy-to-use app that keeps kids engaged in activities about our world. Download it if you want to:
• Instill a love of Planet Earth in your children.
• Play educational games and activities.
• Enjoy quiet time on road trips.
Planning a trip? "My First World Atlas" is a great tool to take along with you on long car, airplane, bus, and train rides. Your kids can learn about where they’re traveling!
Children love playing and learning about the world through games, even when they’re at home. My First World Atlas contains valuable information about US states, animals of the world, different cultures from all over the planet, and much more!
It contains educational games like hidden objects, puzzles, coloring, dress up, geography puzzle maps, etc.
ABOUT LEARNY LAND
At Learny Land, we love to play, and we believe that games must form part of the educational and growth stage of all children; because to play is to discover, explore, learn and have fun. Our educational games help children learn about the world around them and are designed with love. They are easy to use, beautiful and safe. Because boys and girls have always played to have fun and learn, the games we make - like the toys that last a lifetime - can be seen, played and heard.
At Learny Land we take advantage of the most innovative technologies and the most modern devices to take the experience of learning and playing a step further. We create toys that could not have existed when we were young.
Read more about us at www.learnyland.com.
Privacy Policy
We take Privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at www.learnyland.com.
Contact us
We'd love to know your opinion and your suggestions. Please, write to support@learnyland.com.

A huge number of cars in the world, ranging from rare city cars to powerful sports cars! A large number of configurations! Frequent updates replenish the game's vehicle fleet, which becomes larger and larger over time! Choose from 4x4 SUVs, modern sports cars, retro classics or powerful muscle cars. The choice is yours!

bluejetty:00144488:ios.description:
«Magnetology» is an application which permits one to watch the forecast of geomagnetic storms and the state of Earth´s geomagnetic field.
WHY IS IT SO IMPORTANT?
Geomagnetic storms adversely affect the health of humans.
They can cause aches, dizziness, rapid heart rate, and abnormal blood pressure.
People with abnormal conditions of the blood and of the cardiovascular and autonomic nervous systems are particularly susceptible to the influence of geomagnetic storms.
The degree of magnetic storms’ influence on a particular person depends on many factors, including health status, stress, physical and emotional fatigue, natural predisposition.
Not only can geomagnetic storms have a negative impact on humans, but also on communications, navigation, and power.
By taking into account the forecast of geomagnetic storms, you can plan difficult decisions, avoid high physical stress, and protect yourself from negative consequences.
Our application will help you with this.
ABOUT THE NATURE OF THE GEOMAGNETIC STORMS
The Earth's geomagnetic field changes occur under the influence of the Sun. The intensity of the impact is not constant and depends on the ongoing processes on the solar surface.
The strength of geomatic field disturbances is characterized by the value of Kp index. The Kp index can be assigned values from 0 to 9, where 0 is the absence of disturbances and 9 represents extremely strong perturbations of the earth´s geomagnetic field.
Disturbances with a Kp index of 5 and above are called storms.
The number of geomagnetic storms per year can reach 50!
ACKNOWLEDGMENTS
- David Howell for English localization;
- Johan Milani for French localization.
* The app uses data of National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.

Camera Translator

bluejetty:00082109:ios.name: TECHNOCORE
bluejetty:00082109:ios.summary:
TECHNOCORE is a high-stakes drone infiltration game that lets you gather HEXes, decode them, then keep or trade them! 
Look, if people are going to leave their valuables lying around the place, they can’t blame you for picking them up. Yo
bluejetty:00082109:ios.description:
TECHNOCORE is a high-stakes drone infiltration game that lets you gather HEXes, decode them, then keep or trade them! 
Look, if people are going to leave their valuables lying around the place, they can’t blame you for picking them up. You’re doing your environmental duty in tidying up! But they probably can blame you for hacking their security drone in order to get said scattered shinies... 
SNEAK PAST SECURITY 
TECHNOCORE takes place at a sprawling desalination plant loaded up with security turrets. Luckily for you, one of their drones is malfunctioning, making it an easy target to hack! 
With it, you’ll be scouting out valuable HEX boxes; HEXes that can be decoded to reveal amazing item parts*. 
WORK ON YOUR FIXER-UPPER 
You’ll start off with a trusty level-one drone to zip around in, but to pull off those super-daring dives for loot, you’re going to need a better model. 
When you complete a level, you’ll earn experience points and level up, which grants you various rewards, such as HEX boxes. You’ll also earn RIP; this is used to buy upgrades for your drone. Tougher body, more energy — turn your drone into a security turret’s worst nightmare. 
SALTY SENTRIES 
Speaking of security turrets, brace yourself for a warm welcome. Super warm. No, really. It can’t get much warmer than shooting your drone until it explodes into a ball of flames, right? 
Love you too, alarmingly aggressive turrets. 
Sadly, your drone doesn’t come equipped with a gun to shoot back, so you’re going to have to rely on your dexterity, speed, and cunning to fly under the radar. Good luck with that! 
CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD 
Want to show off your drone-flying skills? Earn points and see how you rank against other players on our leaderboard! The more you play, the more you level up, and the more points you earn. 
Feeling chaotic? Once you have maxed out your drone’s upgrades, you can opt to tear it back down to the starting level again in exchange for a healthy dose of points. This allows you to keep on scouring for loot and earning level-up rewards! 
REFRESHED REWARDS 
Searched high, low, and everywhere in between for swag to steal? Fear not! We’ll be refreshing and updating the loot on offer from time to time, so keep checking back to stay on top of the game. 
(*HEX boxes and GUN tokens earned in TECHNOCORE are stored on the GUNZ Companion App. Log in to the GUNZ Companion App with the same sign-in details used in TECHNOCORE to access your GUN tokens, the GUNZ marketplace, and decode your HEX boxes.) 
FEATURES 
- Outstanding Unreal Engine 5 visuals on mobile 
- Engaging upgrade system — stay on top of the challenge by improving your drone 
- Video tutorials presented by Max, based on and voiced by Altered Carbon author Richard Morgan 
- Pilot a drone, find loot, and survive! 
- Points system and leaderboard — compete with hackers around the world 
- NFT rewards mean what you find is yours to keep or trade!

bluejetty:00166993:ios.description:
You don’t need any special medical equipment to get your pulse and to keep track of your health state, just your phone camera! Most accurate, fast and easy to use heart rate app.
APPLIED METHOD:
Our app is based on photoplethysmography (PPG), non-invasive optical technique. Each heart beat transmits the amount of blood to the tissues in your fingers, while the blood absorbs your camera’s light, it illuminates the skin and captures microvascular blood volume changes such as ebb and flow. That allows you to measure the pulse easily, accurately and efficiently.
HOW TO USE:
Cover the camera lens and flashlight with your fingertip completely. Do not press too intensively in order to avoid reducing blood flow. Hold your phone steady and keep still. Make sure your fingers are not cold. Press the button and get your results.
TRACK YOUR MEASUREMENTS:
Get visual display of the data at the given period of time. Personal dashboard with your measurement history.
HEALTH KIT INTEGRATION:
Support for sharing heart rate results with Apple Health App.
REMINDER:
Receive notifications in order to have your finger on the pulse. Staying healthy and fit is a systematic process.
IMPROVE YOUR PERFORMANCE:
Track your workout effectiveness to get in shape, improve your endurance and general wellness.
NEVER MISS A BEAT!
SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
Yearly subscription with 3-day free trial period will give you full access to 
* Unlimited measurements per day, 
* Monthly statistics,
* Health insights, 
* No ads.
Disclaimer: App measurements are just recommendations and can’t be used for diagnostics or medical purpose. Always seek a doctor's advice before making any medical decisions.
Please note that the app doesn't measure blood pressure, oxygen levels and body temperature, you can only record and keep measurement indexs! You need a thermometer, a tonometer and a pulse oximeter to measure values. Save your measurements in "Heart Rate".
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to iTunes Account Settings. For more information please visit the link https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. Unused portion of a free-trial period will be forfeited when a user decides to subscribe.
Privacy Policy: https://www.cogvance.io/privacy-policy/
Terms: https://www.cogvance.io/terms/

bluejetty:00070674:ios.description:
COLLECT YOUR SOULS!
Collect beautiful Souls and enjoy a stunning visual RPG!
【 FEATURES 】
■ SUMMON UNIQUE SOULS
Summon myriads of beautifully crafted Souls from 6 different factions, each with their own exclusive skills and battle animations, and form your optimum Soul squad.
■ STRATEGIZE EPIC BATTLES 
Master faction advantages, harness party buffs, and explore formations to show off your ultimate skills in fierce battles.
■ STUNNING ANIME RPG
Enjoy a stunning Visual RPG with graphics, animation, and artwork inspired by an eclectic array of anime while tuning in to beautiful audio designed to enrich your gameplay.
■ CREATE YOUR WORLD 
Create and explore your own flavorful town with a variety of structures and decor, where you can roam free and interact with your Souls, take on missions day and night, or just slay the monsters lurking around the corner.
■ CHOOSE YOUR FATE
Interact with colorful Souls bursting with personality, but choose your answers wisely as they decide the fate of your relationship.
■ COLLECT AND LEVEL-UP
Collect unique Souls that you can level up and interact with to unlock exclusive stories.
■ RICH GAMEPLAY
Climb the ranks of the Arena leaderboard, face off against epic bosses with your guild mates, explore labyrinths, and go on dungeon runs for a complete PvE and PvP experience.
■ COMPELLING STORYLINE
A powerful narrative unfolds where you as the Savior are summoned across the multiverse to protect a parallel world from imminent danger.
■ AUTO BATTLES WITH IDLE MECHANICS
Hassle-free, effortless resource collection while you're idle, to earn as you play... or sleep!
 =============================
■ This game will be available in English, Korean, and Chinese (Traditional) only.

- Support (TW): https://kakaogames.oqupie.com/portals/2160/inquiry 
- Support (SEA): https://kakaogames.oqupie.com/portals/2152/inquiry
■ Minimum Specs ■ 
- iOS 11 or above / iPhone 8 or above

bluejetty:00030732:ios.description:
Discover your daily Instagram account analytics, with this app - followers and unfollowers you can find out which posts bring the most benefit to you and which posts bring more followers and likes.
Track the growth or unfollows of subscribers every day and know the certain number for every day.
You can understand who is not subscribed to your account, but watches your posts and puts likes and comments.
Find out how many users are not following back to your account.
Keep tracking of your profile activity - “engagement level” in order to understand how many posts per day, week, or month you need to grow as an influencer, blogger and etc.
This is the ultimate app for managing your Instagram followers and understanding your performance on the platform. With this app, you can easily track who is not following you back on Instagram and unfollow them with just a tap. Additionally, you can see who likes your posts, and get detailed analytics about your followers and your account's performance. Your insta follow tracker for every day!
Key features inside:
Unfollow for Instagram: Easily find and unfollow anyone who is not following you back on Instagram.
Instagram Followers Tracker: Keep track of your followers and see who unfollowed you with detailed reports.
Reports for Followers and graphs: Get detailed reports on your followers, including who is following you back and who is not.
Mass Unfollow Detecting: Compare the number of followers with the day before at once with the mass unfollow detecting feature.
Lost Followers: See who unfollowed you and when.
Followers Pro for Instagram: Get access to advanced features such as who blocked you on Instagram and who follows you back.
Instagram Follow Back: Easily follow back accounts that are following you.
Likes Tracker: See who likes your posts and when.
Disclaimer: Unfollowers & Followers Report is not affiliated with Instagram or any third parties we aren’t acquiring followers. This app is only about analytics.

bluejetty:00177435:ios.name: Bibino Baby Monitor: Nanny Cam
bluejetty:00177435:ios.summary: Bibino is the ultimate baby monitoring app for modern moms, dads, and caregivers, transforming two devices - smartphones, tablets, or computers - into a comprehensive baby monitoring system. Keep a watchful eye on your baby with video and a
bluejetty:00177435:ios.description:
Bibino is the ultimate baby monitoring app for modern moms, dads, and caregivers, transforming two devices - smartphones, tablets, or computers - into a comprehensive baby monitoring system. Keep a watchful eye on your baby with video and audio capabilities, and ensure their comfort by soothing them with your voice or calming lullabies. With the flexibility of WiFi and mobile data, Bibino offers you unlimited reach, wherever you may be.
Key Features of Bibino Baby Monitor App
● Seamless Device Integration: Transform two devices into a unified baby nanny cam
● Audio-Visual Monitoring: Watch and listen to your baby's every sound and movement
● Motion Detection: Assess your baby's state of calmness
● Unlimited Reach: Monitor your baby with WiFi and cellular data
● Remote Comfort: Soothe your baby from afar with your voice
● Customizable Sensitivity: Adjust the microphone sensitivity on the baby's device to your preference
● Real-Time Notifications: Stay informed about your baby's status
● Multi-Parent Connection: Link multiple parent devices to one Baby Station
● Enhanced Visibility: Utilize the Night Light feature for better monitoring in low light conditions
● Review Past Monitorings: Access and replay previously recorded sounds and videos
To unlock some of these features, you may need to purchase Bibino Premium, which offers a free trial.
WHAT MAKES BIBINO THE #1 BABY MONITOR?
Hear & watch over your baby
With video and audio monitoring, you can hear your baby remotely and see everything that's been going on in the baby's room. With Bibino, you always have your baby under surveillance.
Video recording
Capture and keep precious moments of your baby during monitoring. Take photos and record short videos of your baby when monitoring to keep all memories.
Unlimited reach with WiFi and mobile data
With Bibino nanny cam, you are not limited by the distance. The app works over WiFi and mobile data, which makes Bibino perfect when traveling with the baby, as each device can be connected to a different network.
Simple to set up
All you need are two devices - phones, tablets, or computers, and Bibino app. Place one device in the baby's room to monitor your little one and keep the second device with you.
Traveling with the baby
Bibino is a must-have for any parents when traveling with their babies. With Bibino, you don't need to carry extra hardware devices to monitor your baby. Bibino baby monitor is always one tap away, and with WiFi and mobile data, the app works where other baby monitors fail.
Enhance audio with Every Noise
When you're not sure what the sound you just heard was, Bibino can temporarily sensitize the audio so you can hear everything clearly.
Soothe your baby remotely
When your baby starts to wake up, you can soothe your little one back to sleep remotely with Bibino app through two-way video and audio.
Play your little one a lullaby
Choose from a variety of lullabies and soothing sounds (white noise, household sounds, and more) to lull your baby to sleep. Project a soothing image on the baby's device and control the volume and time of the lullabies remotely.
History from past monitorings
Bibino records noises, videos, or photos from each monitoring. You can also replay recorded sounds from the monitoring.
Connect multiple parents' devices
With Bibino, you can monitor one Baby Station from multiple Parent Stations. This way, both parents can watch over their baby at the same time.
Upcycle your older phone or tablet
Do you have an older device lying around? Reuse your older phone or tablet as the Baby Station and give it a new meaning. No need to purchase expensive hardware baby monitors when you can recycle and reuse devices you already have. By upcycling your older devices, you have a reliable baby monitor at your fingertips.
We value your opinion on Bibino app. Let us know how we can improve the app at support@tappytaps.com.

bluejetty:00014966:ios.description:
Explore, Learn, and Engage — Anywhere in the World
Agents of Discovery is a free, AI-powered mobile platform that turns any location into an immersive augmented reality (AR) adventure. Whether you’re a park visitor, museum guest, corporate training enthusiast, sports fan, airport traveller, or student — if you’re somewhere, there’s something to discover.
Players become secret Agents, completing real-world Missions packed with interactive Challenges, AR games, and AI-guided experiences. 
No WiFi needed once downloaded.
Built for Every Audience
• Parks, Museums & Libraries — Bring exhibits and outdoor spaces to life
• Sports Teams & Stadiums — Fan engagement and behind-the-scenes exploration
• Airports & Transit Hubs — Turn wait time into discovery time
• Businesses & Corporate Training — Location-based learning for onboarding, safety, and team engagement
• Schools & Education Programs — Curriculum-linked Missions that move learning outdoors
• Conservation & Community — Partner with causes that matter
What’s a Mission?
A Mission combines a location map, an AI-powered interactive avatar, and a series of Challenges — activities that might ask you to match sounds or images, sort AR objects, solve puzzles, or answer quiz-style questions. Complete all Challenges to unlock your reward.
Why People Love It
• Encourages movement, curiosity, and real-world exploration
• Scales from individual play to large group experiences
• Available in English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Korean, and Mandarin, with many more languages coming online
• Missions across the U.S., Canada, Australia, and New Zealand — plus at-home options
For Organizations: Custom Missions can be created for your venue, brand, or program — making Agents of Discovery a powerful tool for training, visitor engagement, and community connection.
Download now and start your first Mission. The adventure is wherever you are.

bluejetty:00066209:ios.summary:
PLUG IN. BREAK THE RULES.
Why mine for items when you can add them? Plug Toolbox lets you edit your Minecraft Bedrock worlds on iPhone and iPad. Choose a world, make your changes, review them together, then apply them.
ITEMS AND ENCHANTME
bluejetty:00066209:ios.description:
PLUG IN. BREAK THE RULES.
Why mine for items when you can add them? Plug Toolbox lets you edit your Minecraft Bedrock worlds on iPhone and iPad. Choose a world, make your changes, review them together, then apply them.
ITEMS AND ENCHANTMENTS
• Add items and blocks from the supported catalogue to armour, offhand, hotbar, inventory and Ender Chest slots.
• Add compatible enchantments individually or in bulk. Choose normal levels, Safe Max or Full Max.
• Create usable item stacks with required item data filled in automatically.
PLAYER AND WORLD
• Change health, experience, abilities, movement, flight and position.
• Edit game mode, difficulty, spawn, time, weather, multiplayer rules and other world settings.
NBT EDITING
Edit world, player and item NBT directly. Browse typed values, add suggested fields or create custom tags. Plug Toolbox preserves unknown data that you do not edit, which helps when Minecraft adds new fields.
REVIEW AND BACKUPS
Stage changes to several parts of a world in one session. Review the previous and proposed values before you apply them. Plug Toolbox creates an automatic backup before supported writes and verifies the result afterward. You can also duplicate a world or keep a separate copy in Plug Vault.
If the world is from a newer Minecraft version, the app shows a compatibility warning and leaves editing available. Make a copy first if the world matters to you.
To work on a Minecraft world, connect its worlds folder once. Close Minecraft before applying changes, then open it again.
Minecraft is required and sold separately.
NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.

bluejetty:00071099:ios.summary: Attention, attention! Life with Masha and the Bear has become even more fun, as something incredible has happened at Bear's house – the long-awaited update is here! New locations, more games, and a whole bunch of favorite toys! No time to b
bluejetty:00071099:ios.description:
Attention, attention! Life with Masha and the Bear has become even more fun, as something incredible has happened at Bear's house – the long-awaited update is here! New locations, more games, and a whole bunch of favorite toys! No time to be bored!
Ready to spend the day with your favorite friends? Then let’s go!
Morning
Ding-ding! It’s morning, time to get up. A day of care, chores, and adventures awaits! But first, let’s brush our teeth and take a shower! Fizzy bath bombs, bubbles galore, and new inflatable rings in the shapes of a duck, crab, and even a crocodile. And don’t forget the fragrant soap! Help Masha develop healthy habits!
Grr-growl! Masha’s tummy is rumbling. Prepare a tasty, healthy breakfast for her friends! Sandwich, pie, pizza, or salad – so many new recipes to choose from! Masha and her friends will love it!
Goodbye pajamas! It’s time to dress up – open the closet and pick beautiful outfits for Masha and the Bear!
Daytime
Now, it’s time to tackle important activities:
- Fly a plane! New!
- Paint pictures! New!
- Solve puzzles! New!
- Plant vegetables and fruits! New!
- Play the harmonica!
- Launch a rocket into space!
- Play tennis!
- Ride a bike!
- Go fishing!
- Go roller-skating!
It’s lunchtime! A new balanced menu is waiting in the fridge! Choose tasty new dishes and feed Masha and the Bear.
After that, let’s dive into:
- Photo hunting – capture the best shots! New!
- Racing with the rooster – let’s hold a fun tournament! New!
- Cleaning and dishwashing – we need to keep the house tidy! New!
- Playing the electric guitar – let’s learn some chords!
- Target practice – let’s see who has the best aim!
- Playing ball – find out who’s the volleyball pro!
Evening
And now it’s evening! Ding-ding! Forest friends have come to visit with treats. Let’s welcome our guests properly – with a pie made from a new recipe and hot tea!
The day flew by so fast, with so many things done... Now, it’s time to brush teeth and go to bed! See you tomorrow in the game “Masha and the Bear: My Friends”!
For questions and suggestions:
Contact us: support@devgameou.com 
Our website: https://devgameou.com/

bluejetty:00187042:ios.description:
‘Work Log' spent on the job with this powerful, customizable & easy to use app. 
++Similar Apps
++ "P-Time RecV2" specialized for hourly wage calculation
※The record for 40 days is possible at first. 
　Meanwhile, there is no limit of the function.
※In case of continuous use, please charge.
-- Features 
1. easy to use interface. Simple, single touch “Clock in”,”Clock Out" button for on-the-go time tracking. 
"Pause/Resume" button for lunchtime or your private time are deducted. 
2. Records all of time spent and provides a running total for each log 
3. choose to display time in hours/minutes or decimal format 
4. Unlimited customizable "Profile"s. 
‘Work Log' provides a number of internal settings that let you tune profiling to your needs. 
5. The "Profile"s according to worker's working form 
6. Each working form 
[monthly salary(standard)] - single shiftwork;fixed time(clock in/out) 
[shift work] - multi shiftwork;the time(clock in/out) that was fixed every shift;six shift available 
[annual salary] - overtime working is not calculated(but the time of midnight working is calculated) 
[flextime] 
[part-time] 
7. and the payroll calculation method which is selectable.(The profile of a part time can choose only the hourly-wage system.) 
8. Although the display is monthly, time, aggregate salary, you can specify a 1 week / 2 weeks /4 weeks / half month / 1 month
9. Semi-automatic punching(clock in;When the restrictive profile is chosen ) 
10. Monthly time sheet 
Display summary tables are reported on a monthly basis
Aggregate result of the time and payroll, there are 5 period (1,2,4 weeks, half-month, 4weeks,1 month)
11.Annual time sheet that can compare the results is prepared for last year 
12.Email your time sheet reports in either plain text or comma delimited (CSV) format for easy import to Excel or Numbers 
13.Includes Dropbox backup/restore

bluejetty:00033357:ios.description:
Looking for an app to track your Mood, anxiety, or emotional state? Look no further than Mood Bubble! Easily monitor your emotions and mental health throughout the day, gaining insights into your well-being. Whether you're feeling ecstatic, stressed, or anxious, Mood Bubble makes it simple to record and analyze your moods with just a few taps.
Key Features:
• Track Your Mood: Log your emotions and anxiety levels multiple times a day with a simple interface. Whether you're happy, sad, anxious, or somewhere in between, Mood Bubble captures your mood accurately—perfect for maintaining a mood journal or bipolar mood tracker.
• Mood Bubble with Friends: Stay connected with loved ones by sharing your mood updates on the Daily Mood Page. See how others are feeling and offer support or encouragement with just a few taps, enhancing your emotional awareness.
• Insightful Analytics: Gain insights into your emotional patterns, anxiety triggers, and mental health trends with Mood Bubble's analytics. Identify triggers, recognize patterns, and take steps toward improving your well-being—like a mental health journal that’s always with you.
• Customizable Reminders: Never forget to check in on your emotions or anxiety with reminders that prompt you to log your state at regular intervals, making it easy to maintain a consistent emotion tracker.
• Privacy First: Your privacy is our top priority. Mood Bubble ensures your mood data, whether anxiety tracker entries or mood logs, is secure and confidential, with customizable sharing settings to suit your comfort level.
Whether you're looking to understand your emotions, manage anxiety, or share moments of joy, Mood Bubble is the perfect companion for emotional awareness and meaningful connections. Download now and start your journey toward a happier, healthier you!
Mood Bubble is more than a mood tracker—it's an all-in-one solution for improving your mental well-being. Whether you're managing anxiety, tracking emotions, or keeping a mental health journal, Mood Bubble provides the tools to stay on top of your emotional health. Designed for users managing mood swings, anxiety, or bipolar disorder, Mood Bubble is the perfect bipolar mood tracker.
Looking for an anxiety tracker? Mood Bubble lets you track anxiety levels and gain insights into triggers. Our emotion tracker helps you understand how emotions change throughout the day, giving you control over your mental health journey.
Whether you're tracking your mental health or supporting friends, Mood Bubble fosters emotional awareness, ideal for a daily mood journal or mental health journal.
Download Mood Bubble today to manage your mental health, emotions, and anxiety. It’s more than tracking moods—it's about improving your well-being.

bluejetty:00022396:ios.name: FRMS - Granular Synthesizer
bluejetty:00022396:ios.summary: FRMS blends Granular, FM, Additive, and Subtractive synthesis in a powerful, flexible layering system. Create lush, evolving soundscapes or gritty, glitchy textures by combining up to four synthesis layers. With a sleek, intuitive interface
bluejetty:00022396:ios.description:
FRMS blends Granular, FM, Additive, and Subtractive synthesis in a powerful, flexible layering system. Create lush, evolving soundscapes or gritty, glitchy textures by combining up to four synthesis layers. With a sleek, intuitive interface, FRMS turns basic sounds into immersive audio experiences—from dense ambient drones to mechanical soundscapes.
Choose from FRMS’s curated sample library, import your own sounds, or capture live audio for instant granulation. Shape unique sounds with layered synthesis, independent envelopes, modulation, and effects.
Key Features:
- 4 Synthesis Engines, 4 Layers Per Voice – Mix Granular, FM, Additive, and Subtractive synthesis.
- FM Modes & Operator Stacking – Create rich, complex tones with 8 FM modes.
- Real-Time Granulation – Process samples or live audio with up to 640 grains.
- Deep Modulation & Envelope Control – Modulation matrix per layer, plus 2 EGs and filters per layer.
- Advanced FX & Polyphony – 4 voices polyphony, arpeggiator, delay, and reverb.
- High-Quality Sample Library & MPE Compatibility – Access FRMS’s expansive sound library and integrate with MIDI Polyphonic Expression and Ableton Link.
Unlock endless sonic possibilities with FRMS, perfect for both beginners and advanced sound designers.
"Imaginando super fan over here ..own everything they make. FRMS is no exception, as it’s incredibly powerful, versatile, and surprisingly intuitive. It’s a joy to work with, and the sound possibilities are endless."
"I expected a lot from this app given the pedigree of the developer, but wow, this exceeded all my expectations. The depth of the granular synthesis engine combined with FM is truly amazing. A must-have for any sound designer."
"This is a great app for anyone serious about granular synthesis. The interface is clean and easy to use, and the sound quality is top-notch. I find myself getting lost for hours exploring new sounds."
"This synth is an interesting and great evolution in the world of granular. It pushes the boundaries of what you can do with layers and modulation. The presets are inspiring, but the real magic comes when you start creating your own."
"FRMS has officially become my favorite synth app. The way it combines granular synthesis and FM is just genius. You can get subtle textures or full-blown sonic mayhem. Highly recommended!"
"Every time I use FRMS, I feel like I’m discovering new dimensions of sound. The modulation options are vast, and the way you can shape tones makes it a designer’s dream. This app has changed my approach to sound design."
"There’s something magical about the way FRMS handles sound. It’s intuitive yet deep, and I’ve created some of my best work using this app. Kudos to the developers for making such a high-quality product."
"FRMS is absolutely brilliant. The interface is smooth, and the ability to layer sounds and modulate them takes granular synthesis to another level. I’ve been recommending it to everyone I know."
"This app is an endless source of inspiration. Whether I’m working on cinematic soundscapes or glitchy textures, FRMS has everything I need. The layers and effects are phenomenal."
"If you love creating ambient music, this app is for you. The ability to tweak and layer samples into lush textures is incredible. It’s become an essential part of my workflow."
"The design of FRMS is superb. It’s both visually pleasing and incredibly functional. Every detail has been thought through, and the sound engine delivers in every way."
"Hands down, the best granular synth I’ve used. The presets are great, but what sets it apart is how intuitive it is to create your own unique sounds."

bluejetty:00089425:ios.description:
- No tracking, measuring, or weighing. No guilt, shame, or failure. 
- Achieve the natural, sustainable, healthy lifestyle you've always wanted. 
- Learn the Iterative Mindset Method to become unstoppable!
- Choose habits that fit you, and practice them until they become your natural way of life. 
Fresh Tri is a mindset and habit-building app that helps you eat healthy, manage stress, move more and think positively using brain science.
Remove the frustration, shame, and failure of traditional tactics. Current weight loss and habit tracking apps are designed for fast results, not lasting results. With Fresh Tri, you'll gradually learn and use the Iterative Mindset Method™ — a science-based, practice-and-iteration approach that keeps you going, no matter the obstacle.
Iteration just means that you figure out what works for you right now, by adjusting and tweaking your way toward the lifestyle you love and can easily maintain.
How To Use The Fresh Tri App 
Follow 4 Easy Steps to achieve the sustainable, healthy lifestyle you've always wanted. 
(1) Create your Tri, a simple habit to practice.
 Then, you will:
(2) Check-In daily. If things are going well, say so! And if not, that's totally OK. 
Why: When you Check-In, you'll get tips and ideas for practicing your habit or changing it up. Either way, you're iterating your way to success! Fresh Tri believes that relapse and setbacks are a normal and necessary part of a lasting habit-building process.
(3) Share with the community! Set your daily intention and gratitude within the Fresh “Tri(be)” feed. 
 Why: Intentions encourage self-honesty and accountability, while gratitude has been scientifically proven to improve emotional and physical health. By sharing with others (anonymously, if you wish), you can inspire — and be inspired by — others in the community.
(4) Train your mindset. Visit the Train section to build your new and more powerful Iterative Mindset!
Why: Learn how to apply the Iterative Mindset to your daily practice with nationally recognized health and wellness trainers, including MDs, PhDs, RDNs, and Clinical Health Coaches. Explore over 720 Mindset training sessions developed to power your wellness journey.

bluejetty:00085729:ios.description:
We know your pain. Most IPTV player apps out there aren't great. You deserve a better IPTV experience. This app is not only superior, it is also free.
Getting started is easy:
1. Add your IPTV playlist - these are usually M3U files
2. Explore and search in your channels
3. Start watching a live stream with one tap!
You can watch anywhere, on your iPhone or iPad, go full screen, Picture-in-Picture to multi-task, or use AirPlay to watch on Apple TV or any AirPlay-enabled audio/video device. You can also download our tvOS app for a beautiful experience adapted to Apple TV.
== Add your playlists ====
• Import your IPTV playlist from a web URL, a local file, iCloud, or using your Xtream Codes credentials.
• Supports M3U and M3U8 formats
• Syncs your playlists, history, and favorites across your devices with iCloud (requires iOS 17 or later).
== Watch anywhere ====
• Supports streaming live TV channels, VoD (Video-on-Demand), Shows, etc.
• Supports AirPlay and Chromecast: Play and cast your content for a larger screen experience in the living room or with family and friends.
• Organize and browse your channels by channel category, playlist, region, and language.
== Make it yours ====
• Add channels to Favorites for quicker access.
• Instant access to your favorite and previously watched channels using Spotlight Search.
• Sort channels by most recently watched, alphabetically, and more.
• Select multiple channels to manage them easily in one go.
• Unlock the app using Face ID or Touch ID. (Option in Settings)
== Choose a superior app ====
• Works across different device forms, with excellent iPad experience, taking advantage of your screen real estate for immersive browsing and playback.
• App also available for your Apple TV and Mac.
This app is a media manager and player and does not come pre-loaded with any content. It is designed to help you enjoy your own content, better than what you may have tried already.
Notice: It is your responsibility to verify your content to make sure it is fair and legal.
This is a Chromecast-enabled app which lets stream to Chromecast products including Google Chromecast and TVs with Chromecast built-in.
