bluejetty:00179990:ios.description:
When the frame rate of a video matches the speed of a particular part, the effect is the same as using a strobe light. In the video, that part freezes.
Since the frame rate of a video can be adjusted, this effect can be used to determine the rotational speed of a part.
The smartphone must support slow-motion video recording (filming at a high frame rate). This is the case for all smartphones starting with iPhone 5S. The range is as follows:
• 0.5—240 Hz (30—14400 RPM), for all phones from iPhone 6 onward
• 0.5—120 Hz (30—7200 RPM), for iPhone 5S
THE HERTZ (Hz) VALUE IS MORE ACCURATE THAN THE REVOLUTIONS PER MINUTE (RPM) VALUE, SINCE REVOLUTIONS PER MINUTE ARE CALCULATED FROM HERTZ AND ROUNDING IS DONE.
To get a clear image, good lighting is important. The clarity of the image is controlled by the exposure of the video (exposure time and light sensitivity (ISO)). If the exposure time is reduced, the image will increase in clarity, but brightness will lower. To increase the brightness, you need to raise the camera's light sensitivity (ISO), but then the amount of noise increases. You also need to manually adjust the focus of the camera.
The app can record video. The video format depends on the selected format in the app settings. If your iPhone supports 4K video format (3840x2160), then you can record 4K video at the frame rate supported by your iPhone. Text with important information is added to the frames of the recorded video: the selected frame rate, exposure duration, ISO, time stamp, time difference between the current and previous frames (Tcurr. − Tprev.), the sequence number of the frame in the recorded video. If you want any other information to be added, then let me know. 
You can choose to add only part of this information, and you can choose a different text color. You also have the option of not adding any information. You can change the information that is added and the color of the text while recording a video. At high frame rates, frames that do not have time to be processed may be discarded. This does not affect subsequent frames and can be controlled using the time difference between the current frame and the previous frame (Tcurr. − Tprev.). Dropping frames affects the video frame rate displayed in the "Photos" app. But the time interval between frames that were taken one after another and were not discarded will correspond to the selected frame rate. Frames may be dropped even when shooting slow motion video using the "Camera" app. You can check this by looking at the frame rate for slow motion video in the "Photos" app.
Video containing the app's interface can be captured using the iOS "Screen Recording" function.
The app can take a photo with the measurement result, date, and time written on the photo. The exposure time and ISO settings will be saved in the photo's metadata. To take a photo that shows the app interface, tap the "Pause" button and take a screenshot.
It is possible to choose a video format that has the best quality, but has a significantly lower maximum frame rate. The difference between the formats is clearly visible only when using the digital zoom. Also, when using a format with better quality, the Rolling Shutter effect is stronger. Therefore, the best quality format can be used at speeds less than about 2000 rpm.
You can turn on hints for easier observation of changes in rotation speed. Hints show how to change the frame rate (decrease or increase) depending on the direction of rotation of the mark. The hints are selected manually, but then you do not need to remember this information. The hints are relevant for frequencies close to the rotation frequency. If the direction of rotation of the impeller is known, hints can be selected in advance. The arrow showing the direction of rotation of the impeller must correspond to the "+" button.
The video tachometer measures the rotational speed in exactly the same way a stroboscopic tachometer would.

PayMyPark makes parking hassles a thing of the past. No more driving around looking for a parking space, finding coins, or rushing back to your car. And no more tickets to display. 
Available for street parking and carparks managed by Wellington City Council, New Plymouth District Council, Tauranga City Council, Hamilton City Council, Hutt City Council, Timaru District Council, Dunedin City Council, Waitaki District Council, Gore District Council, Christchurch City Council and Nelson City Council.
Contact us at info@paymypark.com.

bluejetty:00151585:ios.summary:

This app gives you a snapshot of
bluejetty:00151585:ios.description:
***** Featured in iTunes "STAFF FAVORITES" section and also #1 Finance app for several weeks in 2009 ***** 
***** Featured on cover and chapter-5 of Wiley Publishing's book on Incredible iPhone Apps *****
This app gives you a snapshot of the US economy by providing the latest key economic indicators and tracking the history of these indicators across the past few months, years and decades.
The app includes around 45,000 economic indicators. The primary focus is on US economic indicators (including detailed data on all 50 states and for major metro areas).
It also includes some economic indicators for more than a 100 other countries (e.g. UK, Canada, Australia, India, Singapore, China, Mexico, Estonia, Kenya, Nepal, Brazil etc.)
Macworld review for the V1 version of the app http://www.macworld.com/article/142855/2009/09/economicnewsapps.html says
"tough to do better than Cascade Software’s Economy app"
"The app is a one-stop shop ....... economists and financial analysts love to parse"
"it’s a handy resource to have available in the palm of your hand."
---
Features: 
 1. Latest values of key (curated) US economic indicators (GDP, Employment, Housing, Manufacturing, Inflation, Trade Deficit, weekly updates of Canadian,Mexican currency exchange rates , M2 Money stock, etc.) published by the US Federal Reserve.
 2. Share economic graphs through social media, email, SMS, printouts etc.
 3. Graphs to track economic indicators across many different time ranges (e.g. 1 year, 3 years, ...,40 years etc.)
 4. Graphs that track the values of economic indicators across Democratic and Republican presidencies and across Recession periods over the past several decades. 
 5. Around 45,000 economic indicators (mostly for the US, but also for more than a 100 other countries)
 6. A powerful search engine that makes it easy to use partial (or full) keywords to search through the 45,000 economic indicators provided by the app. 
 7. All indicators updated soon after the govt numbers are published. (Most indicators updated monthly, others quarterly, annually, daily or weekly)
 8. Help/Descriptions for many economic indicators.
 9. Data-value transformations (graphs can be charted on interesting y-axis transformations (e.g. continuously compounded annual rate of change, natural log, change from previous year etc.)
 10. The app requires internet connectivity, but previously downloaded/viewed (saved) data can be viewed in offline mode without an internet connection.
Are you curious about the economy? Gauge the current state of the US economy with the latest economic indicators, Review historical data for patterns across recessions and patterns across Republican and Democratic presidencies
Do you want to win arguments when discussing the economy or make speculative predictions about the economy based on patterns from the past? 
This app will help you with all of that and more.
----
Please contact us through our website (http://CascadeSoft.net) or blog for questions, comments or suggestions.
The app is optimised for multiple iPhone and iPod Touch devices and it has been tested on devices ranging from an iPhone 4 device (running iOS 5.1.1) to an iPhone 7 Plus device (running iOS 10.1)
Download the app to see why it was the #1 ranked paid app in the Finance category of the app store (for weeks in summer, 2009) and why it was featured on the cover of Wiley Publishing's book on Incredible iPhone apps.

- Improve English Communication -
Career-Specific Focus – Learn vocabulary and communication styles tailored to your field
Confident Exam Preparation – Prepare for IELTS, TOEFL, TOEIC, EIKEN, and more with targeted practice in our bilingual app to boost fluency.
- Personalized Learning Paths -
Personalized language learning – Learn to succeed in workplace interviews, giving presentations, interacting in meetings, succeeding at client calls, and daily conversations.
AI-Driven Conversations & Open-Ended Dialogues – Personalized language learning through practicing realistic conversations.
- Instant Feedback & AI Coach for Conversations -
Quantitative Progress Tracking – Monitor your improvement with data-driven insights.
Pronunciation & Word Stress Guidance from our AI English Coach – Receive real-time corrections to sound more natural.
- Real-Life Conversation Practice -
Grammar & Vocabulary – AI-driven conversation helps you build a solid foundation in English grammar and expand your vocabulary with everyday, practical words. The adaptive AI adjusts to your progress, ensuring you always learn exactly what you need.
Conversation Practice – Improve fluency with role-plays, open-ended dialogues, and real-life scenarios. Learn to speak English confidently and with clarity. Leave language misunderstandings behind, whether in the workplace or the classroom.
Pronunciation Training – Practice speaking English and conquer tricky sounds, learn nuanced English pronunciation.
Personalized Study Sets – Save words, phrases, or sentences from lessons or create your own, explore and share sets, and improve your pronunciation with real-time feedback
- What You'll Get -
Enhanced Global Collaboration: Bridge language gaps and foster seamless teamwork with international colleagues or friends.
Career Potential: Boost your career by impressing clients and colleagues with polished English communication
Expand Your Network: Build meaningful relationships and explore global opportunities with confidence.

bluejetty:00026329:ios.description:
Bubble Prizes is where your bubble-shooting skills actually pay off. It's a casual puzzle game that lets you compete in multiplayer tournaments and win real money. Pop bubbles, climb the leaderboards, and cash out straight to PayPal—no gimmicks, just skill.
• WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
This isn't your typical casual bubble shooter. Every match is a real multiplayer competition where you face off against other players on identical boards. The better your aim and strategy, the more you win. No slot mechanics, no random luck—just you versus other puzzle lovers in a fair fight.
HOW IT WORKS
Jump into daily and weekly cash tournaments where skill-based matchmaking puts you up against players at your level. The classic bubble shooter gameplay you know—aim, match three, and pop—but now with real stakes. Win your matches, stack up prizes, and withdraw whenever you're ready via PayPal or gift cards.
• GAME FEATURES
Real Cash Tournaments: Multiplayer brackets and head-to-head matches with actual prize pools. The casual gameplay you love, now competitive.
Classic Puzzle Mechanics: Refined bubble shooter controls built for precision. Every shot counts when you're playing for money.
Fair Matchmaking: Skill-based pairing means you're always competing against people at your level, not pros who'll crush you.
Strategic Power-Ups: Deploy boosters to clear tricky puzzle boards and outsmart your opponents in clutch moments.
Global Leaderboards: See where you rank among multiplayer competitors worldwide. Track your wins, streaks, and total earnings.
Level Up & Unlock: Progress through skill tiers to access higher-stakes tournaments and unlock new bubble designs.
Free Practice Mode: Sharpen your shooter skills before entering paid matches. Play as much as you want, risk-free.
• WHY PEOPLE LOVE IT
Players keep coming back because Bubble Prizes respects your skill. We've paid out over $1,000,000 to winners who mastered the puzzle mechanics. Our 4.5-star rating comes from real players who appreciate fair multiplayer competition and actual payouts.
PERFECT FOR YOU IF:
You love casual puzzle games but want something more rewarding
You're tired of bubble shooters with no real stakes
You enjoy multiplayer competition without pay-to-win nonsense
You want to turn your gaming time into actual earnings
• GETTING PAID IS SIMPLE
Start with free casual matches to get comfortable
Enter a multiplayer tournament when you're ready
Win by outscoring opponents on the same puzzle boards
Cash out to PayPal or grab a gift card—it's that easy
• 100% SKILL-BASED
Every trajectory is certified fair. Every tournament runs on the same boards for all players. Your shooter accuracy and puzzle-solving strategy determine your rank—not your wallet, not randomness. The playing field is level.

Terms of Service: https://ataygames.com/terms

bluejetty:00070084:ios.description:

Designed with versatility and user-friendliness in mind, We Play Piano makes it possible for you to practice your piano skills anytime, anywhere.

Adjustable Keyboard Width: Tailor your piano keyboard to fit your comfort level. With adjustable width settings, you can easily customize the keyboard to match your playing style, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable practice session.
Show Labels: Never lose your place on the keyboard. Our app displays clear and concise labels on each key, making it easier for beginners to learn note names and positions, and for experienced players to quickly navigate through complex compositions.
Locate Octaves: Understanding and recognizing octaves is fundamental in music theory and performance. We Play Piano includes a feature that allows users to easily identify and locate octaves, enhancing learning and playing efficiency.
Whether you're rehearsing for a performance, learning a new piece, or just playing for fun, We Play Piano is designed to support your musical journey. The app caters to all levels of proficiency, from those taking their first steps in music to professional musicians seeking a convenient way to practice on the go.
Experience the joy of playing the piano at your fingertips. We Play Piano not only aids in practice but also enriches your musical knowledge and skills, making it a must-have tool for anyone passionate about music. Download "We Play Piano" today and bring the beauty of piano music into your daily life.

bluejetty:00062445:ios.summary: Metronome BEATS allows you to keep your internal time steady as you practice your musical instrument, using great sounding drum beats and moving pendulum with motion blur effects! You can change Time signatures, Drum loops, Strumming patter
bluejetty:00062445:ios.description:
Metronome BEATS allows you to keep your internal time steady as you practice your musical instrument, using great sounding drum beats and moving pendulum with motion blur effects! You can change Time signatures, Drum loops, Strumming patterns and color themes.
*** How to use Metronome BEATS ? ***
A metronome is a practice tool that produces a steady beat (or pulse) to help musicians play rhythms accurately. The pulses are measured in beats-per-minute (BPM).
* Click on the Play button to hear the metronome sound
* Select Beats per Minute (BPM) from 10 up to 360 using + or - buttons (you can use the vertical or horizontal slider too)
* Change the accent or mute any of the beats by tapping on the animated blocks
* Change the Dynamic Time Signature by selecting from 1 to 16 sub BEAT divisions, from 1 to 32 sub NOTE divisions - choose a subdivisions including triplets, dotted notes, and many more
* Enable Flash & Vibrate Modes 
* Enable Speed Trainer – helps to develop your steady beats progressively (+1 BPM every 5 secondes)
* Choose from 20 drum loops and 29 built-in strumming patterns with voice
* Enable Timer to help you keep track of your session
* Calculate BPM by tapping in real time on the Tap button
* Choose from 10 different metronome sounds
* Enjoy the intuitive interface by changing color themes
Metronome BEATS uses RTP (Real-Time Playback) technology to ensure accuracy to 20 microseconds (±20µs). It also supports a background play mode.
It's the ideal tool for 
- working on your tempo
- learning to play an instrument (indispensable)
- playing with other musicians (necessary)
Metronome BEATS can be used with any instrument: guitar, piano, drums, saxophone, violin, Ukulele …

bluejetty:00035422:ios.description:
Do you want to be a hunting sniper? Let's play this cool shooting game for free! In each city, criminal organizations carry out dirty deals and criminal activities. You are a hunting sniper with superb hiding skills and hitman abilities. Track their whereabouts like a ghost assassin, for the cities’ peace and justice, pick up your guns, assassinate the top leader of the evil forces, guard the city like a ghost!
DIFFERENT MODES MISSIONS
There are rich game modes such as main quest, boss quest, arena, alien invasion, hunting mode, assassination mode, daily task and so on, you can choose the mode you prefer!
BATTLE WITH OTHER PLAYERS
If you like fighting with other players, you can join the arena mode, you can eliminate players around the world, receive rich rewards and dominate the leaderboard!
POWERFUL ARSENAL
There are a variety of different guns in this hunting sniper shooting game that look cool and have powerful attributes. You can build your own firearms arsenal, upgrade gun parts to improve attributes, which can help you complete missions better.
ADVENTURES IN DIFFERENT CITIES
The evil force is spreading to different cities. After completing the missions in one city, you need to go to the next one. Each city has different missions, show your assassin hitman abilities, clean up all the enemies.
MISSION ASSISTANT
Difficult missions exist in this gun game, but don’t worry, please use the drone to locate the targets if you can’t find them, you will finish missions easier.
GAME FEATURES:
* A 3d sniper shooting game for free
* Exquisite art style and 3d display, give you an immersive hitman feeling
* Excellent level design, each level has a different hunting sniper experience
* Easy control to play, use different guns to enjoy the game
* Fast-paced shooting, a great hitman shooting game to kill time

* A variety of guns can be chosen, complete missions easier

bluejetty:00155338:ios.description:
Get the latest news and information, weather coverage and traffic updates in the Quad Cities area with the 97X app! Listen to the station live and interact with the hosts – you can direct message and call the show directly from the app. Receive alerts about breaking news, contests, and more before anyone else. Save articles and viral stories for reading later, and share on Facebook and Twitter.
Key Features:
• Listen to our shows, plus receive weather and traffic updates live from 97X Radio
• Read the latest news, watch videos, view photo galleries & listen to audio content
• Submit Photos/Videos directly from the app
• Participate in contests and giveaways, plus get exclusive access to station scavenger hunts
• Apple CarPlay lets you to stay focused on the road while listening
• Get the latest weather for your area plus a 5-day forecast
• Do not disturb modes for alerts (weekend and after hours)
• Save articles for reading later (supports offline viewing)
• Instant Alerts for breaking news, weather, contests, shows and more
• Featured full multi-tasking with background audio and controls
• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter
• Supports AirPlay for wireless streaming to your compatible devices
• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of the 97X app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within the 97X app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

bluejetty:00174552:ios.name: Awesome Breathing: Pacer Timer
bluejetty:00174552:ios.summary:
Awesome Breathing is a simple, elegant tool to guide and visualize your breathing. Use it daily to help with meditation, sleep, stress, anxiety, focus, or to simply bring a few moments of calm and mindfulness to your day.
The perfect breat
bluejetty:00174552:ios.description:
Awesome Breathing is a simple, elegant tool to guide and visualize your breathing. Use it daily to help with meditation, sleep, stress, anxiety, focus, or to simply bring a few moments of calm and mindfulness to your day.
The perfect breathwork app. Simple, unobtrusive, and best of all, free to use anytime! Set your own pace, follow the calming animated pacer, and enjoy guided breathing exercises for relaxation, stress and anxiety relief, better sleep, and focus.
Don't take our word for it:
** 4.9 stars, over 3,700 ratings **
"Two thumbs up, three if I had them. Works exactly as advertised and is super easy to use. Free to use if you want! I happily sent them support and could choose my own amount. As they say in the app name, AWESOME!"
"Beautiful and responsive UI with customizable breathing patterns."
"I have tested at least a dozen breathing apps. This one is BY FAR the best one I've used. Simple layout, real voice cues, custom programs, and a menu that is relaxing and intuitive. Get it!"
"Excellent app, simple to use. As a psychotherapist I am using it myself and recommending it to clients who might benefit."
Features:
• Clean, simple interface for an uncluttered and calming breathing experience
• Fully customizable inhale, exhale, and optional hold (pause) durations, so you can build any breathing exercise or technique you like
• Choose from fifteen included programs, such as Box Breathing, Relaxing Breathing (4-7-8), Equal Breathing, Measured Breathing, and Triangle Breathing, plus patterns for focus, running, and performance
• Create and save your own custom breathing programs
• Sessions can be free-form (no set duration) or timed, by duration or by number of breaths
• Optional pre-session countdown timer gives you a few moments to settle in before your session begins
• Choose from several beautiful pacer color themes
• Ambient background soundscapes to relax and breathe along to
• Optional guided voice and tone cues signal when to inhale, hold, and exhale, so you can breathe with your eyes closed and without looking at your device, each with its own volume
• Start and end bells can be enabled to signal the beginning and end of your sessions
• Vibration mode allows for silent, eyes closed breathing sessions
• Playback continues when your screen is locked or the app is in the background, so your cues never stop
• Save your sessions as Mindful Minutes in the Apple Health app
• Customizable reminder notifications alert you when it's time to take a moment out of your day to breathe
A few of the included programs:
Box Breathing (4-4-4-4)
Also known as Navy SEAL or tactical breathing. A simple, effective way to regain calm and control under stress. Inhale for 4, hold for 4, exhale for 4, hold for 4. All through your nose.
Relaxing Breathing (4-7-8)
Trouble falling asleep? Inhale for 4 through your nose, hold for 7, exhale for 8 out of your mouth.
Equal Breathing (4-4)
A pranayama practice called Sama Vritti that helps quiet racing thoughts. Inhale for 4, exhale for 4, all through your nose. Try a 6 or 8 count once it feels comfortable.
Measured Breathing (4-1-7)
A handy stress reducer you can do anywhere. Inhale for 4, hold for 1, exhale for 7. All through your nose.
Triangle Breathing (4-4-4)
Picture a triangle with equal sides. Inhale for 4, exhale for 4, pause for 4. Repeat.
Plus Coherent Breathing, Breathing for Meditation, Yoga Pranayama, and dedicated programs for runners, swimmers, athletes, and endurance.
We hope Awesome Breathing helps you reach your goals, and we look forward to being part of your journey. We would love to hear your reviews and feedback.
------

bluejetty:00021839:ios.name: Family Tree: Heritage History
bluejetty:00021839:ios.summary: Every family has a story waiting to be told. Family Life Tree is more than just a genealogy tool; it is a digital sanctuary designed to preserve the whispers of the past and bridge the gap between generations. From the faded memories and he
bluejetty:00021839:ios.description:
Every family has a story waiting to be told. Family Life Tree is more than just a genealogy tool; it is a digital sanctuary designed to preserve the whispers of the past and bridge the gap between generations. From the faded memories and heritage of your great-grandparents to the stories of your children, we help you weave them all into a beautiful, living legacy.
Whether you are rediscovering your heritage or documenting your own journey, our app turns the search for your origins into a heartfelt experience of discovery by making a nostalgic album out of your family's genealogical history.
Bring Your History to Life:
• Interactive Family Tree Builder: Gently trace your lineage through a visually captivating interface. Watch your family story unfold as you connect names, faces, and relationships into a dynamic tapestry of life.
• Detailed Personal Profiles: Move beyond mere dates and names. Capture the true essence of your loved ones by recording their passions, occupations, life achievements, and the personal stories that define them.
• AI-Powered Photo Colorization: Bring warmth back into the past. Our advanced AI technology restores faded black and white photographs, bringing vibrant color to the precious moments of your ancestors. Breathe life into your family album and relieve the most nostalgic memories in color!
• Interactive Family Map: Trace the footsteps of those who came before you. Visualize your family’s geographical journey and discover the places and landscapes that shaped your heritage.
• Milestones and Celebrations: Keep the spirit of connection alive. Stay mindful of every birthday and anniversary, ensuring that every significant moment in your family’s journey is celebrated.
• Personalized Tree Designs: Reflect your family’s unique character with a variety of beautiful family tree skins, allowing you to present your history and genealogy in a style that feels like home.
• Seamless Family Sharing: Invite your relatives into the journey. Collaborate on research and share your genealogical discoveries to build a shared understanding of where you all come from.
Why Choose Family Life Tree?
Family Life Tree is an invitation to slow down and remember. It is a way to honor those who paved the way and to ensure the stories of your lineage are never forgotten. Go down the memory lane and bathe in the feeling of nostalgia.
Join us in building a bridge between the past and the future, one memory at a time.
Privacy Policy: https://daily-discovers.com/privacy
Terms Of Use: https://daily-discovers.com/tos

bluejetty:00184413:ios.summary:
4x4 Offroad Monster Truck Racing:
Get ready for the most thrilling 4x4 offroad driving adventure and experience real offroad drifting, intense uphill climbing, and challenging offroad racing across extreme environments. This is not just a r
bluejetty:00184413:ios.description:
4x4 Offroad Monster Truck Racing:
Get ready for the most thrilling 4x4 offroad driving adventure and experience real offroad drifting, intense uphill climbing, and challenging offroad racing across extreme environments. This is not just a racing game, it is the ultimate 4x4 offroad drifting and racing simulator designed for players who love uphill challenges, offroad driving, and competitive drifting races.
In this offroad racing game, you will test your driving skills on rough mountain paths, desert tracks, muddy trails, and rocky uphill climbs. Master the art of drifting with your 4x4 truck as you race against time and opponents in demanding conditions. The combination of realistic vehicle physics, detailed environments, and addictive gameplay makes this offroad drifting and racing simulator one of the most engaging uphill climbing challenges available on mobile.
The focus of this game is pure offroad fun. Drive a wide range of 4x4 vehicles including powerful monster trucks, rugged jeeps, and high-performance SUVs. Each vehicle is designed with realistic suspension, tire grip, and handling to give you the most authentic offroad driving experience possible. Feel the thrill of drifting through sharp turns, racing across dirt tracks, and climbing steep hills while keeping your vehicle under control.
Offroad racing fans will enjoy the diversity of tracks and missions. From steep mountain climbs to long desert trails, every race is a new challenge. Use your driving skills to stay on the road, manage your speed on dangerous curves, and drift with style to leave your opponents behind. Unlike casual driving games, this 4x4 offroad racing and drifting simulator pushes you to control your vehicle in extreme situations.
If you are a fan of hill climb racing, dirt bike adventures, rally driving, car parking simulators, or monster truck challenges, this game will keep you entertained for hours. The gameplay is designed for both casual players and hardcore racing fans who want to test their driving abilities in extreme offroad conditions. You do not lose lives or energy here. You can always restart and try again until you master the track.
The uphill climbing challenges are especially designed to test your precision and patience. Driving a 4x4 vehicle uphill is not easy, and when combined with drifting and racing mechanics, it becomes one of the most exciting experiences on mobile. Every mountain track requires focus, every drift demands control, and every race rewards you with progress and a sense of victory.
The game combines smooth controls with stunning 3D graphics to bring the world of offroad racing to life. Experience realistic environments from dusty deserts to snowy mountains, muddy rivers, and rocky hills. Every location is designed to challenge your drifting and climbing abilities while providing a fresh racing adventure each time you play.
Real 4x4 offroad racing, extreme uphill climbing, realistic drifting physics, powerful monster trucks, rugged jeeps, addictive gameplay, and dynamic environments. With smooth handling and responsive controls, you can drift, race, and climb with confidence. Whether you want to complete missions, beat records, or simply enjoy the thrill of offroad driving, this game has something for every racing fan.
This 4x4 offroad drifting and uphill racing game is more than just a driving simulator. It is a complete offroad adventure where every race is unique and every climb is a challenge. Improve your skills, unlock new vehicles, and become a master of offroad drifting and uphill racing. The more you play, the better you get, and the more fun the experience becomes.
 Master the art of drifting, dominate the racing tracks, and climb every mountain in your way. If you are looking for a true 4x4 offroad drifting and uphill climbing experience, this is the game you have been waiting for. Get behind the wheel, push your limits, and prove that you are the ultimate offroad racing champion.

- Thousands of embroidery, cutting, and printing designs.

• Gallery
Join the Artspira community—build your own Gallery, post your projects, comment, and follow your favorite makers.
• AR function
See how designs will look on your projects before you stitch them out.
• Storage
Save up to 20 files in cloud storage.

- Draw your own cutting designs

- Edit Artspira library designs

UNLEASH ROBOT TITANS 
Towering over 9 feet tall and weighing over 2000 pounds are your 58 ultimate fighting machines, robot titans & legends including fan favorite superstars – Zeus, Atom, Noisy boy & Twin Cities.
STAR ROBOTS
Fight the greatest robot brawlers among 100 million WRB players in exciting Global Multiplayer battles. Transform the legends Atom, Zeus, and all-time favorite champions into powerful 1, 2, 3 and 4 Star Robots to win big in Versus Leagues & Global Tournaments. Top the Leaderboards, claim the Championship title and reign supreme as the Ultimate World Robot Boxing Champion.
Achieve greatness in the future of boxing, where gigantic robots pack powerful punches. Unleash your fighting style with deadly jabs, uppercuts & special moves to win world championship belts, collect trophies & knockout friends!
BRAWL REAL-TIME WITH FRIENDS

WIN EXCITING CHALLENGES!
Play Career, Multiplayer, and the new Winner Take All Mode to become the All-Category Champion.
EXPERIENCE REAL SPORTS ACTION
Build a roster of your favorite sports robots and take on the Legends in enthralling arenas and stadiums.
UPGRADE & COLOR YOUR CHAMPION
Fight and Upgrade your robot to be stronger, faster and meaner. Color your robot, express yourself and have some fun in the Paint shop!
SHOWCASE YOUR TRIUMPHS
Win Challenges and exhibit your achievements in an all-new Trophy Room.
ACHIEVE GLORY IN ARENAS
Reign supreme in 11 huge arenas that can barely contain these hulking mean machines.

bluejetty:00071579:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00071579:ios.description:
Do your kids like ice cream? Eskimo, ice cream cones, milkshakes, popsicles and much more.
Ice cream games is an amusing game for kids, which will not only let your kids try on the role of an ice cream man, but also teach the basics of making delicious treats.
Welcome animal guests and take orders from them. Prepare ice cream of different flavors and textures, decorate desserts with various edible decorations and earn coins. Moreover, our ice cream game is great for developing kid's imagination, fine motor skills training, and is also a perfect way to spend free time.
Our the smallest user will be able to:
– learn how to work with kitchen appliances;
– select an ice-cream flavor (strawberry, chocolate, banana, watermelon, etc.)
– learn recipes for making ice cream cones, fruit ice or milkshake;
– play the game with a simple interface;
– enjoy bright graphics and funny characters;
– play without the help of adults.
~~~ Features of Ice cream games ~~~
• 5 treat recipes
Visitors want to treat themselves with ice cream! Choose with your kid what you want to cook: ice cream in a waffle cone or in a glass, fruit ice, ice cream balls or a milkshake. Each dessert is prepared according to a special recipe. Mix different ingredients to make the most delicious ice cream!
• Variety of flavors
To start preparing a treat, the kid needs to decide what taste it will be. Tap on the syrup you want to use as a base and add the contents to the bowl. There are many different tastes: vanilla, blueberry, strawberry, caramel, banana, watermelon and others. Choose what you like best!
• Delicious decorations
After making the ice cream, to add bright colors, kids can decorate their dessert with various fruits and berries. Strawberries, blueberries, bananas, pieces of chocolate and caramel, colorful sprinkles - everything that little sweet tooth likes so much!
• Fine motor skills development 
In our ice cream app your child not only get positive emotions and find out how to cook sweet desserts, but also train their fine motor skills. Drag the ingredients into the bowl, tap on the blender buttons, turn the combine handles, distribute decorations. Our game is a great workout for your kids' fingers!
SUBSCRIPTION
Enjoy the game and get bonuses:
1. mini-game "Sweet ice".
2. mini-game "Ice-cream balls".
3. mini-game "Milkshakes".
4. mini-game "Fruit ice on the stick".
Make your life easier with premium access: 
- Check its advantages, by getting a free three-day trial. After 3 days, the trial will automatically turn to the weekly paid subscription.
- The paid subscription is divided into the 3 types: weekly, monthly, and year.
- A week paid subscription costs $9.99. Month - $19.99. Year - $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel the subscription or a free trial at any time, but at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE, it will be automatically renewed.
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage the subscription and turn off the auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited when you purchase the subscription.
- Read our privacy policy https://jmhdevelopers.com/privacy.html 
And Terms of use https://jmhdevelopers.com/terms_of_use.html

FNB Izard County is your personal financial advocate. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.

Here’s what you can do with FNB Izard County:
-Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
-Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
-Transfer money between your accounts
-Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
-View and save your monthly statements
-Find branches and ATMs near you
-Aggregate your financial accounts

Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode or biometric on supported devices.

bluejetty:00165929:ios.name: The Way: Meditation & Zen
bluejetty:00165929:ios.summary: THE WAY is a new kind of meditation app: a single path, led by an authorized Zen master, that guides you on a deep meditation training program. Study alongside Zen master Henry Shukman as you uncover the deep peace, love, insight and awaken
bluejetty:00165929:ios.description:
THE WAY is a new kind of meditation app: a single path, led by an authorized Zen master, that guides you on a deep meditation training program. Study alongside Zen master Henry Shukman as you uncover the deep peace, love, insight and awakening that meditation can bring.
The simple path to deeper meditation.
With THE WAY, you will:
*** Never feel overwhelmed by choice. The Way guides you step-by-step along a single, linear path through all the key areas of a deep and fulfilling meditation practice. You never have to worry about which meditation to choose.
*** Experience real transformation and deep wellbeing. Progress along a proven pathway of meditation that helps you to awaken to the true nature of your mind, your self, and your relationship to the world. Explore Zen koans, non-dual awareness and other awakening techniques. 
*** Benefit from an authorized Zen Master as your guide. Study with a beloved teacher with over 35 years of meditation practice. Learn Henry Shukman’s innovative fusion of modern mindfulness, Jhana practice and Sanbo Zen teaching. 
HENRY SHUKMAN teaches mindfulness and awakening practices to a wide range of students from all traditions and walks of life. Henry is an authorized Zen Master in the Sanbo Zen lineage, and is the Spiritual Director of Mountain Cloud Zen Center in Santa Fe, New Mexico. His struggles and traumatic experiences as a youth, combined with a spontaneous awakening experience at 19, paved the way for Henry to develop a well-rounded approach to meditation. 
On the journey of THE WAY, you can learn to:
*** Calm the nervous system, reduce stress on a daily basis and release trauma over time
*** Uncover previously unknown support and gratitude in our lives
*** Access beautiful states of flow and absorption during meditation
*** Get tastes and glimpses of awakening - insights into your own true nature, and discovering what non-duality really means, and the deep freedom and joy it can give.
THE WAY works through a series of daily guided meditations and talks along a single path of practice. Through these guided meditations you will explore with Zen Master Henry Shukman: teaching from ancient Buddhist traditions, finding peace and unconditional wellbeing in the heart of our lives, learning how to sit with and process negative emotions, healing from past traumas, uncovering deep joy in the bare fact of being alive, discovering a deep and connected presence, understanding insights into non-duality and awakening to the true nature of reality. All grounded in modern mindfulness and ancient Zen wisdom.
SUBSCRIPTION AND SCHOLARSHIPS
THE WAY is free to download and try out the pathway.
You can manage your subscription from your Apple account settings. Payment will be charged to your Apple account.
If you can’t afford the cost of the subscription, please let us know and we will arrange a free subscription to THE WAY for you through our scholarship program.
Terms of service: https://www.thewayapp.com/legal/terms-conditions
Privacy policy: https://www.thewayapp.com/legal/privacy-statement

bluejetty:00170812:ios.description:
Match Mania 3D: Relax, Enjoy, and Play in a World of Beautiful Puzzles and Clever Fun!
Welcome to a world of boundless amusement and mind-bending thrills! Immerse yourself in a vibrant 3D universe where your intelligence and quick thinking are your greatest assets. With straightforward yet perpetually challenging matching puzzles, our game promises limitless joy for players of all ages.
Simple Rules, Brain-Boosting Matching Gameplay: Our game is meticulously crafted with simplicity in mind. Just match three identical items, and witness your mind receive an invigorating workout! Whether you're a novice or a seasoned player, you'll relish pushing your limits with these captivating matching puzzles.
Diverse Adventures with Over 400 3D Models: Delve into a wide-ranging assortment of more than 400 types of 3D models, including delectable foods, fresh fruits, bouncing balls, adorable toys, captivating animals, and much more! Each level brings a fresh visual delight, ensuring that you stay engaged and entertained with 3D matching challenges.
Empower Your Journey with Potent Matching Boosters: Stuck on a challenging level? Worry not! Harness the array of mighty matching boosters at your disposal, and conquer even the most formidable 3D puzzles. A strategic approach and a touch of these exhilarating power-ups will lead you to victory in relaxing matching gameplay!
Free to Play, Anytime, Anywhere: No Wi-Fi? No problem! Our game is free to play and functions without an internet connection. Savor unending matching entertainment offline, whether you're at home, on the move, or taking a breather from work.
Come join us now and set out on an enthralling journey through a 3D realm brimming with delightful visuals and captivating matching challenges. Download today and let the frenzy of 3D matching commence!
Got any questions? Reach out to our support team at support@solimatch.com

bluejetty:00039864:ios.summary: Whether you are looking for a romantic date, a casual hangout, or just a friend for sharing the trivia of everyday life, you can always find people who have the same thought as you in Omi! Millions of couples & friends have met and embarked
bluejetty:00039864:ios.description:
Whether you are looking for a romantic date, a casual hangout, or just a friend for sharing the trivia of everyday life, you can always find people who have the same thought as you in Omi! Millions of couples & friends have met and embarked on their wonderful journey from Omi. Ready for yours?
A Simple Swipe When You Feel Right!
With Omi’s big data algorithm of LBS, MBTI romance compatibility and common interests, we ensure you the highest success rate to match. Your special someone is just a few swipes away! 
Various Ways to Discover People Like You
There are more ways to get matches other than swiping. Omi Blind Date helps you to meet like-minded people in creative ways. Choose an avatar and get started! You could unlock your matches' real pictures if you both send 5 messages.
► Start your chats with more than a "Hi". Daily questions from Omi's Dating Quiz brings people who pick the same answer together. Follow the topic and share more about yourself! 
► The more you know a person, the easier you know if he/she is your type. Based on the super-scientific MBTI test questions, Omi's Love Style Test reveals your romance compatibility scores and where you shine in a relationship! 
► Everyone deserves gentle “Sweet dreams” after a stressful workday. If you are looking for someone to give you a night call, try Omi's Telepath! But don't be surprised if you fall in love with a beautiful voice:P 
► We know you are also curious when finding that special someone, be it a friend or a significant other. If you also turn to the stars for signs, let Omi Clic's tuneful bell rings guide you to your zodiac meant-to-be!
Your Safety Matters
To maintain a safe community, Omi does more than you think.
We make our photo verification fast and precise, by adopting world-leading facial verification technology. We would do everything we could to prevent fake profiles and make a safe and comfortable community.
Our community safety team is on-call 24/7 to eliminate fake or spam accounts with a zero-tolerance policy. 
Omi Premium: Same Price, Moooore Features
Enjoy a variety of value-added services with ultra-low prices for Omi Premium 
► See Who Likes You top listed people already swiped right on you 
► Unlimited Likes for you to meet as many people as you want 
► 5 FREE Crushes per day. Let that special someone know you are really into him/her 
► 1 FREE Turbo per month to boost your profile by 10 times for more attention
The list goes on and waiting for you to discover~
Omi Supreme: Enjoy Your Personal Filter
Omi Supreme includes all 9 Omi Premium privileges with extra exclusive privileges:
► Message Before Matching: You can send 3 Praises directly to people you like
► Advanced Filters: You can filter by height, education, purpose and popularity to only see your type
► Daily Picks: Omi will pick the most popular users and recommend to you everyday
We value your feedback! Hit us up with an email for any question, comment or concern via: support@omi.sg
Terms: https://omi.sg/terms
Privacy: https://omi.sg/privacy
Website: https://omi.sg/features
------
If you choose to purchase Omi Premium or Omi Supreme, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal can be turned off at any time by going to your Account Settings in the App Store. Current Omi Premium subscription price starts at $20/month, with 1-month, 3-month and 12-month packages. Omi Supreme subscription price starts at $60/month, with 1-month, 3-month and 12-month packages. The price is clearly displayed in the app, and pricing may vary in different regions and is subject to change without notice. If you do not purchase Omi Premium or Omi Supreme, you can still use Omi for free!

Select your favorite coach to keep you motivated as you sweat.

Automatically syncs across all your devices.

bluejetty:00070755:ios.summary: Ivanti Email+ for iOS is a secure and containerized email client that allows you to easily and securely gain access to your organization's email on your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch. It synchronizes to your mobile device, email, contacts and
bluejetty:00070755:ios.description:
Ivanti Email+ for iOS is a secure and containerized email client that allows you to easily and securely gain access to your organization's email on your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch. It synchronizes to your mobile device, email, contacts and calendar information using the ActiveSync protocol. 
NOTE: Email+ requires Ivanti's Enterprise Mobility Management platform. Please consult with your organization's Mobile IT staff before downloading and using Email+.
Key Features :
Secure Email - Secured by the Ivanti AppConnect platform and provides AES-256 encryption, application level passcode, certificate based authentication and managed copy/paste functions. Based on admin control, users can receive notifications for Email and Calendar in real-time.
Work contacts - Global address lookup, mark contacts as VIPs and administrator configurable export to personal address book
Work calendar - Create/edit meetings, accept/decline invitations and highlight VIP calendar alerts
Work tasks - Create, edit, delete, view and sort tasks
Secure intranet access - Integrates with Ivanti Web@Work product to securely access intranet sites referenced in emails
Secure interoperability with AppConnect applications - Administrators can selectively allow interoperability with applications from a large number of Ivanti AppConnect partners to ensure that Email attachments can only be shared with secure applications.

bluejetty:00015121:ios.name: Color by Numbers - Halloween +
bluejetty:00015121:ios.summary: Every year, boys and girls all over the world eagerly await Halloween. For on this night, the most mysterious supernatural things occur. These coloring pages depict the main symbols of Halloween, conjuring up all the ancient stories and leg
bluejetty:00015121:ios.description:
Every year, boys and girls all over the world eagerly await Halloween. For on this night, the most mysterious supernatural things occur. These coloring pages depict the main symbols of Halloween, conjuring up all the ancient stories and legends. In coloring these in, your kids will feel the distinctive mood of this mystical night.
Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining
Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

bluejetty:00179397:ios.description:
Build better habits one goal at a time with Habit Tracker: Daily Goal.
Habit Tracker helps you track routines, stay consistent, and see your progress clearly with streaks, reminders, widgets, calendar stats, and Apple Watch support. Whether you are building a morning routine, tracking workouts, drinking more water, reading daily, or breaking an old habit, Habit Tracker keeps your goals simple and visible.
Key Features
• Track habits your way
Log habits once or multiple times per day, create flexible schedules, and adjust each habit to match your real routine.
• See progress clearly
Use streaks, trends, stats, notes, and long-term calendar history to understand what is working and where you can improve.
• Stay consistent
Set helpful reminders with quick actions, so you can complete habits faster and keep momentum throughout the day.
• Widgets that actually work
Track habits from your Home Screen or Lock Screen with interactive widgets on iOS 17 and smart widget interactions on iOS 16.
• Apple Watch support
Keep your habits on your wrist and mark progress without opening your iPhone.
• Fast, simple, and focused
Habit Tracker is designed for quick daily use, with a clean interface, swipe actions, context menus, and fast habit creation.
• Personal and secure
Protect your habits with Face ID or Touch ID, customize colors, use Dark Mode, and keep everything synced with reliable iCloud support.
Habit Tracker Premium
Upgrade to Habit Tracker Premium to unlock:
• Unlimited habits
• Collaboration
• Themes, tints, and app icons
• Support for indie development
Subscription Information
If you choose a Habit Tracker Premium subscription, your purchase will be charged to your Apple ID account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription before the trial expires.
Terms & Conditions: https://yahenskyi.dev/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://yahenskyi.dev/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00126761:ios.name: SaskAlert
bluejetty:00126761:ios.summary:
SaskAlert is the Government of Saskatchewan's official emergency alerting program, providing real-time, critical information on emergencies to help you protect yourself, your family, and your property.
Key features of the SaskAlert App:
•
bluejetty:00126761:ios.description:
SaskAlert is the Government of Saskatchewan's official emergency alerting program, providing real-time, critical information on emergencies to help you protect yourself, your family, and your property.
Key features of the SaskAlert App:
• Alerts for life-threatening and emerging situations
• Alerts based on locations you're interested in
• "Follow Me" feature to get alerts near your current location, even when traveling outside Saskatchewan
• View alert areas on a map
• Easily share alerts via social media, email, and text
• Detailed emergency descriptions, impacted areas, and safety instructions
• Simple setup and user-friendly interface
• Choose the types of alerts you want to receive
• Accessibility features for users of all abilities
• Multilingual, with the option to translate alerts into your device's default language
An emergency alert issued through SaskAlert will:
• let you know what the emergency is;
• let you know where it is happening;
• provide instructions for you to follow to stay safe;
• and advise you when the incident is over.
Alerts can be issued by Government of Saskatchewan ministries, Crown corporations, agencies, local governing bodies, and Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC).
Provincial ministries, Crown corporations, and local authorities issue alerts for emergencies within their areas of responsibility that may impact life and safety. Policing agencies issue alerts to warn the public of imminent potential risks to their safety, child abductions, and critical incidents.
ECCC provides alerts for severe weather events, including:
• Tornado watches and warnings
• Warnings for blizzards, blowing snow, dust storms, extreme cold, freezing drizzle, freezing rain, heat, rainfall, severe thunderstorms, snowfall, high winds, and winter storms

bluejetty:00041139:ios.summary: Presenting the fanciest Nail Art Salon Games for kids and girls. Paint your nails pretty with the Timpy Nail Art Salon Games. Get your nails done at the Nail Art Salon, which offers gorgeous themes such as Unicorn, Candy, Princess, Underwat
bluejetty:00041139:ios.description:
Presenting the fanciest Nail Art Salon Games for kids and girls. Paint your nails pretty with the Timpy Nail Art Salon Games. Get your nails done at the Nail Art Salon, which offers gorgeous themes such as Unicorn, Candy, Princess, Underwater, Space, Jungle, Food, Halloween, Christmas, and Unicorn each with its own special nail shapes, nail polish hues, glitters, and patterns as well as beautiful stickers and gems. For a stylish look, adorn your hands with lovely rings, bracelets, and jewelry. Nail Salon is entertaining and addictive. For kids who enjoy fashion and nail games, this manicure magic exists! In this adorable nail salon game for girls, you can paint your nails with different shades of nail polish. Fun games for kids to decorate nails and play cute nail art games.
~ Unicorn nail polish game:
The Unicorn nails theme at Timpy Nail Salon adds a magical and playful touch to your nails. It features colorful designs with unicorns, rainbows, and stars.
~ Christmas nail salon game:
The Christmas nail theme brings the festive spirit to your nails. It includes red, green, and gold colors with Santa Claus, snowflakes, Xmas ornaments, and Christmas trees. Perfect nail makeover for the Xmas holiday season!
~ Halloween nail salon game:
The Halloween nail art theme is spooky and fun. Play with dark colors like black and orange and create spooky but cute designs with bats, spiders, ghosts, and pumpkins. Ideal nail makeover for haunted nail art styles!
~ Candy nail art game:
The Candy nail art theme is sweet and colorful. Make designs inspired by candies like lollipops, gummy bears, sweet treats, and cotton candy. Create a delicious nail makeover that's too sweet to eat!
~ Princess nail salon game:
The Princess theme is elegant and royal. It has princess favorite colors like pink and lavender with designs featuring tiaras, pearls, and fancy patterns. Enjoy a royal nail makeover for girls!
~ Underwater nail art game:
The Underwater theme is inspired by the ocean. It uses shades of blue and green with designs of seashells, starfish, and mermaids. A nail makeover with beautiful ocean elements!
~ Space nail polish game:
The Space theme is cosmic and adventurous. It includes dark colors with metallic accents and designs of planets, galaxies, and shooting stars. Create your little universe with a Milky Way and a Galaxy of stars with this nail makeover!
~ Jungle nail polish game:
The Jungle theme is inspired by the tropical rainforest. It uses earthy colors and has designs with tropical leaves, flowers, and animal prints. Enjoy our popular jungle theme nail makeover for girls!
~ Food nail art game:
The Food theme is for food lovers. It includes designs inspired by hamburgers, ice cream, pizza, and other delicious treats. Give a food art style for your nail makeover!
Our salon is your child's personal nail art design studio. They can experiment with different tools, stickers, and decals to take their nail art to the next level. Encourage your child to let their creativity shine and create nail art that's uniquely theirs.
Subscription Details:
-Payment will be charged to the Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
-Cancel subscription renewal anytime under Subscriptions in your App Store Settings.
-Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
-No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: https://www.timpygames.com/privacypolicy.php
Terms of Service: https://www.idzdigital.com/terms_of_service.php

Whether it's nail design, nail coloring, or nail painting, our game has it all. Join us in celebrating the beauty of creativity and self-expression.

bluejetty:00167759:ios.name: Perfect Diner
bluejetty:00167759:ios.summary:
Welcome to Perfect Diner, your gateway to building an empire in the fast-food industry and ascending to the ranks of a restaurant tycoon! 
Embark on a culinary adventure where you start from scratch and rise to the zenith of the food servi
bluejetty:00167759:ios.description:
Welcome to Perfect Diner, your gateway to building an empire in the fast-food industry and ascending to the ranks of a restaurant tycoon! 
Embark on a culinary adventure where you start from scratch and rise to the zenith of the food service world. In Perfect Diner, you'll immerse yourself in the whirlwind of fast-food frenzy, crafting and constructing your own deluxe diner empire from the ground up.
Dive headfirst into the bustling world of the restaurant business with this exhilarating simulator game. Here, you won't just be flipping burgers; you'll be orchestrating every facet of the fast-food experience. From launching your establishment and perfecting your signature dishes to upgrading your facilities and expanding your reach – experience the full spectrum of the dynamic fast-food diner business.
Manage Your Diner:
In this town where fried chicken reigns supreme, it's all about delivering sizzle and flavor! Take charge of the kitchen, where you'll whip up delectable delights to tantalize taste buds. But remember, it's not just about the food – maintaining pristine tables and swift service is paramount! Navigate the frenetic world of fast-food madness and oversee every aspect of your operation with finesse.
Elevate Your Game:
Transform your humble counter into a culinary oasis fit for royalty! Master the art of efficient cooking and service to keep your customers satisfied and your profits soaring. Speed is of the essence – the quicker you serve, the happier your patrons, and the greater your financial rewards to fuel your expansion endeavors.
Recruit and Manage Staff:
Ascend to the ranks of a true restaurant tycoon by assembling and overseeing your team of culinary experts and support staff. Invest in their training and development to unlock their full potential, and witness as they contribute to the success of your fast-food empire. A well-oiled team ensures smooth operations and attracts a steady stream of eager customers!
Unlimited Expansion:
From modest beginnings to global domination, the sky's the limit in Perfect Diner! Start small with a single counter and watch as your enterprise blossoms into a global sensation. Diversify your menu to cater to diverse tastes and preferences, from classics like fries and burgers to tantalizing treats like pizza and beyond. Become a tycoon of the fast-food industry as you expand your network of diners worldwide!
Navigate Unexpected Challenges:
In Perfect Diner, every day presents a fresh set of challenges. Brace yourself for unexpected rushes and supply shortages, just like in the real world. Rise to the occasion with resourcefulness and resilience, turning obstacles into opportunities for growth and prosperity. Master the art of adaptation and watch as your perfect diner evolves into a thriving beacon of culinary excellence!
Embark on a journey to fulfill your dreams of becoming the ultimate fast-food tycoon. With Perfect Diner, you're not just playing a game – you're crafting your legacy in the annals of gastronomic greatness. Seize the opportunity to transform your vision into reality and chart a course to culinary supremacy!
Download Perfect Diner today and embark on your quest to reign supreme as the perfect tycoon of the fast-food franchise universe!

bluejetty:00124143:ios.description:
Join Trainers across the globe who are discovering Pokémon as they explore the world around them. Pokémon GO is the global gaming sensation that has been downloaded over 1 billion times and named “Best Mobile Game” by the Game Developers Choice Awards and “Best App of the Year” by TechCrunch.
_______________
UNCOVER THE WORLD OF POKÉMON: Explore and discover Pokémon wherever you are!
CATCH more Pokémon to complete your Pokédex!
JOURNEY alongside your Buddy Pokémon to help make your Pokémon stronger and earn rewards!
COMPETE in epic Gym battles and...
TEAM UP and UNITE with other Trainers to catch powerful Pokémon during Raid Battles!
It’s time to get moving—your real-life adventures await! Let’s GO!
_______________
With the player’s permission, Adventure Sync uses the Health app to enable the player to earn walking distance when the app is closed.
Notes:
- This app is free-to-play and offers in-game purchases. It is optimized for smartphones, not tablets.
- It is recommended to play while connected to a network in order to obtain accurate location information.
- Compatibility is not guaranteed for devices without GPS capabilities or devices that are connected only to Wi-Fi networks.
- Compatibility information may be changed at any time.
- Information current as of July 11, 2019.
- Compatible with iPhone® 5s / SE / 6 / 6s / 6 Plus / 6s Plus / 7 / 7 Plus / 8 / 8 Plus / X devices with iOS Version 9 or later installed.
- Not compatible with 5th generation iPod Touch devices or iPhone 5c or earlier iPhone devices.
- Please visit PokemonGO.com for additional compatibility information.
- Compatibility is not guaranteed for all devices.
- Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically reduce battery life.

Start the epic quest and explore lost lands and special locations.
Join Harper, a cargo pilot, and her beloved dog Scout on a mission, together with Alex, an archaeology professor searching for lost treasures and ancient artifacts found only on tropical islands and abandoned mystery lands. But, oh no! A malfunction in the airplane forces Harper and Alex to abandon the plane. Help them in their treasure adventure; discover new destinations, complete quests, craft goods, and merge objects to progress, meeting fun characters at every turn!
Embark on a journey of mystery and treasure hunting in this new adventure simulation, uncovering the secrets hidden within.
Main features of Adventure Tales:
- The wonderful adventure awaits: Explore diverse themed locations and lost lands, with each location offering a captivating travel adventure, mysterious storylines, and fun quests, ensuring an enthralling experience. Explore new cultures, help the locals, and overcome challenges!
- Follow the Story: Meet fascinating characters, assist them and discover their story in order to progress in the mystic adventure. Unveil the twists and turns of Harper and Alex’s journey, delving into their evolving relationship in this adventure story game! Reveal secrets from the past and treasures as you progress!
- Restore & Decorate: Bring ancient artifacts and local treasures back to life and help restore sacred and ancient relics, cultures, and buildings.
- Join the Treasure Hunt: Restore ancient artifacts and relics, help the locals, and solve mysteries to open treasure chests and uncover the hidden treasures of your epic adventure.
- Complete Quests & Orders: Unlock new locations and lost islands by successfully completing quests and orders. Merge objects, mine & harvest and craft recipes to open the secret doors to the wonderful adventure in this new simulation game.

bluejetty:00122925:ios.description:
Keep tabs on your budget, finances, and loans—all in one spot. Get the info you need to use money as a tool to build the life you want. See your whole financial life on one screen, then zoom in on your budget to break down your cash flow, expenses, and goals. Get ready to say goodbye to money stress and hello to living “the good life”.
Manage Your Accounts
 • Review account activity: checking, savings, credit card, home, auto, personal and business
 • Deposit checks from your phone with Mobile Check Deposit
 • Keep tabs on your debit card usage with card features
 • Stress less with overdraft protection
 • Check on application status
Convenient Ways to Pay
 • Transfer money between accounts
 • Connect accounts from other financial institutions
 • Send and receive money instantly with Zelle®
Budget & Save
 • Save money faster with budgeting tools and savings, income, and spending trackers
 • Set alerts for savings goals and budget categories
 • Set aside money for recurring expenses with scheduled transfers
Loan Management
 • Pay your auto, mortgage, boat, RV or personal loan with your debit card
 • Receive personalized pre-approved loan offers
 • View current rates and promotions
Security
 • Block & unblock your card in the app
 • Use Biometric ID (face, touch, or fingerprint) to verify your identity for an added layer of security
 • Receive an email or text alert whenever your username is used to login
Connect with Members Choice
 • Send a secure message to one of our member advocates within the app
 • Reference our ATM map to find 55,000+ no-fee Allpoint Worldwide ATM locations

bluejetty:00178861:ios.name: Numberzilla: Number Match Game
bluejetty:00178861:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00178861:ios.description:
Millions of people all over the world are in love with Numberzilla - the TOP numbers game!
The best brain teaser from our childhood with good old familiar rules now has come back with a brand new witty look. People say this super addictive and relaxing puzzle game helps their mental health as well as lets them relax especially after a workday. Enjoy daily achievements and unlock cool badges which will cheer you up!
You will meet our cute mascot Numberzilla and friends - Smart Croissant, Sassy Avocado, Watermelon Warrior, and others. They will be happy to guide you through the rules and will keep track of your results and achievements.
HOW TO PLAY
Cross out the pairs of the same numbers (4-4, 2-2, 9-9) or those which add up to 10 (2-8, 3-7, etc). Two numbers can be removed by tapping on them one by one.
In the Numberzilla puzzle game, the pairs must be located side by side. You can cross out them vertically, horizontally, and also when one number stands on the last cell in the line and another stands on the first cell line below. There can also be empty cells between the 2 matching numbers.
The goal is to cross out all the numbers and empty the board.
When there are no more numbers to remove, press PLUS to ADD the numbers below.
4 GAME MODES
CLASSIC. This is an "endless" mode: you have unlimited time and field to set a scoring record! If you run out of moves - just add extra lines to the bottom.
SURVIVAL. The field is limited, and numbers are falling down similar to the "Tetris" game. Once the board is full - you lose!
DYNAMIC. Once you complete the level, you will get the button SHUFFLE. Press SHUFFLE, it will multiply your points and bring you to the next level.
SPRINT. Mode for time-pressure lovers. You have a few minutes to clear all numbers above the highlighted rows, while new numbers keep falling down. 
BOOSTERS
HINTS. Don't know what to do next? Use hints to simplify the game process
BOMBS. This useful booster helps you to get rid of extra numbers in one tap. Just move the red area to choose the target. As a result, you will blow up 9 numbers at once!
SWAPS. Use this booster to change positions of any chosen two numbers
Check out the Numberzilla Shop, where you can buy any boosters whenever you need them without having to watch the ads for rewards.
DAILY CHALLENGES AND GIFTS
For extra fun, we have prepared something special for you - Guess the Code daily challenge! Guess the number code, crack the safe and earn daily bonuses. Every day you will have one new safe code to guess.
You can also get daily free rewards, promos & discounts! Subscribe to our push notifications to find out more!
PREMIUM ACCESS
You can definitely play Numberzilla for free, but with Numberzilla Premium access, we will take you to a whole new level:
- Unlock an unlimited amount of hints, swaps, and bombs
- No ads will ever interrupt the puzzle-solving process.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Subscription options:
Weekly Gold Membership offers $4.99 weekly subscription for unlocking all content and features and removing ads.
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://docs.appsyoulove.com/policies/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://docs.appsyoulove.com/policies/terms-of-use/
Join us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/numberzilla/
Join us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Numberzilla

bluejetty:00018353:ios.description:
Transform your phone into a powerful receipt scanner, expense tracker, and mileage tracker — all in one app. 
Smart Receipts helps individuals, freelancers, and business owners capture every expense, maximize every IRS deduction, and turn tax season from a headache into a few taps.
SMART RECEIPTS — YOUR ALL-IN-ONE EXPENSE SOLUTION
Whether you're managing personal finances or running a small business, Smart Receipts delivers customizable PDF, CSV, and ZIP reports built for real-world accounting. Organize expenses into "folders," categorize spending, and generate professional reports that simplify tax filings, reimbursements, and bookkeeping.
KEY FEATURES
• Powerful receipt scanner with AI-powered OCR — capture every detail in seconds
• Snap photos with your camera or import existing images
• Upload and process PDF receipts effortlessly
• Import your existing CSV files or bank statements in seconds
• Connect your bank account (USA & Canada only) to automatically pull in expenses and transactions
• Track price, tax, currency, and payment method for every purchase
• Tag entries with names, categories, comments, and custom metadata
• Built-in mileage tracker for reimbursement and IRS deduction claims
• Automatic exchange rate calculations for international travel and business trips
• Smart predictions based on past entries — faster reporting every time
• Fully customizable PDF, CSV, and ZIP reports
SAVE HOURS EVERY WEEK
Stop typing expenses into spreadsheets. Smart Receipts eliminates manual data entry by combining a fast receipt scanner, CSV import, and direct bank sync (USA/Canada). Whether you're tracking a single business trip or a year of deductions, your records stay organized and tax-ready.
BUILT FOR ACCOUNTING & BOOKKEEPING
Accountants, bookkeepers, and small business owners trust Smart Receipts to keep clients audit-ready. Export clean, IRS-friendly reports in seconds and spend less time chasing paperwork.
YOUR DATA, SECURED
Smart Receipts protects your sensitive financial information with secure automatic backups to our private cloud and AI-powered OCR for accurate scanning. Your records stay safe, organized, and accessible whenever you need them.
JOIN OVER 1,000,000 USERS
More than a million people trust Smart Receipts as their go-to expense tracker and mileage tracker. Built by a seasoned consultant, the app is designed for efficiency, flexibility, and the realities of modern financial management.
Download Smart Receipts today and take control of your expenses, deductions, and tax returns.

Drive with speed, drift in the mud and jump with your car to cross the finish line first. Unchain the potential of your offroad cars by customizing and upgrading. Grab the wheel and compete in PvP races against players around the globe drifting on the rough and dusty gravel roads, snow terrains or in forests. Blazing graphics for four-wheel racing games. Feel the dust fly off the tires and enjoy dramatic landscapes & epic sunsets. 
PvP RACING 
Compete against other players worldwide in real-time multiplayer races. Join the fun in competitive season challenges, create a team with your friends, get promoted through the ranks of the PvP leagues.

Get under the hood to upgrade or tune your engine, traction, suspension, or nitro with quality parts. Customize each vehicle in your garage and make it truly yours by choosing the paint and decal. 
OFFROAD LEGENDS 
Prove yourself worthy and learn offroad racing skills and tricks from real-world Red Bull offroad superstars such as Nasser Al-Attiyah, Stéphane Peterhansel, Francisco “Chaleco” López, Catie Munnings, Sebastien Loeb, Timmy Hansen, Kevin Hansen, Carlos Sainz, Andy Mc Millen and Cristina Gutierrez.

bluejetty:00032767:ios.description:
Take the stress out of packing.
Pack, Repeat helps you build packing lists you can trust, reuse, and share. Start with curated essentials, organize everything by bag or traveler, add documents, check the weather, and bring back your best lists whenever you travel again.
Whether you're packing for a weekend away, a business trip, a family vacation, or a multi-stop adventure, Pack, Repeat keeps the whole process calmer from the first item to the last checkmark.
"Essential Travel Apps" - Apple
"Apps We Love" - Apple
"Pack, Repeat is an Essential App for Summer Travel Season" - AppAdvice
START WITH A BETTER LIST
- 30+ curated categories and 400+ common travel items
- Create lists by destination, date, trip type, tags, and notes
- Copy a previous trip and adjust it in seconds
PACK BY BAG OR PERSON
- Organize items by suitcase, carry-on, backpack, toiletry bag, kids' bag, and more
- Split shared trips into clear, manageable sections
- Hide completed items, sort your way, and bulk-check when you're done
GET SMART SUGGESTIONS
- Use AI starter lists for your destination, dates, tags, and optional weather
- Add weather-based packing suggestions before you leave
- Review every suggestion before it goes on your list
PLAN FOR THE REAL TRIP
- See destination weather for your travel dates
- Support multi-destination trips with separate stops
- Check power outlet information before you go
KEEP TRAVEL DETAILS TOGETHER
- Attach tickets, confirmations, PDFs, images, and other travel documents
- Import from Files, Photos, or the share sheet
- Preview documents when you need them
SHARE THE LIST
- Share packing lists with family or travel partners
- Keep everyone working from the same plan
- Track updates across shared trips
PACK FROM ANYWHERE
- Check progress with Home Screen widgets
- Mark items packed from the interactive checklist widget
- Open trips quickly through Spotlight, Shortcuts, and app shortcuts
NEVER START FROM SCRATCH
- Reuse your best lists for repeat trips
- Build dependable routines for work travel, family vacations, weekends, and holidays
- Spend less time wondering what you forgot
Terms: https://packrepeat.com/terms
