Access your accounts on the go with Cornerstone Bank Mobile Banking. Conveniently and securely access key banking services using Cornerstone Bank’s Mobile Banking application for iPhone and iPad. 
Features: View account balances, transact
bluejetty:00017763:ios.description:
Access your accounts on the go with Cornerstone Bank Mobile Banking. Conveniently and securely access key banking services using Cornerstone Bank’s Mobile Banking application for iPhone and iPad. 
Features: View account balances, transaction details and pending payments/transfers; view deposit and check images; pay bills to established payees; transfer funds between your Cornerstone Bank accounts; deposit checks quickly and easily by taking a picture of the front and back of the check. 
You can access Mobile Banking using your existing User ID and Password. Mobile Banking is currently offered to Personal Banking Customers only. To view Cornerstone Bank’s Privacy Policy, please visit www.cornerstonebk.com/privacy. 
Mobile Banking is offered as a free service to Cornerstone Bank Online Banking users. You may incur, and are responsible for, any charges assessed by your communications service provider. Please consult your service provider for details. 
Why we ask for permissions: Read phone status and identify; So we can made the app more secure against fraud. Take pictures and video: So you can take pictures of checks you wish to deposit. Full network access: So the app can communicate with Cornerstone Bank. To protect against fraud and identity theft, do not ever give out your User ID, password or financial information online or over the phone, unless you initiate the contact. Individuals posing as viable entities, such as banks, are illegally obtaining this information from unsuspecting online users. Cornerstone Bank will never initiate a request for this type of information.

bluejetty:00166142:ios.description:
• • • Cupla: The fastest way to a better relationship.• • • 
Because great relationships don’t just happen. They are planned together.
Cupla is the relationship app for couples who want to stay in sync, reduce mental load, improve communication, and plan life together more easily.
Cupla is the only app with university-backed research on its impact on relationships:
• 75% of users say Cupla reduces stress and friction in their relationship.
• 65% of users say Cupla helps them spend more quality time together.
Created by a real couple, Cupla is the original planning app trusted by 500,000+ couples to stay connected.
• • • A shared calendar built for couples.• • • 
Complete schedule visibility. See all of your calendars and work schedules together in one place and make plans that actually happen.
Cupla syncs with Apple, Google, Outlook, work rosters, and shared family calendars, so you can stay connected across work, life, and everything in between.
• View both schedules side by side
• Create shared events in seconds
• Add plans directly to your partner’s calendar
• Choose what to share with flexible privacy controls
More quality time, less mental load with To-dos and Lists made for real life
• Keep up with the details of life together without constant back-and-forth.
• Share chores, groceries, errands, and travel plans
• Assign reminders to yourself or your partner
• Keep track of the little things without nagging
• Turn everyday admin into shared teamwork
Wishlists made for two
• Save and organise the things you want to do together.
• Create wishlists for date ideas, gifts, travel, and future plans, all in one place.
• Found something on Instagram or TikTok? Save and share it instantly so nothing gets lost.
Key Dates and Quality Time features that enhance relationships
• Keep track of all of life’s important moments, from anniversaries and birthdays to upcoming trips, with Key Dates and countdowns.
• Set a goal for how often you want to go on date night and Cupla will send you helpful reminders to meet your goal.
• Relive past dates with the beautiful Memories feed.
• Widgets to keep your life together front and center.
Why couples love Cupla
“Cupla has changed everything. We finally plan dates around his crazy schedule, and we have chores organised so we’re contributing equally.”
“Cupla helps us feel more like partners in everything.”
“Finding time was tough. Cupla makes it fast and easy.”
Everything couples need to plan life together:
• Shared calendar for couples
• Wishlists for date ideas, gifts, and travel
• Shared to-dos, lists, and reminders
• Anniversary and event planning
• Cross-platform calendar syncing
• Private sharing controls
No more diary clashes, forgotten plans, or missed opportunities to connect.
Join the 500,000+ couples already using Cupla.
Download Cupla and start planning life together.
View the university-backed research - https://cupla.app/blog/2025-impact-report/
Terms & Conditions - https://cupla.app/terms/
Privacy Policy - https://cupla.app/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00098127:ios.name: CozyAI - AI Home Design
bluejetty:00098127:ios.summary:
Elevate your home in seconds—redesign rooms, stage properties, declutter photos, and plan beautiful outdoor spaces with Cozy AI, your personal Design Agent.
Just take or upload a photo, pick a style (or simply tell the agent what you want),
bluejetty:00098127:ios.description:
Elevate your home in seconds—redesign rooms, stage properties, declutter photos, and plan beautiful outdoor spaces with Cozy AI, your personal Design Agent.
Just take or upload a photo, pick a style (or simply tell the agent what you want), and get realistic, magazine-worthy results—no design skills needed.
Your Design Agent (Chat Edit + Precise Control)
Cozy AI isn’t just a style filter. It’s an interactive Design Agent that helps you iterate until it feels right: 
- Chat Edit: Describe your dream look in natural language (e.g., “make it warmer, modern, and brighter”).
- Reference-Guided: Upload an inspiration photo or moodboard—Cozy AI matches the vibe.
- Brush to Edit: Paint over a specific area to change only what you want (sofas, rugs, walls, cabinets, decor), while keeping lighting, perspective, and scale consistent.
Interior Design in One Tap
Turn any room into a new vision:
- Restyle & Style Matching: Try multiple aesthetics with consistent, realistic results.
- Virtual Staging: Fill empty rooms with furniture and decor—perfect for listings.
- Replace & Place: Swap furniture, art, lighting, or decor with precise edits.
- Removal (Declutter): Erase unwanted objects, stains, or distractions for a cleaner space.
- Enhance: Improve brightness, contrast, color, and clarity for photo-ready visuals.
Outdoor Design (Backyard, Front Yard & Garden)
Design your outdoor space like an interior—with styles + components you choose:
- Select an outdoor style (modern, cozy rustic, Mediterranean, Zen, tropical, etc.)
- Pick Exterior Type: Garden, Pool Yard, BBQ Area, Kids' Yard, Dining Yard and more
- Get a cohesive yard & garden redesign that feels practical, beautiful, and ready to build
Perfect For
- Homeowners & renters planning a refresh or renovation
- Real estate agents needing fast virtual staging
- Designers, creators, and DIYers exploring ideas and moodboards
- Anyone who wants to compare options, save versions, and share with family, contractors, or clients
Save your favorite designs, compare iterations, and share instantly. Download Cozy AI and start designing—inside and out.
We always welcome your thoughts and suggestions. You can contact us via cs@collov.com.
Terms of Service:
https://collov.ai/terms
Privacy Policy:
https://collov.ai/policy

bluejetty:00082395:ios.description:
Independent Health’s free MyIH app brings members the RedShirt® Treatment whenever and wherever they need it – with the convenience of finding a doctor or provider, access to their member ID card, benefits information and more!
Serving all of Western New York from its home in Buffalo, NY, Independent Health is a not-for-profit health plan dedicated to helping members get and stay healthy. Learn more at independenthealth.com.
App Features:
Find a Doctor – Search for a doctor, specialist, pharmacy, hospital or urgent care facility in your network quickly and easily. 
My ID Card – Access your member ID card to view and share at doctor appointments or whenever needed.
My Benefits* – View plan details and benefits – right on the spot – for everyone covered under your plan. 
My Deductible Tracker* – Check your status and always know where you stand in meeting your in-network deductible.
My Doctors - Access, manage and update your primary care providers. 
My Claims* - Check on the status of claims from your account – including provider details, cost share and Explanation of Benefits documents.
My Documents* - Review your personal plan documents, contract, and statements.
Secure Message Center - Receive and view your secure messages from Independent Health.
Health Extras* - View your Health Extras balance and monitor your activity.
Health Apps* - Access to tools and resources to help you better manage your health and achieve wellness goals.
Live Chat* - Chat with a member services representative about claims, benefits or any question you might have as it relates to your plan.
Safe and Secure – Create an Independent Health member account in the MyIH app or use your online member account to securely access your personal information. 
* Available on select plans.

HERE FOR YOU AND YOUR FAMILY
- We're open 7 days a week, including evenings and weekends
- Have your appointment at home, work or on the go
- Get expert medical advice
- Get same-day prescriptions sent to your local pharmacy
- Get a specialist referral
- Renew a prescription
- Let your child see a doctor from home
Livi provides high-quality care to anyone, whether you connect with your local healthcare provider or use our paid service. Just register in minutes and see how it can work for you.
TRUSTED BY PATIENTS
We’ve seen over 10,000,000 patients by video, and we’re rated 4.9/5 for a reason (or many). Here’s what patients have to say...
“Livi is so easy and safe to use. Doctors are kind and understanding.”
“Talked with a doctor within 5 minutes of asking. Brilliant!”
“Lovely doctor. Very engaging with my 5-year-old. Great service. Thank you!”
“I love this service. So important at the best of times and all the more when the NHS frontline is so overburdened.”
“What would usually take days was sorted within minutes – and on a Sunday afternoon!”
“Felt as though I was in the surgery across from my doctor – but in the comfort of home.”

- Fever

- Sinus problems

bluejetty:00066270:ios.description:
A native settlement management app for Kingdom Death: Monster.
At last, a fully featured settlement management app that runs right on your iOS device! No need for logins, no internet connection required, all your data stays right with you.
Scribe also supports local multiplayer over Wi-Fi LAN! No third party servers involved, your devices communicate directly to one another. Any changes are instantly visible to all other connected players. Internet multiplayer is also available for those not around the same table!
All data can easily be exported to a human readable JSON file. You can import it to a new phone, or back it up to the cloud to be sure you don't lose any data.
The core game and all currently released expansions are supported! You can even make your own custom expansions with whatever content you want!
For more information checkout the official wiki: https://gitlab.com/taboobat/kdm-app/wikis/Getting-Started
View terms of use here: https://gitlab.com/taboobat/kdm-app/wikis/Terms-of-Use
This application is not developed, maintained, authorized or in any other way supported by or affiliated with Kingdom Death or Adam Poots Games.

bluejetty:00022803:ios.summary:
PaymentWiser is a payment app that saves your money with only 0.5% additional fee. It replaces your credit card terminal and card reader with a simple, intuitive way to accept credit card payments on the go & online!
If you're looking for
bluejetty:00022803:ios.description:
PaymentWiser is a payment app that saves your money with only 0.5% additional fee. It replaces your credit card terminal and card reader with a simple, intuitive way to accept credit card payments on the go & online!
If you're looking for a simple POS or point of sale, an alternative credit card reader, or for a better payment app to help with credit card processing, we've got you covered!
As a no-code Stripe Terminal partner, your business can use any of the supported Stripe Terminals, in any of the supported Stripe countries to start collecting payments without a single line of code. Additionally, PaymentWiser supports Tap to Pay on iPhone; which turns an iPhone into a contactless (credit card or mobile wallet) payment terminal.
- Works With Stripe
If you already work with the best payments platform on the planet, sign in with your Stripe payments account, let us do some magic with Stripe Connect, and you’re up and running!
- Create charges in under 30 seconds
Tap out an amount, type a credit card number, and hit charge.
- 0.1% additional fee, less than 100% of other apps
There are no setup fees, no monthly charges, no minimums or no limits. You only pay 0.1% additional fee on top of Stripe’s standard fees. 
- Create a payment link and share it everywhere
Share your paymentlinks in emails, text messages, or all over social media. Accept secure payments from multiple online channels and customers. Easy online sharing lets you reach lots of potential customers with a single link.
- Built-in fraud detection & security
Automatically evaluate charges for fraud risk and block those fraudulent.
- Multi Currency
Charge in over 135 currencies. Let customers pay in their native currency, you get paid in yours.
- Tips & Receipts
An easy interface that you can hand to your customer for them to add percentage based tips! 
Receipts will be sent to your customers' email address automatically.
- SCA-Ready to meet Europe's PSD2 regulations
With built in support for 3D Secure 2, we've got Secure Customer Authentication covered. OTP, password, or biometric, let your customers choose!
- More Software, Less Hardware
A simpler alternative to Square Point of Sale, Clover Go and Quickbooks GoPayment

Mahalo is your guide to daily gratitude practice. All over the world, people who keep a gratitude journal or practice gratitude experience improved stress relief, anxiety relief, self-love, self-care, more mot
bluejetty:00034735:ios.description:
Make gratitude your attitude!
Mahalo is your guide to daily gratitude practice. All over the world, people who keep a gratitude journal or practice gratitude experience improved stress relief, anxiety relief, self-love, self-care, more motivation and improved mindfulness.
Mahalo is the easiest way to practice gratitude and make it a habit that you will do every single day. Each day a new gratitude practice will be available. When you open the app the first thing you will see is the newest practice for you to start. The practices are meant to take between two and ten minutes, they are meant to be short in part because practicing gratitude should impact the rest of your day outside of the time spent practicing in the app. After you have completed your daily practice the next practice will not be available until the following day. We suggest that you add reminders so it is easier to build the habit of practicing gratitude.
A gratitude diary is a sacred place where you can open up to yourself and explore your own thoughts and feelings. That means privacy is important: Any things that you write in a Mahalo practice is only for your eyes and is not available to anyone else.
Mahalo means thank you. Thank you for the life I live. Thank you for the good times and the bad. Thank you to myself for never giving up. Thank you.

Terms of Use: https://getmahaloapp.com/terms-and-conditions.pdf
We are just getting started here at Mahalo. If you have any feedback or suggestions please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at contact@freezegun.com. We would love to hear from you!

Astro Gold for iOS – Professional astrology tools - all in one powerful, easy-to-use app.
Astro Gold combines precision and flexibility for astrologers at every level. Generate precise birth charts, access rich interpretations, tailor char
bluejetty:00174966:ios.description:
Astro Gold for iOS – Professional astrology tools - all in one powerful, easy-to-use app.
Astro Gold combines precision and flexibility for astrologers at every level. Generate precise birth charts, access rich interpretations, tailor charts to your preferences and customise your experience with a wide range of display options. Save your charts locally or to iCloud Drive for seamless access across iOS and macOS.
FREE FEATURES
Astro Gold is free to download and includes a full-feature 7-day trial so you can explore everything before choosing a subscription or lifetime upgrade.
After the trial, you can continue using Astro Gold free with access to essential astrology tools and chart features.
• Create natal, transit and horoscope charts
• View beautiful high-resolution single, bi-wheel and tri-wheel charts
• Zoom and explore detailed chart wheels and aspect grids
• Read planetary placements, aspects and astrological symbol meanings
• Access beginner-friendly interpretation text for signs, houses and aspects
• Print or share chart wheel images
• Save charts locally or with iCloud Drive sync
• Import and export chart files, compatible with Astro Gold for macOS and Solar Fire workflows
• Customize chart styles, colors and display settings
• Add Home Screen widgets with natal and transit chart displays
GOLD LEVEL FEATURES
Unlock the complete professional astrology experience with a one-off lifetime purchase or flexible subscription.
A no-commitment 7-day free trial is included.
Gold Level is designed for professional astrologers, advanced students and dedicated astrology enthusiasts who want deeper predictive and chart analysis tools.
• Secondary progressions, directions, solar return, lunar return and composite charts
• Advanced predictive astrology tools for transits, progressions and directions
• Dynamic transit tracking with extensive configuration options
• Essential Dignities and Midpoint Sort listings
• Expanded orb, zodiac, chart point and house system settings
• Full chart management and editing tools
• Advanced transit widgets for lunar, inner and outer planet activity
• More customization and professional workflow controls
PRO REPORTS
Generate beautiful professional astrology interpretation reports in PDF format for yourself or clients.
Reports are available as optional one-time in-app purchases and can be shared, printed or saved.
• Birth Chart Report
• Child Report
• Relationship Compatibility Report
• Predictive Report (12 Months)
• Big Three Report — Sun, Moon & Ascendant
• Solar Return Birthday Report
• Lunar Return Report
• Pet Astrology Report
ASTRO MAPPING ADD-ON
Explore powerful astrocartography and relocation astrology with the optional Astro Mapping add-on purchase.
Astro Gold’s advanced mapping tools allow you to:
• Display astrocartography and local space lines over interactive maps
• Zoom all the way into your suburb, street or neighbourhood
• Save personalised locations such as Home, Work or Travel destinations
• Relocate charts anywhere in the world
• Generate relocation reports
• View on-screen location interpretations
• Map eclipse lines and planetary influences globally
Designed specifically for iPhone and iPad, Astro Mapping brings professional astrolocality tools into a fast, intuitive mobile experience.
TECHNICAL DETAILS
• Powered by the highly accurate Swiss Ephemeris
• Includes ACS Atlas with 250,000+ locations and historical timezone support
• Supports many house systems and sidereal zodiacs
• Accurate chart calculations from 1200 BCE to 2400 CE
• iCloud support for syncing charts across compatible iOS devices
• Compatible with Astro Gold for macOS workflows
Terms of Use - https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Bible studies in depth for every christian

Bible Studies in depth on the basic Christian doctrine that every believer should know. These principles must be incorporated in us to know more and more
bluejetty:00138573:ios.description:
Bible studies in depth for every christian
The most complete Bible Studies in depth
Bible Studies in depth on the basic Christian doctrine that every believer should know. These principles must be incorporated in us to know more and more this wonderful God that we have.
In Christianity, Bible study is the study of the Bible by ordinary people as a personal religious or spiritual practice.
While personal, devotionally-oriented Bible study is very important, as is family Bible study, Bible studies in depth by definition digs deeper into God's Word in order to gain a better understanding of the truths contained in it.
Our goal is to help Christians grow in their faith and Bible knowledge while helping them to explore and study the meaning of scripture as it relates to the entire Bible taking into context the meaning of the surrounding chapter, book and verses as well as the historical.
Since in-depth Bible study generally involves research into the authorship and dating of biblical manuscripts, as well as interaction with criticism of the biblical record, it's helpful to have or seek to pursue greater knowledge of the Bible so that we can study it better.
Some of the biblical studies you will find in this application:
- Pentecost and New Birth Realities
- Jesus and prayer
- God loves us
- Judas' death and its timing
- The armor of God
- Who is the author of the Bible and who wrote it?
- On the interpretation of the Bible
- II Timothy 3:16-17: the usefulness of the Bible
- Eve in Genesis
- The temptations of Jesus
- On the perpetual virginity of Mary
- About the wise men
- Jesus the Son of David
- Was Jesus born on the 25th of December?
- Spoken vs Written
- The Church: Its definition, its head and its members
- The genealogies of Jesus Christ
- The two "fields" of blood
- Esther and the delivering power of God
- Gideon and how God worked with him
- Jesus Christ: The Redeemer
- Some of the things that Jesus Christ is
- The Parable of the Sower
- The Word of God is:
- Acts 16:6-40
- Born of God
- Cares, Prayer and Believing
- Occurrences of the words "Sheol" and "Hades" in the Bible
- What did Jesus really say to the criminal at the cross?
- God of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob
- Lazarus and the rich man
- Moses and Elias in the Lord's transfiguration
- 1 Peter 3:19 : The spirits in prison
- The enemy, the battle, and the winners
- Patience
- Before, Now and After
- The chastening of the Lord
- The heart
- The iniquity of Sodom
- Obedience to God
- The fear of the Lord
- John the Baptist: A God's General
- The mercy of the Lord
- Examine yourselves....
- Acts 16:6-10 or how Paul came to Europe
- The parable of the prodigal son
- Martha, Mary and Jesus
- Praise the Lord
- The parable of the widow
- Saul vs. David
- Rest in the Lord
- Is resignation a solution?
- The way of Balaam
- Honor your father and mother
- Some thoughts on material possessions
- Beloved, now we are children of God
- Prophecy in 1 Corinthians 14
- Church (ecclesia) and her head
- Decision making and its effects: an example from Paul’s trip to Rome
- Paul and Philemon
- Does God condemn the sinner?
- “Wretched man that I’am” – A brief commentary on Romans 7
The app also contains:
-Bible Verses by topic: Topical Bible Verses with hundreds of Bible verses separated by over 153 different topics.
-Theology Dictionary: Completely offline so that you can consult when you want all the definitions and terms about theology.
- Audio Bible: listen to all chapters you want of the Bible
Pastors as well as leaders or seminary students can take advantage of these resources that will be of blessing, when preparing sermons, teachings or the reason to enrich their own knowledge.
Study and explore the Bible for new testament and old testament Bible study. 
Choose the one that best suits you and take another step to be closer to our Lord Jesus Christ.
Download Bible studies in depth , this will help you better understand the Bible and the Word of God

Join Barbie, Barbie, Teresa, and Renee as they investigate the cause of a mysterious pink fog that disrupted their slumber party—erasing memories, altering familiar places, and leaving them with unanswered questions. Now, every corner of their world conceals puzzles waiting to be solved.

Easily track every ride with the official (and free) Cannondale app. Use your phone GPS or integrated Wheel Sensor (included on most new Cannondale bikes). See the fitness and eco benefits of riding your bike, register for your warranty, and get detailed bike info and service reminders to help care for your Cannondale.
KEY FEATURES
RIDE TRACKING & ANALYSIS
A beautiful Ride Screen displays your most important metrics in real time, with support for dark mode, landscape mode, customizable fields, maps, and Garmin Varia radar integration. After your ride, the new Ride Analysis screen lets you dive deep into your performance with second-by-second data, interactive maps, ride graphs, and detailed statistics. bluejetty:00120869:ios.name: ArtCard - Quick Art
bluejetty:00120869:ios.summary: ArtCard is a powerful app that transforms every photo instantly into a stunning piece of art. Download ArtCard for free and enjoy amazing photo-to-painting effects. ArtCard was created to make awesome pictures, to try out different painting
bluejetty:00120869:ios.description:
ArtCard is a powerful app that transforms every photo instantly into a stunning piece of art. Download ArtCard for free and enjoy amazing photo-to-painting effects. ArtCard was created to make awesome pictures, to try out different painting styles and to play around with new photo filters. 
With ArtCard, you have the right tool to create incredible results out of your photos. Our team is constantly working on new effects and filters that will make your photos stick out of the mass. For that, we use a powerful combination of artificial intelligence and image filters. We extract personal styles of famous artists, e.g., from Munch, van Gogh, or Picasso, and apply them to your photos. 
You don’t need a subscription for ArtCard! You will get all these features for free:
- Transform as many photos as you like into art
- Apply powerful photo effects instantly on your iPhone
- Play around with the intensity of each effect
- Apply the color of the effect or keep the colors of your photo
As a plus we work to together with MyPostcard (www.mypostcard.com) to offer an integrated postcard service. They will send your awesome results as a real postcard for only $2.69, including free shipping! Keep in touch with your friends and family all over the world in a fun and easy way. Surprise them with a postcard on any occasion. Use ArtCard to send greetings from your travels and vacations, or send a postcard as greeting card for a birthday, anniversary, to say thank you, or just because you’d like to say "Hi!". We’ve also teamed up with CanvasPop to offer a printing service with a 100% "Love it" guarantee. Have your favorite artwork printed on canvas or as a poster and delivered straight to your door. Even large sizes are not a problem thanks to our high-quality, high-resolution technology.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
- Select a photo from your library
- Crop your photo into the right format to prepare it for sharing
- Choose a photo effect to create art in one touch
- All effects are free to use! Try sparkle and glitter effects, pastel colors or choose the style of an famous artist that was extracted with the help of artificial intelligence 
- Change the intensity of the photo effect and/or enable/disable the color transfer
- Save your painting in high-resolution
- Share your art on social media like Instagram and Facebook
- Print your results with our integrated printing services, e.g., order a postcard for just $2.69 (includes free shipping!)
ArtCard’s goal is to make state-of-the-art technology of image stylization in high-resolution available to everyone. What’s different to other apps? We combine styles of famous artists with traditional image filtering techniques, e.g. with oil painting, watercolor or cartoon effects. Your photos will convert instantly, using the power of your device. All of your photos and artworks created with ArtCard won’t leave your iPhone until you say so.
READY FOR MORE?
If you love the effects of ArtCard, you should try out BeCasso, too. It’s our premium app that gives you more than 2 Million possible effects to build on your own. Freely combine and edit different styles with traditional image filters (oil painting, watercolor, sketch and cartoon effects). You will be also able to add colors filter, vignettes, frames and more. BeCasso lets you transform your photos in every way you like!
FOLLOW US
Facebook: http://facebook.com/becassoapp/
Twitter: http://twitter.com/becassoapp/
Instagram: http://instagram.com/becassoapp/
SUPPORT
If you have any questions or feedback for us, please feel free to send us an email at support@digitalmasterpieces.com.
Optimized for iOS 18, the iPhone 16, iPhone 16 Plus, iPhone 16 Pro and iPhone 16 Pro Max.

bluejetty:00188143:ios.description:
The All-New FREE Superbook Kid's Bible app brings the Bible to life for the entire family with a full Bible, videos, images and engaging interactive games. Featuring sixty eight (68) full-length, FREE EPISODES from the Superbook series including David and Goliath, The Ten Commandments, Daniel and the Lions’ Den, The First Christmas and more Bible stories!
Some of the episodes included in the Superbook children’s Bible app are:
• In The Beginning
• The Test!
• Jacob and Esau
• Let My People Go!
• The Ten Commandments
• A Giant Adventure
• Roar!
• The First Christmas
• Miracles of Jesus
• The Last Supper
• He Is Risen
• The Road to Damascus
• Revelation
• Jonah
• Joseph and Pharaoh's Dream
• The Fiery Furnace
• Rahab and the Walls of Jericho
• Esther: For Such a Time as This
• John the Baptist
• Paul and the Shipwreck
• Job
• Noah and the Ark
• Gideon
• Peter's Denial
• The Prodigal Son
• Elijah and the Prophets of Baal
Other aspects of the Superbook children’s Bible app include:
FUN BIBLE GAMES FOR KIDS
• Play more than 20 fun Bible games.
• Includes Trivia Bible Games, Word Bible Games and Action Bible Games.
• Earn XP points to level up your character as you engage with Bible game content.
DYNAMIC CONTENT WITHIN THE BIBLE 
• Videos and interactive content embedded within the Bible, so kids can easily interact with each chapter of the children's Bible.
• Biblical answers to hundreds of questions that are common to children. 
• This free kids Bible app also includes profiles of people, places and artifacts found in the Bible.
• Over 80 topics for children to learn about from a Biblical worldview such as anxiety, shyness, friends, self-image, wisdom, prayer, and more. 
ENGAGING VISUALS
• 68 full-length, free episodes from the children's Bible animation series - SUPERBOOK.
• Dozens of dynamic video clips from the SUPERBOOK animation series.
• Images of Bible characters, places and artifacts enhanced with detailed biographies.
INTERACTIVE BIBLE ENGAGEMENT
• Quests – New fun, interactive devotionals to learn more about your relationship with God.
• Find Biblical answers to questions that are important to kids – questions about life, heaven, Jesus and the Bible – in the SUPERBOOK Q&A Contraption.
• 20+ fun Bible games that you can download and play anytime, anywhere
• Choose the right answer in an engaging Bible trivia game – important questions for kids with fun Biblical answers.
• Try to find all of the hidden words in a challenging Word Search game.
• Decode Bible verses before time runs out in the exciting, new Bible Verse Scramble game
• Experience a kid-friendly sharing of the Gospel message.
CUSTOM CHARACTERS
• Play games, earn SuperPoints, and get cool clothes for your Superbook character.
PERSONALIZATION
• Create notes with text, verses, drawings, and stickers and attach them to Bible verses.
• Favorite/bookmark Bible verses that you like.
• Highlight passages with multiple color choices.
• Add your own photos within the kid's Bible, so that you can make a personal connection with a verse. 
• A complete collection of your notes, favorite verses and personal photos can be accessed from the My Stuff area of the children's Bible app.
• You can also choose different fonts and font sizes, change your screen to have a cool black background with white letters and trade out the background of the home screen to different images like heaven or the temple in Jerusalem.
OTHER FEATURES OF THE SUPERBOOK BIBLE APP FOR KIDS
• The SUPERBOOK Free Kids Bible App includes multiple Bible versions plus audio for the New Living Translation.
• A search function that will allow you to search the Bible or to search features and interactive content within the kids Bible
• You can also email your favorite verses, personal photos with related Bible verses and your notes to friends.
So download the SUPERBOOK kids Bible app and get ready to start the adventure of a lifetime!

bluejetty:00097182:ios.description:
Alpheva AI is the financial operating system built for high-income households.
Designed for households earning $200K+ annually, Alpheva AI helps optimize your financial life across taxes, investing, debt, insurance, cash flow, estate planning, and long-term wealth management.
Most financial tools operate in silos.
Investments are managed in one app. Taxes live in spreadsheets. Debt decisions happen separately from long-term wealth planning. Insurance is rarely optimized alongside the rest of your finances.
Major financial decisions like buying or selling assets, refinancing loans, optimizing taxes, planning retirement, or coordinating estate planning are often handled independently without understanding their broader financial impact.
Even financially sophisticated households often miss how these decisions impact one another. Alpheva AI continuously identifies hidden financial opportunities many high-income households miss.
By combining advanced AI systems with human financial expertise, Alpheva helps uncover opportunities across your financial picture so you can make smarter, coordinated financial decisions with confidence.
Alpheva users identify an average of $23,000+ annually in financial optimization opportunities.
Built with enterprise-grade infrastructure, bank-level encryption, and secure financial connectivity, Alpheva AI delivers a modern wealth optimization experience for affluent households with complex financial lives.
WHAT ALPHEVA AI HELPS YOU DO
• Optimize taxes, investing, debt, insurance, and wealth from one unified platform
• Build a complete financial view across bank accounts, investments, loans, income, expenses, assets, and goals
• Discover hidden financial opportunities and reduce costly inefficiencies
• Track net worth, cash flow, assets, liabilities, and financial progress in real time
• Receive personalized recommendations tailored to your financial behavior and goals
• Identify spending leaks, improve savings efficiency, and strengthen long-term financial outcomes
• Evaluate financial decisions across multiple domains instead of in isolation
• Navigate major financial decisions including asset purchases, refinancing, and long-term wealth planning
• Coordinate retirement and estate planning with a more complete financial picture
• Access hybrid financial guidance powered by AI and human expertise
• Stay protected with enterprise-grade security, encryption, and privacy controls
BUILT FOR MODERN HIGH-INCOME HOUSEHOLDS
Whether you're optimizing RSUs, managing multiple properties, balancing taxes with long-term investing, planning for children’s education, evaluating major buy or sell decisions, or coordinating retirement and estate planning, Alpheva AI helps simplify financial complexity while keeping you in control.
No more fragmented tools. No more disconnected financial decisions. No more guessing whether your money is working efficiently.
WHY HIGH-INCOME HOUSEHOLDS USE ALPHEVA AI
As income grows, financial decisions become more interconnected and harder to optimize manually.
Taxes impact investments. Debt impacts cash flow. Insurance decisions affect long-term wealth outcomes. Asset purchases and estate planning can create ripple effects across your broader financial life.
Most households lack a unified system that continuously evaluates how these decisions work together.
Alpheva AI is designed to solve this problem.
The platform continuously analyzes your finances to surface high-impact opportunities across your financial life, helping households improve long-term financial outcomes with greater clarity and control.
ENTERPRISE-GRADE SECURITY
• Bank-level encryption
• Secure account connectivity
• Privacy-first infrastructure
• Enterprise-grade compliance
• Built in the U.S.A.
Alpheva AI helps high-income households move from fragmented financial management to coordinated financial optimization.
Optimize your financial life with greater clarity, confidence, and control.

bluejetty:00074241:ios.summary:
12 Step Toolkit – Everything AA Members Need for Daily Recovery
12 Step Toolkit is a complete set of recovery tools designed to support your journey—day by day, step by step. Built around the principles found in the Big Book of Alcoholics
bluejetty:00074241:ios.description:
12 Step Toolkit – Everything AA Members Need for Daily Recovery
12 Step Toolkit is a complete set of recovery tools designed to support your journey—day by day, step by step. Built around the principles found in the Big Book of Alcoholics Anonymous, this app combines guidance, inventories, readings, and practical utilities to help you stay connected to your programme.
Whether you are new to recovery or continuing your journey, 12 Step Toolkit keeps everything you need in one secure, easy-to-use place.
KEY FEATURES
IN-APP SPONSORSHIP
• Connect with thousands of sponsors and sponsees worldwide
• Find a sponsor
• Add sponsees
• Secure, instant in-app messaging
BIG BOOK & STEP WORK
• Full 164 pages of the Big Book of Alcoholics Anonymous
• 70+ additional stories from early editions
• Step-by-step guides on how to work all 12 Steps
• Dedicated sections for completing your own step work
RECOVERY CALCULATOR
• Track your clean or sober time with detailed statistics, averages, and milestones
INVENTORIES & DAILY PRACTICES
• Comprehensive Step 4 moral inventory
• Step 10 spot-check tool
• Interactive “On Awakening” inventory
• Nightly review with reminders
• Hourly mindfulness and consciousness reminders
READINGS & PRAYERS
Readings included:
• AA Preamble
• How It Works
• The 12 Traditions
• Promises (pp. 83–84)
• Just For Today
• On Awakening
• On Retiring
• A Vision For You
Prayers included:
• Serenity Prayer (standard and extended)
• 3rd Step Prayer
• 7th Step Prayer
• 11th Step Prayer
• The Lord’s Prayer
GRATITUDE, NOTES & SHARING
• Create gratitude lists
• Write personal notes and reflections
• Share inventories, lists, and notes using standard iOS sharing tools
PRIVACY & SECURITY
• PIN lock
• Face ID and Touch ID support
• Local-only storage for your step work, inventories, and notes
WORK ALL 12 STEPS – RIGHT INSIDE THE APP

bluejetty:00140804:ios.description:
+++ As Seen on Reddit +++
Smash planets. Build solar systems. Rule the Milky Way.
Milky Way: Cosmic Playground is the space sim where real physics meets pure sandbox fun — rated 4.7 stars by 2,500+ players. Every star, planet, moon, and meteor obeys genuine Newtonian gravity, and every collision runs on SPH simulation (smoothed particle hydrodynamics), the same math astrophysicists use. Nothing is scripted. Everything is yours to cause.
Ever wondered what really happens when an asteroid hits Earth? Stop wondering. Trigger a meteor shower and watch meteors streak across the sky. Send a single meteorite down in slow motion and zoom in as it carves a glowing crater. Then scale up to a full asteroid impact and rewrite geology. This is your cosmic playground: no fail states, no waiting — just gravity, matter, and imagination.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Run a planet collision simulation with real SPH physics — worlds splash, shatter, and re-form differently every time
• Rain meteor showers and asteroid impacts on Earth or any world you build
• Grow planets from a spinning protoplanetary disk, like a true solar system simulator
• Give any planet a ring system worthy of Saturn
• Merge entire galaxies in 3D — stage the far-future collision of the Milky Way galaxy and Andromeda tonight
• Spawn black holes and watch them feed, bending orbits and swallowing suns
• Launch spacecraft and satellite constellations into orbits you designed yourself
• Send comets sunward and watch their tails bloom (new Comet Tails update)
• Go head-to-head in Planet Rivals mode
• Sandbox freely as a space crash simulator, a planet simulator, and a gravity toy in one
REAL SCIENCE UNDERNEATH
Milky Way is a space simulation toolkit disguised as a game. Orbits, slingshots, tidal forces, and accretion emerge from real physics — not animations — so you absorb genuine astronomy just by playing. Kids see wonder. Students see their textbook come alive. Space lovers finally get a laboratory that fits in a pocket.
ENDLESS EXPERIMENTS
Build a double planet and test its stability. Find the exact asteroid size where "crater" becomes "extinction." Comb a debris field into rings. Rescue a doomed solar system using only gentle nudges. Then zoom out from a single cratered moon to two colliding galaxies you set in motion — few things on a phone feel this enormous.
ALWAYS GROWING
Major free updates ship constantly — the latest BIG UPDATE rebuilt the 3D Galaxy Merger, Comet Tails, and Planet Rivals. Rated 4+ for all ages.
Download free and start rearranging the universe. The Milky Way took 13 billion years to form. See what you can do with it before your coffee cools.

bluejetty:00090510:ios.description:
A simple, no-frills, bike computer to mount on your handlebars. No account required.
FREE FEATURES:
- Apple Watch app streams stats to your phone or works independently
- Keeps a history of all of your rides
- Load and follow routes from GPX files
- Export rides as GPX files
- Live Activity support
- Always-on screen automatically turns off at 5% battery remaining
- Customizable units
- Battery-efficient
- No account required
- Large, easy-to-read stats
- Saves cycling workouts to Apple Health
- Autopause and autoresume
- Shortcuts app integration
- Lock and Home Screen widgets
- Rides, Routes, and Settings sync across devices on the same iCloud account (review your Rides on an iPad!)
PRO FEATURES:
- Historical ride weather review
- Route weather 5-day forecast 
- OpenStreetMap, OpenCycleMap, and High Contrast maps
- Customizable stat views
Designed for BATTERY LIFE:
- Dark theme minimized battery drain from screen
- Only updating stats as necessary
Designed for PRIVACY:
- No account signup, ever
- No usage tracking libraries added
- Optionally keep all data on-device by disabling iCloud sync
Stats displayed:
- Total Distance
- Total Duration
- Speed: Current/Average/Max
- Elevation: Current/Gained/Lost
- Time of Day
This app does NOT:
- Sync with any other cycling/fitness service
- Connect to any hardware devices
- Collect any personally identifiable information
NOTE: In-app purchases are required to unlock Pro features.
Mini Bike Computer integrates with Apple Health to save workouts and estimate calories burned, and uses Motion data to help with auto pause and auto resume.
Privacy Policy: https://bikecomputer.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00156837:ios.description:
YMCA Central Florida App: Healthy in Spirit, Mind, and Body
Achieve your fitness and health goals in a fun, intuitive way.
The official YMCA of Central Florida App is your digital companion for a healthier spirit, mind, and body. Exclusively for our members, this app connects you with your local Y community and provides powerful tools to track your progress, book classes, and stay motivated - anytime, anywhere.
YOUR YMCA EXPERIENCE AT A GLANCE
Discover everything your family center has to offer in one place. Browse the Programs & Classes schedule, discover new services, and find the activities that interest you most.
PERSONALIZED TRAINING & COACHING
Whether you are training at the Y, at home, or outdoors, the app acts as your hand-on virtual coach.
• Precision Programs: Get a customized training plan - including cardio, strength, and group classes - tailored to your specific goals and available equipment.
• Guided Workouts: Let the app lead you through your routine with exercise instructions and demo videos, automatically tracking your results as you go.
• Create Your Own: Prefer a DIY approach? Build your own custom cardio or strength workouts from our extensive library of exercises.
STAY CONNECTED & BOOK ON THE GO
• Class Reservations: Easily find your favorite group exercise classes and book your spot directly in the app.
• Challenges: Join community challenges to get healthy with others, test your limits, and climb the leaderboard.
• Y News: Stay up to date with the latest wellness tips, nutrition advice, and community stories from our News & Blog.
MONITOR YOUR MOVEMENT
Everything you do counts. The app tracks your activity through MOVEs (units measuring intensity) and MOVERGY (your two-week activity trend).
• Wellness Passport: Keep a detailed record of your body measurements and fitness progress over time.
• Third-Party Sync: Automatically log your outdoor activities by syncing with Apple Health, Fitbit, Garmin, MyFitnessPal, Strava, and more.
Note: This app is an exclusive benefit for members of the YMCA of Central Florida. Access is provided as part of your membership activation. There are no in-app purchases or upsells - just the tools you need to reach your goals.

bluejetty:00088265:ios.description:
Blockdit เป็นแพลตฟอร์มสำหรับผู้ที่มองหาไอเดียใหม่ ๆ ซึ่งกำลังเป็นที่นิยมในกลุ่มคนที่หลงใหลในการอ่าน เขียน เล่าเรื่องราว และต้องการสร้างสรรค์สังคมให้ดีขึ้นในเรื่องที่พวกเขาสนใจ
Blockdit ไม่มีระบบเพื่อน ทำให้เราสามารถโฟกัสเฉพาะเรื่องราวที่เราติดตาม เพจ หรือนักเขียนที่เราชื่นชอบ ซึ่งทำให้เกิดไอเดียใหม่ได้ เข้ามาร่วมเป็นส่วนหนึ่งกับสังคมได้ที่นี่
ทำความรู้จักกับสังคมใน Blockdit 
นักทำคอนเทนต์
- แชร์ไอเดียของเรา ผ่านบทความ วิดีโอ และพอดแคสต์
- มีระบบสร้างรายได้
- สนุกไปกับฟีเจอร์สำหรับนักทำคอนเทนต์โดยเฉพาะ เช่น โหมดร่างไอเดีย ตั้งเวลา ดูข้อมูลเชิงลึก
นักอ่าน
- รับไอเดียใหม่ๆ จากผู้คน และเพจมากมาย
- มีคอนเทนต์จากหลายหมวดหมู่ให้ติดตาม
- เลือกติดตามนักเขียนได้ตามความสนใจ และสามารถให้รางวัลแก่โพสต์ที่เราชื่นชอบ
- แสดงความคิดเห็น หรือส่งข้อความโดยตรงไปหาเพจเพื่อใกล้ชิดกับผู้สร้างคอนเทนต์
แล้ว Blockdit มีจุดเด่นอะไร จะทำให้เกิดไอเดียได้อย่างไร? 
- คอนเทนต์หลายประเภท
บางคนเกิดไอเดียจากการอ่าน แต่บางคนชอบฟัง หรือดูภาพเคลื่อนไหว แพลตฟอร์ม Blockdit จึงตอบโจทย์การหาไอเดียด้วยคอนเทนต์หลายประเภท รวมอยู่ในแพลตฟอร์มเดียว ทั้งบทความ พอดแคสต์ วิดีโอ และซีรีส์ (คอนเทนต์ที่มีเนื้อหาหลายตอน ต่อเนื่องกันมารวมอยู่ในโพสต์เดียว) 
- ฟีเจอร์ช่วยให้อ่านเรื่องยาว ๆ ได้สนุกขึ้น 
ด้วยฟีเจอร์กล่องข้อความ หรือ บล็อก (Block) เนื้อหาจะอยู่ในรูปของกล่อง ไม่ติดกันเป็นพืด ง่ายต่อการอ่านบทความเรื่องยาว อีกทั้งยังมีฟีเจอร์รูปภาพประกอบระหว่างเนื้อหา ซึ่งจะทำให้อ่านบทความได้อรรถรส และสนุกมากขึ้น
- ฟีเจอร์อ่านโพสต์ให้ฟัง
อยากได้ไอเดียจากบทความ แต่ไม่สามารถมองหน้าจอ แอปพลิเคชัน Blockdit มีฟีเจอร์อ่านออกเสียงโพสต์ให้ฟัง (Read post) โดยที่เราไม่ต้องอ่านเอง
- แนะนำโพสต์ที่เกี่ยวข้องให้ดูต่อ
เมื่อคุณเข้าไปอ่านบทความแล้วสไลด์จอขึ้น ก็จะพบโพสต์ที่เกี่ยวข้อง (Related Posts) ซึ่งนำเสนอเพื่อให้คุณได้รับข้อมูลที่หลากหลายด้าน จากมุมมองของนักเขียนหรือเพจอื่น ๆ ซึ่งจะทำให้ผู้อ่านมีวิจารณญาณในการตัดสินใจ และได้ไอเดียจากเรื่องนั้น ๆ มากยิ่งขึ้น
- โนติแจ้งเตือนเรื่องน่ารู้ประจำวัน
อย่างน้อย 10 เรื่อง/วัน คือจำนวนเรื่องน่ารู้ ที่ผ่านการคัดสรรและส่งตรงถึงคุณ ทางข้อความแจ้งเตือนแอป (Notifications) คุณจะได้รับคอนเทนต์ทันสถานการณ์ ไม่ว่าจะข่าวสาร สาระ หรือคอนเทนต์ที่จะทำให้คุณเกิดไอเดียในแต่ละวัน
โดยสรุป ถ้าคุณกำลังมองหาไอเดียใหม่ๆ หรือ คุณต้องการแพลตฟอร์มที่ใช้ในการสร้างสรรค์สังคมให้ดีขึ้นในเรื่องที่คุณสนใจ Blockdit คือคำตอบสำหรับคุณ
Blockdit. Ideas Happen.

bluejetty:00159948:ios.description:
Introducing BAM: Your Essential Brand Asset Manager
Experience a new level of content management with BAM— an all-in-one app for content creation, organization, and sharing. Ideal for individual users, direct sellers, small businesses, and enterprise teams, BAM simplifies how you manage and share your brand assets.
Key Features:
• Effortless Organization: Store text, images, and links in sleek, customizable albums. Stay organized and always ready to impress. (Video storage available with Pro upgrade)
• Instant Sharing: Share content seamlessly across social, text, and email. One tap, and it's done. (Video sharing available with Pro upgrade)
• Custom Keyboard Integration: Access and share your content instantly from any app with our powerful custom keyboard.
• Collaborate with Ease: Join or create teams to streamline collaboration and boost productivity. (Joining teams is a Pro feature)
• Personalize Your Content: Use BAM's Creator Studio to add stickers, frames, text, and artwork. Make every piece uniquely yours and share it with the world.
• Stay Connected On-the-Go: Manage your brand from anywhere. BAM keeps your content at your fingertips, making organization and sharing a breeze.
• Freemium Model with Powerful Upgrades: Start free and enjoy core features. Upgrade for unlimited albums, advanced collaboration, video uploads, and more.
Who is BAM For?
• Direct Sellers: Access ready-to-use content, collaborate effortlessly, and grow your brand.
• Small Business Owners: Create stunning content with ease—no hassle, just results.
• Social Media Managers: Keep your content organized and consistent across platforms.
• Enterprise Teams: Collaborate globally with robust management tools. (Pro features available)
• Content Creators: Enjoy easy access to templates and powerful editing tools.
• Individual Users: Simplify content management and sharing with BAM's intuitive features.
Create. Organize. Share. Effortlessly.
With BAM's streamlined Content Library, creating, organizing, and sharing marketing assets is incredibly simple. Manage your content intuitively and fast. Always stay organized and ready to impress.
Express Yourself. Simply.

bluejetty:00116167:ios.description:
In an uncharted mythical world, calamities and monsters ravage the land. Survivors flee to Sanctuary, desperate to awaken the gods that vanished during Rangarok and reclaim their power.
Amidst the relentless cold, the embers of civilization flicker to life on this isolated island. But ravenous Blackforged, twisted by darkness, now stalk the wilds. Malevolent spirits from another time stir with sinister intent, and emboldened rival Tribes harbor ambitions of conquest...
As the Chieftain of your Tribe, how will you rise to the occasion and ensure your Tribe's survival?
Game Features:
[City-Building, Laidback Management]
Intuitive Simulation Gameplay: Build a thriving settlement of your own on a remote island. Easily manage every citizen's daily life, work, and relationships, and watch as their stories unfold through generations.
[Landscape or Portrait, Your Choice]
Freely Switch Between Modes: Play casually in portrait mode or switch to landscape mode for an immersive experience.
[Realistic World, Enhanced Strategic Depth]
Intricate Gameplay with Dynamic Environments: The shifting of seasons and day-night cycles hold the key to the Tribe's development speed. Master the elements to turn small gains into great victories.
[Free Movement, Tactical Battles]
Innovative Combat Mechanics and Systems: Commanders and Lieutenants fight alongside each other in battle. Manage and position four soldier types to outmaneuver foes and turn the tide of battle.
[Trade and Auction, Rapid Development]
Unique Auction System for Faster Growth: With a fair bidding system on Tribe Bounty, enjoy the thrill of an RPG raid in an SLG title.
[Unique Looks, Endless Customization]
Wide Variety of Cosmetic Items: With territory decorations, Hero skins, chat boxes, and portraits, create a Tribe that is uniquely yours.
[Roguelike Mechanics, Endless Exploration]
Open-World Inspired Design with Infinite Possibilities: Original roguelike gameplay where every expedition, from gathering resources to arming your Tribe, brings new excitement.

Join over 100,000 people going no contact. Break free from toxic exes, messy breakups, situationships and reclaim your peace.
Breakfree is the #1 no-contact recovery app, designed to help you heal, move on, and rebuild your life with intention. Whether you’re fresh out of a breakup or trapped in an on-off cycle, Breakfree gives you the tools to break the loop for good.
With a science-backed recovery system, real-time streak tracking, personalized healing tools, and relapse prevention features, Breakfree helps you stop the spiral, silence the chaos, and start over stronger.
No more checking your phone. No more false hope. Just healing.
WHY THOUSANDS TRUST BREAKFREE
RECLAIM YOUR POWER
Built on modern psychology and behavioural science, our structured no-contact system helps you detach, reset, and heal your nervous system. This is recovery for your mind and heart.
DAILY HEALING TOOLS
Use guided exercises, emotional check-ins, soothing articles, and emergency panic tools to stay grounded, especially when temptation hits hard.
THE ICK LIST
Never forget why you left. Build your own list of red flags and reminders for when you need strength.
LETTERS TO MY EX
Write what you wish you could say, and keep it private. Release the feelings without breaking no contact.
CURATED ARTICLES
Understand your triggers, patterns, and healing process through bite-sized, expert-informed articles.
HOME & LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
Track your no-contact streak without even opening the app. Keep your healing front and center.
TRACK YOUR STREAK
Count your no-contact days, monitor your emotional recovery, and watch your momentum build. Every hour you hold the line is a win.
STOP RELAPSING
Use smart reflection tools to identify your triggers, spot patterns, and prepare for next time before it happens again.
THE PLAN TO STAY FREE

bluejetty:00145365:ios.summary: Welcome to School Break: Obby School, where danger and adventure collide! Can you outsmart the evil Mr. Fat and make a daring prison escape from the haunted block school? This fast-paced runner game combines thrilling action with tricky obb
bluejetty:00145365:ios.description:
Welcome to School Break: Obby School, where danger and adventure collide! Can you outsmart the evil Mr. Fat and make a daring prison escape from the haunted block school? This fast-paced runner game combines thrilling action with tricky obby maps full of obstacles that will push your skills to the limit.
Features:
Escape the Block School: Navigate through creepy, abandoned hallways filled with deadly traps. Beware of Mr. Fat, the evil teacher on your trail!
Exciting Prison Escape Challenge: Can you survive the school obby and make your way out? Each map brings new surprises and escalating danger! 
Obby Maps and Challenges: Jump, slide, and dodge your way through a variety of obby maps packed with difficult obstacles. Each level is a new adventure! 
Joystick Controls: Use the joystick to steer your character through the block school, make precision jumps, and dodge deadly traps!
Thrilling Gameplay: Intense runner action and heart-pounding moments filled with mystery and suspense!
How to Play:
Use the joystick to move through the eerie halls of the block school. 
Jump over obstacles, dodge traps, and uncover hidden escape routes. 
Be fast, because Mr. Fat is always chasing you—don’t let him catch you! 
Why Play:
Obby Escape: This game’s mix of action and puzzle-solving makes every run exciting! 
Challenging Obstacles: Only the fastest and smartest can escape the school. Are you up for the challenge? 
Mysterious School: Discover the dark secrets of the block school as you fight to survive! 
Compete and Escape: Test your skills and compete with friends to see who can escape the fastest! 
Don’t miss out! Download School Break: Obby School now and experience the thrill of escaping from Mr. Fat!

bluejetty:00179478:ios.description:
Discover tickets for concerts, theatre, sport, museums and exhibitions, festivals and family events. As the market leader and leading ticketing platform in Italy, TicketOne offers you access to over 200,000 events per year with the TicketOne APP. Discover new artists, stay reliably informed about your favourite events and get all the relevant information for your next event visit – conveniently, clearly and from a single source.
Features at a glance
• Seating plan booking: Select your preferred seat directly from the seating plan and flexibly choose the number of tickets you want.
• Event list: See at a glance when and where your desired event is taking place and conveniently save dates in your personal calendar.
• Personal home page: Keep an eye on your favourite artists and stay up to date.
• Favourite artists: Mark your favourites with a single click or import them from your local music library. 
• Favourite venues: Mark your preferred locations and receive early information about upcoming events, as well as helpful service information such as directions and parking options.
• Event inspiration: Discover selected events. With fan reports, you can find out what others like – and submit your own reviews.
• Secure account management: With your MyTicketOne account, you have access to digital tickets, orders and ticket alerts at any time.

bluejetty:00041152:ios.description:
Masimo SafetyNet does not provide medical or healthcare diagnoses, advice, or services, and is not a substitute for medical care.
Masimo SafetyNet is a secure cloud-based platform that allows providers to remotely manage patients using customized interactive digital CarePrograms.
CarePrograms offer a digital replacement for traditional home-care plans and are delivered to patients’ smartphones. The CareProgram actively reminds patients to follow their care plan, automatically captures monitoring data from the tetherless Radius PPG sensor, and securely pushes the data to clinicians at the hospital for evaluation.
Radius PPG sensors, powered by Masimo SET® measure-through-motion technology, provide continuous respiration rate and oxygen saturation monitoring via a tetherless, single-patient-use sensor.
Masimo SafetyNet integrates with Apple Health allowing users to share measurements collected from connected devices.

bluejetty:00161242:ios.description:
Speakometer is an AI-powered English pronunciation app for accent training, IPA guidance and spoken English practice. Improve British or American English pronunciation with instant feedback, IPA sounds and clear guided practice.
Say a word, get a pronunciation score, see which sounds need work and repeat with clear native-speaker examples. Speakometer helps you practice British English pronunciation, American English pronunciation and difficult English sounds.
Designed for learners who want practical accent training, better spoken English and a simple pronunciation practice app they can use every day.
Why choose Speakometer?
• AI pronunciation feedback: Get instant feedback on your spoken English using advanced pronunciation analysis. Learn which sounds you pronounce accurately, which need more practice and how to improve them.
• British & American English: Practice with British or American pronunciation models. Listen, repeat and compare your speech with clear examples, including Received Pronunciation (RP) British English.
• Personalised practice: Get practice suggestions based on your native language, learning history and progress, so you can focus on the English sounds that are most difficult for you.
• IPA & phonetic guidance: Use the International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) to understand how English words are pronounced. Learn vowels, consonants, stress patterns and spelling–sound differences.
• Minimal pairs and common mistakes: Train difficult sounds with minimal pairs, long and short vowels, voiced and voiceless consonants, word endings, silent letters and consonant clusters.
• 65,000+ English words: Search and practice thousands of English words. Hear pronunciations in British and American English, repeat them and track your progress over time.
• Progress tracking: Test your English pronunciation, follow your improvement and build a regular speaking habit with detailed practice history.
• Multilingual support: Use translations in 40+ languages to make English pronunciation practice easier for ESL and EFL learners.
Topics and word lists include:
• Top 3,333 English words
• Thematic word lists
• Commonly mispronounced words
• Long vs short vowels
• Voiced vs voiceless consonants
• Word endings: -ed and -s
• Silent letters and consonant clusters
• Irregular verbs and grammar-based pronunciation
• Received Pronunciation (RP British English)
Speakometer can help you:
• Improve pronunciation for study, work and travel.
• Practice clearer speaking for IELTS-style speaking tests and other English exams.
• Build confidence in daily conversation.
• Learn English sounds with IPA and phonetic examples.
• Reduce pronunciation mistakes linked to your native language.
Speakometer is free to download and includes optional subscription features.
Download Speakometer and start improving your English pronunciation today!

bluejetty:00092228:ios.description:
Welcome to Oxiline App – Your Ultimate Health Monitoring Companion
The Oxiline App seamlessly integrates with Oxiline health devices to bring your health data to life. Our app makes it easy to connect via Bluetooth, allowing you to visualize, track, and export your health measurements in real-time. Whether you're managing chronic conditions or simply committed to staying on top of your health, Oxiline Health Connect is here to empower you and support your journey.
Easy Device Integration: 
Connect effortlessly to your Oxiline health devices via Bluetooth to start tracking immediately.
Real-Time Data Visualization
Get instant access to your health metrics displayed in clear, easy-to-understand graphs and charts.
Comprehensive Health Overview: 
Monitor various health metrics, including blood pressure, heart rate, and more, all from the comfort of your phone.
Data Export Made Simple:
Share your health data with healthcare providers by exporting reports directly from the app, ensuring you receive the best care.
Track Your Progress: 
Keep an eye on your health trends over time, helping you understand the effectiveness of your health and wellness strategies.
Secure & Private: 
Your health data's security and privacy are our top priorities. Enjoy peace of mind knowing your information is protected with top-tier encryption.
Why choose Oxiline Health Connect?
Oxiline Health Connect is more than just an app; it's a partner in your health and wellness journey. Our intuitive design, coupled with powerful functionality, makes health monitoring accessible and straightforward. Stay motivated, informed, and connected with your health like never before.
Download Oxiline Health Connect today and take the first step towards a healthier, more informed you. Your health journey, visualized and simplified.
Have questions or need support? Visit our website www.oxiline.shop or contact our customer support team at support@oxiline.shop
For more information, please read our Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions available in the app or on our website.
Disclaimer:
This app is intended for health monitoring purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your doctor before making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00039142:ios.description:
Seven Hearts Stories is a collection of visual novels where the player is given the choice to influence the plot.
Have you ever dreamed of living the path of the main character determining his fate yourself? In this mobile game you can...
Customise your character's appearance from a wide variety of wardrobe choices!
Start romantic relationships with characters from the game and go on dates with them!
Make choices that affect the plot and get a unique ending!
Collect unique stats and CGs to brighten the game progress! 
Choose from a variety of game genres based on your own preference!
Choose one of our stories that you want to start from the following list:
Legend of the Celestials - The main character, one of the inhabitants of the heavenly world, goes to the human world to participate in a festival dedicated to the gods. But she violates the Rule of Heaven, so there’s no turning back to the heaven’s chancellery forever. Will she be able to return home?
The Villain’s Last Wish - The enigmatic stranger gave Elise a chance for a new life. From the joyless reality, full of disappointments, she was transported into a book. Now the heroine’s life is like a fairy tale. She is surrounded by princes and the luxury of the imperial palace. The dream has come true, but Elise finds herself in the body of the hated villain. Will she be able to change her fate?
The Era of Fate - The story of a chosen one who wakes up in a cave after five hundred years and doesn’t remember her past. She is the last mage and the fate of the future civilisation of this world is placed in her hands, because there’s long forgotten power within her.
The list of stories continues to grow, so stay tuned!
Collect hearts together with Seven Hearts Stories and enjoy your stay in our games.

bluejetty:00073061:ios.name: Nagarik App
bluejetty:00073061:ios.summary: Nagarik App (translation: Citizen App) is a mobile application launched by the Government of Nepal to provide government-related services in a single online platform. The app was developed to facilitate an easier, systematic, and simplified
bluejetty:00073061:ios.description: Nagarik App (translation: Citizen App) is a mobile application launched by the Government of Nepal to provide government-related services in a single online platform. The app was developed to facilitate an easier, systematic, and simplified delivery of government services to Nepali citizens digitally. The app was launched to play a pivotal role in revolutionizing the way citizens interact with the government. It offers a wide spectrum of government services through a single unified platform, minimizing the need for citizens to navigate multiple channels or physical offices for their diverse needs of government services. The services are added gradually according to the needs and services required. The government aims to reduce the physical queues and the need to be physically present to get services from the different government offices and promote digital transactions. One can get services online round-the-clock even during holidays. As of now, 25 services are included in the app, ranging from Police Clearance Report to Voters Card.

listings.name: 22SIM - Unlimited Data & More
listings.description:
Travel ready. Stay connected with 22SIM.

22SIM is a Gulf-based travel eSIM app for buying, installing and managing prepaid mobile data abroad. Find internet plans for 220+ countries & destinations, with access to 400+ networks worldwide. From family holidays to business trips and studying overseas, choose data that fits your journey.

WHAT IS A TRAVEL eSIM?
An eSIM is a digital SIM installed on a compatible device. Buy your plan and install it from the app or with a QR code, without swapping a plastic SIM, visiting a shop or waiting for delivery. Use mobile data for maps, messaging, bookings and your favorite internet apps.

A PLAN FOR YOUR TRIP
• Local eSIM plans for a single destination.
• Regional plans for trips across several countries.
• Global plans for journeys across continents.
• Unlimited data options for supported destinations.
Check each plan's coverage, validity and conditions before purchasing.

WHY TRAVEL WITH 22SIM?
• Activate in minutes with guided installation.
• Access speeds up to 5G, depending on the destination, network and device.
• See your remaining data in the app.
• Keep your home SIM in your device for your usual number.
• Get help from a human customer support team, including Arabic-speaking support.
• Join an app with 1.5M+ downloads.

MEET 22Connect
Travel often? 22Connect is a reusable global eSIM. Install it once and add eligible plans for future trips, instead of installing a new eSIM each time. Explore 22Connect and 22Connect Premium options in the app.

MORE FOR YOUR JOURNEY
Use handy travel tools including a currency converter, compass, world clock and unit converter.

GET CONNECTED IN THREE STEPS
1. Choose your destination and data plan.
2. Purchase and install your eSIM over Wi-Fi, preferably before departure.
3. On arrival, select 22SIM for mobile data and enable data roaming on that eSIM as instructed.

Keep data roaming off on your home SIM to avoid your home carrier's data roaming charges. Calls and SMS on your home line remain subject to your carrier's rates.

BEFORE YOU BUY
Your device must support eSIM and be unlocked for use with other carriers. Check compatibility in the app. Plan activation rules, coverage and speeds vary; review your chosen plan.

22SIM travel plans provide data only, without a phone number or standard voice calls. Use internet calling apps where available. Do not delete an installed eSIM unless instructed: deletion is permanent and it cannot be reinstalled.

Choose your destination. Get your eSIM ready. Travel with 22SIM.

Commander, use your extraordinary wisdom to start an exciting journey of legendary battles! During this journey, Caesar, Scipio, Hannibal... the legendary generals will fight for you! Rome, Samnium, Epirus, Carthage, you can choose from different nations! Recast the glory of war, and the empire will rise because of you!
『General』
「Diverse Legendary Generals」
Caesar, Scipio, Hannibal, Pyrrhus... Choose your legendary generals and create your own era!
「General Growth」Through continuous battles, your generals will continue to grow to obtain outstanding abilities and show extraordinary dominance on the battlefield!
「General skill」Every general has a wealth of skills, and different skill combinations may produce unexpected and amazing effects! The secret is waiting for you to explore!
『Battle』
「Diverse Campaign」Rome, Samnium, Epirus, Carthage. Different choices will open a different history! Fighting for the rise of Rome, or blazing a different path, is up to your wisdom. Write your own history and create a unique empire glory! 
「Return To The Ancient War」 Punic Wars, Pyrrhic Wars, Samnite Wars... The ancient wars will bring a brand new experience! You can not only experience the surging battles of ancient wars, but also feel the brilliance of history under different choices! Everything is no longer doomed! The ancient war will open up new glory, please do your best!
『troop』
「Unique Troops」 archer, cavalry, war elephant, ballista, catapult, warship... The extremely rich types of troops allow you to use a wealth of strategies. Let the enemy surrender at your feet!
「Troop Growth」A battle-tested soldier will have extraordinary combat effectiveness! Hone your troops on the battlefield, they will get a level upgrade, and the situation on the battlefield may change as a result!
「Troop Skill」 Tired of monotonously attacking each other? Don't worry, your troops will have different skills! Try to use your skills to control the battlefield!
『Strategy』
「Troops Balance」 Want to win with fewer? Want to make surprise attacks on the enemy? All this will be achieved by your strategy! There are different attribute restraints among the troops, reasonable use of the mechanism, the next second, you will be able to turn the tide and change the situation of the battle!
「Terrain Factors」 Plains, hills, mountains, oceans...Different terrain will bring unexpected changes to the war! Choose to cross the mountains and catch the enemy by surprise; or choose to attack head-on and defeat the opponent on the plains, commander, please choose your marching route! 
「Fortification」 Leading troops on the expedition will no longer be your only choice! Watchtowers, fortresses, walls, fences... a variety of fortifications allow you to choose from a wealth of war strategies! attack? Maybe wait a little longer! Consolidate your city, defend against the enemy's attack, and eliminate the enemy forces. The horn of counterattack will be sounded!

bluejetty:00064877:ios.description:
The First Foundation Bank (FFB) Mobile app powered by MX makes it even easier to manage your bank accounts and personal finances. By allowing you to securely connect all of your external accounts, you can see your full economic standing and create your own path towards financial wellness. It is comprehensive, intuitive, secure, and available anytime and anywhere you need it.
On top of the normal functionality you would expect, like viewing your account history, transferring funds, paying bills, and depositing checks, our new app provides a wide range of convenient features to help manage your personal banking and nurture your financial health.
With the FFB Mobile app you can:
Connect all of your external accounts to see your complete financial picture.
Receive personalized insights (“FinSights”) across all of your connected accounts to stay informed of any unusual activity, visualize your spending trends, predict potential overdrafts, and monitor your bills and subscriptions.
Review transaction details with merchant logos and clear descriptions, to easily identify purchases at a glance.
Track your overall financial health and strength with a “FinStrong” score, and learn about actions you can take to progress and attain your goals.
View your Statements, Notices, and Tax Documents for your deposit, loan, and CD accounts.
Send and receive external transfers from your other financial institution accounts.
Open additional checking and savings accounts from within the app.
Control and manage your First Foundation Bank debit cards to make purchasing more secure.
Check your credit score, review your credit report, and get tips on improving your credit.
Send and receive money securely to friends and family with Zelle® (1).
Disclosure: Some features are available for eligible clients and accounts only. There is no charge from First Foundation Bank, but message and data rates may apply. Such charges include those from your communications service provider. Delivery of alerts may be delayed for various reasons, including service outages affecting your phone, wireless or internet provider; technology failures; and system capacity limitations.

Prison Life: The Ultimate Prison Management Simulation Game
Are you ready to take on the challenging yet rewarding role of a prison manager? In Prison Life, you will manage every aspect of running a successful prison. From taking in new pr
bluejetty:00138648:ios.description:
Prison Life: The Ultimate Prison Management Simulation Game
Are you ready to take on the challenging yet rewarding role of a prison manager? In Prison Life, you will manage every aspect of running a successful prison. From taking in new prisoners to ensuring their basic needs are met, upgrading facilities, and managing your staff, your goal is to create the ultimate prison empire. Dive into this engaging simulation tycoon game and see if you have what it takes to control, expand, and level up your prison to new heights.
Key Features
• Manage Prisoners:
Take on the responsibility of running a bustling prison. From intake to release, you will manage prisoners' daily lives. Ensure their basic needs like food, hygiene, and recreation are met to keep them healthy and compliant. Balance the demands of maintaining order and keeping prisoners satisfied to prevent escapes and disturbances.
• Diverse Facilities:
Upgrade and manage a variety of facilities within your prison. Build and enhance gyms, mines, kitchens, and visiting rooms to improve prisoner satisfaction and productivity. Each facility offers unique benefits and challenges, adding depth to your management strategy.
• Expand Your Prison Empire:
As you progress, rank up your prison to unlock new facilities and expand your operations. The more you expand, the closer you get to building a world-renowned prison empire. Unlock advanced features and discover new ways to improve your prison's efficiency and security.
• Staff Management:
Your staff is the backbone of your prison. Hire and manage a diverse team of specialized prison officers to help you. Upgrade their skills and capabilities to ensure they perform their jobs efficiently. A well-trained staff is essential to maintaining order and security in your prison.
• Simulation and Casual Gameplay:
Prison Life : Idle Game combines the best elements of simulation and casual idle gaming. Enjoy a deep and engaging management experience with easy-to-learn mechanics. Whether you have a few minutes or a few hours, Prison  Life offers a rewarding gameplay experience that fits into your busy life.
Prison Life is not just a game; it's a simulation that mirrors real-world management challenges. From resource allocation to staff management, you'll develop skills that are applicable in various aspects of life. 
Download Prison Life : Idle Game today and start your journey towards becoming the ultimate prison tycoon. With its unique blend of strategy, simulation, and casual gameplay, Prison Life is the perfect game for aspiring managers and tycoons alike. What are you waiting for? Join the Prison operation community and build the prison empire of your dreams!
