bluejetty:00017347:ios.description:
With over 10 million downloads across the Sportsmate LIVE apps you know you’re in good hands.
The Union Live app by Sportsmate is the only way to stay up to date on everything Rugby Union. After a strong debut, Union Live has continued to innovate while still putting the fans first, bringing you everything that you need to be the most in-the-know rugby fan possible.
Built by rugby fans, for rugby fans, Union Live combines up-to-the-second live scores and stats from the Super Rugby, Rugby Championship, Six Nations and all major International Fixtures with the most in-depth statistical database, as well as exclusive analysis and the latest breaking rugby news and video highlights. 
Whether it’s an intense local derby, the colour of a Bledisloe Cup match or the drama of the final minutes of the Six Nations tournament or the biggest stage of them all, the World Cup - don’t just follow your favourite club, join them!
FOLLOW LIVE
Access live coverage of every Super Rugby, Rugby Championship, Six Nations Tournament and International Test match 
Live scores for each match
Play-by-play match commentary 
Detailed team stat sheets, team lists and score worms
Player specific stat sheets
TRACK YOUR FAVOURITE TEAM AND PLAYERS
Follow the progress of your club and your favourite players throughout the Super Rugby season.
Follow every thing to do with your club in the dedicated Team News tab
Prepare for every match by syncing your clubs fixtures to your calendar
Stay up to date with the latest club news and team tweets
Keep an eye on your favourite players
GET THE STATS
Need a hand with your fantasy team? Been thrown a thorny league question? Need the perfect Rugby Union trivia answer? Don’t worry we have you covered here too with a detailed database of team and individual player stats.
Up to date club and player stat rankings
Leaderboards for individual stats and KPIs 
Individual player profiles and career stats
Compare players head to head
STAY UP TO DATE
Union Live by Sportsmate also brings you the breaking Rugby news, along with exclusive match previews (and tips) as well as analysis from Sportsmate’s team of commentators from around the country.
A thorough overview of the day’s play from around the country via the Match Day tab
Access league news and updates about club teams
Watch and listen to videos and podcast series on demand
Personalise alerts so you never miss any of the action, league scores or latest news
DOWNLOAD NOW
Union Live by Sportsmate is available FREE for all Rugby Union enthusiasts in Australia and around the world. Don’t miss a minute, download now and start tracking live footy scores today!
FEEDBACK ALWAYS WELCOME
We’d love to hear from you how we could make the Union Live app even better. Please send all feedback to support@sportsmatemobile.com, tweet us at @Sportsmate or use the feedback form inside your app’s Settings.
ABOUT THE DEVELOPERS
Founded in 2009 and based in Melbourne, Australia, Sportsmate Mobile is an Independent Sports Media company which creates and distributes mobile applications focused on delivering lightning fast sport scores and stats to sports fans all over the world.
With over 10 million global downloads, we are Australia's number one sports app network. Our growing suite of apps is built by a dedicated team of sports mad app developers, designers and content creators who are passionate about delivering content sports fans crave.

bluejetty:00164054:ios.description:
Stampy is a complete assistant for stamp collectors.
Discover a smarter way to identify, explore, and organize postage stamps. The app helps collectors understand what they own and why it matters.
Smart features for every collector
— Instant stamp recognition. Take a photo of a stamp and receive information about its origin, rarity, and historical background.
— Collection management. Create digital albums, organize stamps by categories, search easily, and keep everything structured.
— Market value insights. Get estimated market values to better understand the potential worth of your collection.
Explore and learn
— Large stamp database. Access detailed information about stamps issued across different countries and periods.
— Historical context. Learn the stories behind stamps and their cultural and historical significance.
— Visual comparison. Find similar stamps to compare designs, details, and variations.
Tools for collectors of any level
— Condition assistance. Get guidance to help evaluate the condition of your stamps.
— Collection analysis. Identify missing items and understand how your collection can grow.
— Duplicate tracking. Keep records of duplicate stamps for easier organization and exchange.
Privacy and data safety
Your collection data is stored securely and remains private. Offline access is available so you can manage your collection even without an internet connection.
Important notice
All information provided in the app is for reference purposes only and may not be fully accurate in every case. For official identification, valuation, or authentication, consulting a professional philatelist or certified appraiser is recommended.
Stampy is suitable for everyone, from beginners identifying their first stamps to experienced collectors managing extensive and valuable collections.
Start exploring your stamp collection with confidence and clarity.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://nazarovkirill.tech/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00139910:ios.description:
Screen Mirror: Screen Casting Made Easy
Screen Mirror is a versatile and user-friendly screen-casting tool that lets you effortlessly mirror your screen to any smart TV connected to the same Wi-Fi network. With no delay, you can wirelessly mirror your mobile screen in real time, allowing you to showcase any content on a larger display.
Key Features:
Wireless Screen Mirroring: Mirror your mobile screen to any smart TV without the need for additional hardware, providing a seamless viewing experience.
Versatile Content Casting: Quickly cast games, videos, music, and more from your mobile device to your TV for an immersive entertainment experience.
Enhanced Presentations: Make your presentations more impactful by casting them on a bigger screen during business meetings or educational sessions.
Whiteboard Functionality: Use the built-in whiteboard feature to easily present and explain ideas in meetings, classes, or any other setting.
Online Classes and Meetings: Cast online classes or conduct smooth online meetings with live video streaming directly on your TV.
Family Gatherings: Share memories with loved ones by casting a memory album on the big screen at family parties or gatherings.
DLAN and AirPlay Support: Utilize DLAN and AirPlay projection methods for flexible and reliable screen mirroring options.
Screen Recording: Record your screen directly from the app for future reference or sharing.
Subscription Details:
Screen Mirroring offers premium features through auto-renewable subscriptions. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings.
For more details on managing subscriptions, visit: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy Policy: https://screen-mirroring.posterapplab.com/privacy_policy
Terms of Use: https://screen-mirroring.posterapplab.com/terms
Screen Mirror offers a seamless and convenient way to cast your screen to any smart TV, making it ideal for entertainment, education, and business purposes. Download Screen Mirror now and experience the convenience of wireless screencasting!

bluejetty:00159328:ios.description:

Senior care businesses using Caryfy software will have a built in integration for real time messaging and payments for services.

bluejetty:00186706:ios.name: Birds of Europe - Field Guide
bluejetty:00186706:ios.summary:

- BIRDS IDENTIFIER
The application has a built-in polytomic Bird
bluejetty:00186706:ios.description:
Professional Field Guide (Bird Identifier) for 515 bird species inhabiting Europe - from the Atlantic Ocean to the Urals, and from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea.
- BIRDS IDENTIFIER
The application has a built-in polytomic Bird Identifier (Identification Filter), which helps to determine the unknown bird by 24 different features. You can select the region of Europe, the size of the bird, plumage coloration, streaks, beak and feet shape and color, distinctive features of appearance, behavior, habitats, location of a sitting bird, song and calls, daily activity, nest size, shape, construction material and location, eggs size and color. The Identifier will help you to narrow down the range of species for unknown bird.
- TERRITORY OF USE
The application covers most of the territory of Europe and can be successfully used in the most part of Northern, Western, Central, Southern and Eastern Europe, including Scandinavia, Baltic States, France, Spain, Balkan countries, Transcaucasia, Northern Kazakhstan and other adjacent territories.
- EUROPEAN LANGUAGES
The app is composed on 20 European languages, including English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Hellenic and others. The user can choose any of these languages.
- BIRDS CALLS
For each of 515 bird species, the app provides one combined recording, including male songs and several most typical calls – alarm, aggression, interaction, contact and flight calls, etc. Each of the recordings can be played in four different ways: 1) once, 2) in a loop without interval, 3) in a loop with an interval of 10 seconds, 4) in a loop with an interval of 20 seconds.
- PHOTOS AND DESCRIPTIONS
For each species, a several photos of the bird in nature (male, female or immature, bird in flight), distribution maps and eggs are given, as well as a text description of the appearance, behavior, features of reproduction and feeding, distribution and migrations.
- BIRDWATCHING JOURNAL
Record the places and times of your bird encounters.
- IN-APP PURCHASES
The main functions of the application are free - for each species of bird, you can view its image and text description and add species to Favorites (these functions are available offline), as well as play a recording of its voice (if you have an Internet connection and no more than 1 time per minute). Paid functions allow unlimited use of the Identification Filter and Quiz, open access to additional color images, and also make it possible to play all recordings of bird voices offline. 
- THE VOICES OF BIRDS CAN BE PLAYED IN NATURE!
In the presence of the Internet, the voices of birds can be played directly in nature. After paying for in-app purchases, all functions can be used offline, including in the areas without the Internet - on ornithological excursions, walks in the country, on expeditions, hunting or fishing.
THE APPLICATION IS DESIGNED FOR:
• birdwatchers and professional ornithologists;
• university students and faculty at on-site seminars;
• teachers of secondary schools and additional (out-of school) education;
• forestry workers and hunters;
• employees of nature reserves, national parks and other nature protected areas;
• songbird lovers;
• tourists, campers and nature guides;
• parents with their children and summer residents;
• all other nature lovers.
A subscription after the first free week costs 2.99€.
App Privacy Policy: https://tapa.su/birds-privacy-policy/
License Agreement: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00155438:ios.description:
Experience Intelligent Companionship Like Never Before
Meet authentic AI companions designed to spark meaningful conversations on your own terms. Whether you’re drawn to someone witty, empathetic, or delightfully unpredictable, you’ll find a voice that resonates. With new gender flexibility and customizable traits, it’s never been easier to create the perfect persona — or discover one that feels just right.
Why You’ll Love It:
• Explore Diverse Personalities: Choose from a growing gallery of AI profiles, each with distinct traits, interests, and conversational styles. Engage with AI that learns from every conversation and evolves to match your mood, humor, and interests.
• Create Your Own AI Persona: Want a companion that’s completely your own? Craft a unique AI persona with a photo, name, age, personality tags, bio, and interests. Watch as your creation adapts to you over time, making every conversation feel more genuine and immersive.
• Dynamic Interactions: The more you chat, the more your AI partner understands your humor, values, and emotional cues. Experience dialogues that feel natural, supportive, and truly personalized — whether you’re seeking casual banter, heartfelt confessions, or intellectual debates.

• Flexible Gender Preferences: Tailor your experience by selecting the gender dynamics of your AI companions. This added layer of personalization ensures every interaction aligns with your comfort and preferences.
• Premium Access: Unlock even richer connections, including unlimited pairing options and the freedom to craft your own unique AI profiles.
Embrace the Future of Connection:
This platform is more than just a dating or chat app — it’s a gateway to exploring new dimensions of companionship. Immerse yourself in conversations that reflect who you are and who you aspire to be, all while discovering intriguing perspectives along the way.
Download now and redefine what it means to connect in a digital world. Your AI mate awaits.

apple-macos:1529082184.description:
Idle Game 1 is an incremental game stripped down to its core: just the joy of watching numbers go up.
No story, no characters, no ads. Upgrade, prestige, repeat.
The twist is the prestige mechanic. Each reset gives a random boost to a random color, so no two runs play the same, and you have to adapt your strategy to what you get. It looks simple, but give it time and you'll see how deep it gets. When you're stuck, just step away: your next prestige bonus grows while you idle.
Clean lo-fi visuals and FM-synthesized sounds make it fun to replay over and over.
Play responsibly and good luck!
Notes from the developer:
 * Prestige cheats are not random, you'll be able to select color & boost type.
 * Prestige cheats are single use items meant to carry you forward in the game. https://idle1.com/cheats.html
 * Please don't damage your screen by leaving it on for long hours
 * Players with eye problems, please use the 'low contrast' mode for long hours of play
 * Speed upgrades start to affect earns after maxing out the color speed
